artworks.title: Three Panels
artworks.description: The painting features three distinct scenes, each separated by a white border. The first scene depicts a seated figure with ten heads and 20 hands. Additionally, the figure is accompanied by four attendants who are holding a monkey in a sling. The second scene shows three ladies engaged in a dancing scene. The third and final scene portrays three male figures.

artworks.title: Seated Krishna with Two Male Figures and a Lady
artworks.description: The painting depicts a serene scene with several figures. A portrait of seated Krishna is accompanied by two male figures and a lady, suggesting that he has been pacified by them. A separate work shows a portrait of a lady standing beside a mango tree, while another piece captures a conversation between two ladies. Additionally, there is an image of a seated saint. The top of the painting features an inscription, providing context and information about the artwork.

artworks.title: A Lady Holding a Deer
artworks.description: The painting depicts a lady standing in a scene that is rich in symbolism. Wearing a red dress with a black floral pattern, she holds a deer by its horns with her right hand and a flower in her left hand. Besides the subject's attire and pose, the painting also features an inscription at the top written in Persian.

artworks.title: Lady Enjoying Huqqa

artworks.title: Embracing Couple
artworks.description: The painting depicts a couple standing in profile and embracing each other. The man is dressed in a green dress and wears a red turban, while the lady wears a pink dress with a blue floral pattern. Bearing an inscription in Persian script at the top adds another layer of cultural significance to this artwork.

artworks.title: Lady with a Deer
artworks.description: The painting depicts a woman standing and engaging in two distinct activities. She is holding a musical instrument in her right hand and feeding leaves to a deer with her left hand. The subject is dressed in a green dress, which is complemented by a red odni. The painting also features an Urdu inscription at the top on a card board mount.

artworks.title: Lady Holding a Child and Parrot
artworks.description: The painting depicts a woman standing and holding a child in her right arm. She also has a parrot perched on her left hand. The subject is wearing a pink coloured garment with a green leaf pattern, which adds to the overall aesthetic of the artwork. An inscription in Urdu can be seen at the top of the painting, providing additional context and information about the piece.

artworks.title: Embracing Couple
artworks.description: The painting depicts a romantic scene of a couple standing together, embracing each other. The man is dressed in a red costume with a distinctive black leaf pattern. The woman accompanying him wears a whitish costume also featuring a black leaf pattern and green accents, adding to the overall aesthetic of the piece. At the top of the painting, an inscription in Persian adds another layer of cultural significance to the artwork.

The dress also features green accents, specifically on the bodice or skirt, which add to its visual appeal. The subject of the painting is carrying a musical instrument over her right shoulder. At the top of the painting, there is an inscription written in Persian, adding another layer of cultural and historical context to the artwork.

artworks.title: The Hindu Religious Figures in Five Panels

In the second four male figures and two females are represented prominent among the males is the Brahma's supplicant, shown in the first panel. He is shown again, in the third panel, sitting over Vishnu. The god's consort, with folded hands, is a helpless witness to the seen. in the same panel is shown Vishnu holding left leg of the Rishi in his hands. in the fourth panel appears three pairs of saintly men and also of the left corner Brahma with suppliant cant right male figures and one female are shown in the bottom panel.

artworks.title: Rasikapriya
artworks.description: Miniature painting. Illustration from Rasikapriya- " Rasika Kavibhasa Rasa " , depicted Radha seated on white bolster outside the room anxiously she is waiting for somebody. A maid servant is spending in front of her. Hindi inscription on top and below the painting.

artworks.title: Dhanasari Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting. Illustrating " Dhanasari Ragini " represents a princess seated on a white carpet with big bolster at her back applying tilak on her fore head looking into a mirror, held by a maid. Another maid is standing at her back. Red colour border. Devanagari inscription at the back side of the painting.

metadata.title2: A Princess Seated on a White Carpet Applying Tilak on Her Fore Head Looking Into a Mirror

artworks.title: Dhanashree Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature pained " Dhanasri Ragini " of Sri Raga, depicts a lady seated under a tree on a floral designed carpet with a bolster at her back. Two rabbits are standing in front of her. Lady holding a white cloth in her right hand and left hand stretched towards the rabbits. Hindi inscription on top of the painting. Red coloured border.

artworks.description: Double sided miniature painting from " Bhagavata purana " manuscript Krishna blessing the four People below a tree. artworks.title: Raga Dipaka
artworks.description: The painting depicts "Raga Dipaka", which shows a Raja seated in an ambari on an elephant, holding a flower in his right hand. A man is standing at the back of the elephant, while five persons are walking in front of it. An inscription can be seen at the back of the painting.

metadata.title2: Raja Seated in an Ambari on Elephant

artworks.title: Nata Ragini
artworks.description: Painting of " Nata Ragini " depicting a Raja watching the acrobatic done by two ladies. A lady offering respects to Raja. She holds a sword in her left hand orange colour border.

artworks.description: Prophet Mohammed's journey from Miraj to Heaven on winged horse base having a female head. Angles are welcoming him to heaven.

artworks.description: Raja seated resting his right hand on the bolster. A fly- whisk bearer at the back of the Raja. A person seated on the right side of the Raja and other three standing in front of him.

artworks.title: King and Queen Riding Elephant
artworks.description: A Raja seated on elephant back. A maid servant helping the queen to sit on the elephant for a ride with king.

artworks.description: Procession of Ramasta khan on elephant back along with his followers. Background represents hillocks, trees and a pond.

metadata.title2: Ramasta Khan on Elephant Back Along with His Followers

artworks.title: King and Queen in Court-yard
artworks.description: Raja seated on a floral bed along with his wife. A fly-whisk bearer is positioned at the back. Two persons are standing in front of Raja, one holding an umbrella. The background of the painting features flower plants and a Devanagari inscription can be seen at the backside of the painting.

artworks.description: A folio from a Ramayana manuscript, Rama proving his power to Sugriva by standing the arrow through seven trees Laxmana stands behind with a cow in his right hand and an arrow in his left hand seven birds flying in the sky. Inscription on top of the painting.

artworks.title: A Seated Painter
artworks.description: The painting depicts a seated figure of a painter. The painter is dressed in a white turban, a muslin anghrakha with a yellow bordered black waist band. He holds a painting in his left hand and a brush in his right hand. In front of him are different color bowls.

artworks.title: Love Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting love scene of a Raja and a Rani seated on a red floral design carpet with floral design cloth spread out on the carpet. Violet color bolster at the back of the Raja and two similar color pillows at the side of the Raja. A maid servant standing in front of them holding a cup in her right hand and a decanter in her left hand. Red color border around the painting.

metadata.title2: A Raja and a Rani Seated on a Red Floral Design Carpet

artworks.title: Raja Amar Singh
artworks.description: Raja Amar Singh of Bikaner seated on a chair. Wearing two pearl necklaces and with a waist band. Raja holding a sword in his left hand.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Raja
artworks.description: Painting depicting Raja holding a stick in his right hand. Wearing matching necklace, amulet and two bracelets. Wearing a anklet his right ankle. Wearing a red colour turban.

artworks.title: Scene from Bhagawata Purana
artworks.description: Painting depicting a scene from Baghwatha Purana Manuscript. Kneeling kamsa touching the feet of seated Vasudeva and Devaki Devanagiri inscription on both of the painting.

metadata.title2: Kamsa Saluting His Brother-in-law Vasudev and Sister Devaki

artworks.title: A Folio from Ramayana Manuscript
artworks.description: Illustration on both sides. A folio from Ramayana manuscript. Bramaha appearing before a saint. Below king Dasaradha seated on a throne approached by two sages and young prince in the palace and to the right side of this king. Dasaradha standing with bow and arrows with a prince and sages and two female attendants standing in front of him on a hill slope. on the other side illustration represents in THREE PANELS attendants guiding two sages. three young princess sitting in side the palace and two saints and two ladies are standing in front of them. PANEL TWO:two saints and young prince standing before a seated king, THIRD PANEL: a young prince seated in a lap of queen, a noble standing in front of them.)king dasharada demonstrating with bow and arrow to prince.

artworks.title: Vastra Apharan
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of 'vastra apharan', which is a mythological event. Krishna is seated on a tree, surrounded by the stolen saris of Gopies, with two saris on either side of the tree. The Gopies themselves are shown standing in water, holding lotuses in their folded hands. The painting features a red color border, adding to its vibrant and eye-catching appearance.

metadata.title2: Krishna Seated on a Tree with Stolen Sarees of Gopies

artworks.title: Jain Kalpa Sutra
artworks.description: A page from "Jain Kalpa sutra" depicting painting on either side of the page . On one side a seated person with attendant on either side. Reverse person applying thilak on the fore-head of a seated prince. Two standing figures at the bottom of the painting. Inscription on either side of the painting.

metadata.title2: On One Side a Seated Person with Attendant

artworks.title: Gor - Mahar Ragini
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a woman named Gor-Maihar Ragini seated in front of water. She is surrounded by four trees, with one banana tree on either side of her. In the sky above, clouds are visible. The lady's hands are stretched out to both sides.

metadata.title2: A Lady Seated with Stretched Hands in Front of Water, Four Trees on Either Side of Her

artworks.title: Prince Seated Under a Canopy
artworks.description: Illustration from an unidentified manuscript showing a prince seated under a canopy receiving a noble. An attendant holding a blue horse at his back. Two attendants are standing at the back of the prince. Another bearded noble is receiving a noble, with three attendants holding the gifts in tray. Two attendants following the noble one lifting presents and another following him. Building and trees in background and building in the foreground.

artworks.title: Illustration from Swarga-naraka
artworks.description: Illustration from 'Swarga-Naraka' series depicting the sinners hanged inverted to a rod with hands and legs tied with chains and fire burning below them. A dog eating the flesh of a man one another sinner laid on a pole and his hands and legs are ties with chains. Three crows eating his flesh. A devil shooting an arrow to him from below.Another devil holding the rod. Red color border around the painting inscription on top of the painting.

metadata.title2: The Sinners Hanged Inverted to a Rod with Hands and Legs Tied with Chains & Fire Burning Below Them

artworks.title: Conversation of Raja Daleel Singh Ji and Kishan Singh Ji
artworks.description: Painting depicting Raja Daleel Singhji seated under a canopy on a floral design carpet. Two bolsters at his back. Kishen Singhji seated in front of him with a black shield in front of him with a black shield in his both hand. An attendant standing at the back of Raja. Sword and shield in the foreground Inscription on top of the painting. Red colour border.

artworks.description: Modern painting by " K. Narender Nath " titled " Dream II " . A man sleeping leaving his chappals on ground. Right leg lifted Moon in the sky. Face not visible. in a wooden frame.

artworks.title: Abstract Painting
artworks.description: Contemporary painting with the titled " Drawing No.10 " by Shah Ali. Shows an abstract pattern in pink, brown and black colours, in a wooden frame.

artworks.title: Hunger
artworks.description: Painting entitled " Hunger ", shows two weary people seated by "S. Vittal Rao. " on drawing sheet.

artworks.description: Painting entitled " Spectre of kitty hawk " showing a caricature by " S.Vittal Rao " . on drawing sheet.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Saint Burhan
artworks.description: The painting depicts Saint Burhan seated on a carpet, with both his hands placed on his knees as if in prayer. He is dressed in a white turban and a violet-colored shawl. The inscription on top of the painting is written in Urdu and Hindi. A dark green border surrounds the entire painting.

artworks.title: Jain Kalpa Sutra
artworks.description: An Illustrated folio from 'KALPA SUTRA ', yellow and blue combined type with border illuminations showing human, animal floral and abstract patterns, depicts the seated Mahaveera in the center in samavasarna in around shape. Inscription in the center and in another panel. Reverse:-Text on left and and right panels. divided by figures on three vertical borders. The center vertical panel showing two dancers and in the other two panels show figures with folded hands.

metadata.title2: An Illustrated Folio from Kalpa Sutra

artworks.title: Jain Tirthankara
artworks.description: Miniature painting depicts the seated Tirthankara with a halo. Two devotees holding fly-whisks, a dancer and two musicians. Floral border around the painting.

metadata.title2: The Seated Tirthankara with a Halo with Two Devotees Holding Fly-whisks, a Dancer and Two Musicians

artworks.title: Bhagwatha Purana
artworks.description: Painting depicting a scene from a Hindu epic probably Bhagwatha. Krishna is shown in a swing inside a house with his parents on either side and a female fly-whisk bearer behind the father. Out side the house in the foreground are seen four Gopies pouring out milk on three noblemen in the middle, along with three male musicians and one female dancer on one side. Plantain trees are prominent , one on the extreme left and one on the right side.

metadata.title2: Krishna Is Shown in a Swing Inside a House with His Parents on Either Side

artworks.title: An Illustration from Saranga Tatwa
artworks.description: Painting depicting an illustration from 'Saranga tatwa' series. It depicts four different scenes divided into three panels. Two at the top and one at the bottom. The left side panel at the top shows a noble wearing a turban seated on a rectangular seat with bolster at his back on a terrace. Two lady attendants standing on either side of him in service holding fans. The lady attendant standing on either side of him in service holding fans the lady attendant standing to his left scenes to inform something to the noble and both of them scene to be in discussion with their left hands out stretched. A box and a tray shown in the foreground. The right side panel at the top shows a Royal couple walking towards a palace and covering themselves with a big metal bowl and a red rug from the head to foot. A noble man is holding a sword in his right hand. The couple is attending in front of a tree from which a peacock is shown gazing at them. Green fields and sky in the background. In the third panel at the bottom on the left side two men are shown seated before a housing warming themselves from a hearth place between them. A peacock is seen in the foreground a tree besides the house a floral arch in the foreground with two white flower garlands hanging from it. A bolster is shown below the arch placed on a white seat on the right side of the panel is shown a man wearing a striped turban and a loin cloth is shown stirring with a stick the peculiar content like a human couple, a peacock, a horse, and a camel and elephant besides some trees and buildings in a huge golden bowl seems to be kept on the top of the son, whose heat and flame's are visible. A crescent is shown in the foreground. Sanskrit inscription in two lines on top of the painting.

metadata.title2: It Depicts Four Different Scenes Divided Into Three Panels

artworks.title: Saint
artworks.description: Painting depicting a saint (Probably christian saint Abraham) seated under a tree on the shore of a river, under moon lit sky. Three winged fairies are shown kneeling in front of him offering food and wine. Another winged fairy kneeling by the side of him is shown offering him fruits. A small fire is shown burning in front of the group. Two small egrets are shown in the foreground. In the background....

artworks.title: An European Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicting an European lady standing and holding a lotus flower with stalk in her right hand. She wears a full length blue skirt and full sleeved upper garment of pink violet color and has a brown blanket on her shoulders. She wears a peacock feather also has a stringed bead necklace. She has sandals on her feet.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mohabbati Khan
artworks.description: Sitting portrait of Mohabbati Khan under a tree smoking a huqqa. The noble is shown wearing a cream coloured Jama, trousers with pink stripes on white background and a gold brocade turban. He has a jamadhar tied to his waist by a brocade patka. He is seated against a bolster on a carpet of yellow ground with a floral pattern. The carpet is covered with white cloth on the actual portion where the noble is seated. A gold colour spittoon and a betel box are near each feet. The background shows green hills.

metadata.title2: Portrait of Mohabbati Khan Under a Tree Smoking a Huqqa

artworks.title: Seven Travelers in a Forest
artworks.description: Painting depicting seven travellers in a forest. Two of the travellers are naked and squatting with water pots in their hands. The rest are standing and undressing when, attached by a swarm of ants. A big tree is in the background and a smaller one in the foreground. The Costumes and weapons of some of the travellers are shown placed on ground with huqqa and water pots. A black she goat and a dog are depicted.

artworks.title: Scene from Vishnu Purana
artworks.description: Painting depicting Vishnu pooja,with Lord Vishnu seated under a pavilion on a throne covered with a huge lotus having a bolster at the back. Vishnu is shown with four arms holding the usual emblems, wearing a yellow dhoti and a uttariya of the same color placed over his left shoulder. He is wearing a gold crown with crests studded with jewels. A Raja with his consort and three princes are on the left side facing Vishnu. On the other side the Gods Brahma and Maheswara accompanied by one female divinity and three other male divinities are shown approaching Lord Vishnu. Trees in the background and also in the fore-ground with birds. The pavilion in which Lord Vishnu is seated seems to be a part of a palace with a wall behind. possibly the work of artist Nikka.

metadata.title2: Vishnu on a Throne , Brahma,shiva and Others Are Standing Both Sides

artworks.title: An Illustration from Saranga Tatva
artworks.description: Illustration from "Sarangatatva" series, showing a king with his boy prince shown seated on throne, attended by a female fly-whisk bearer and another male attendant both of them holding gold color bowls in their hands. A noble is shown standing in front of king with his right hand raised and seems to be informing something to him. Outside the palace premises a person is shown sound asleep in a small room. In the star lit sky the crowned head, of probably a divine figure depicted swallowing the moon. the palace has three white domes and out side a banana tree and two different tree are shown. Inscription in two lines on top of the painting. in black letters on yellow ground.

metadata.title2: A King with Young Prince Shown Seated on Throne

artworks.title: Playing Lady with a Yo-yo near a Flowering Tree
artworks.description: Portrait of a female playing with a YO-YO near a flowering tree. The YO-YO is held in her hands. A child on her right side and a dog in the foreground. The painted portion is enclosed by a dark black border. The main figure wears a red skirt and a short black chola.

artworks.title: Raga Megha Malhara
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Mewar school portraying 'Raga Megha Malhara'. The picture shows blue complexion Krishna with a veena in his left hand standing among the group of eight Gopika's, four of them on either side. One of the Gopika's is playing mrudangam while another is playing on cymbals .The set is a garden with a fountain in center foreground.

artworks.title: Raga Madhumadhavi
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Gujarat/Rajasthani school portraying 'Raga Madhumadhavi'. The painting in a horizontal format a shows a Nayika standing out side pavilion surrounded by two tigers and two birds. on the top left hand a rivulet has been suggested and two stylized trees have been depicts between the Nayika and the tiger.

metadata.title2: Nayika Standing Out Side Pavilion Surrounded by Two Tigers and Two Birds

artworks.title: Vasanta Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting portraying 'vasanta Ragini'. The composition shows a group of gopis playing holi with Krishna on the left and a group of youths on the right. Two women pour coloured water on Krishna's head from a pitcher and a bottle in the foreground another female drawing coloured water in a syringe from a pitcher. The youth in foreground on the right has a musical percussion instrument in hand.

artworks.title: A Scene from Bhagavatha
artworks.description: Miniature painting depicting a scene from Bhagvata. Krishna and Balarama are standing under a tree and watching four cowherds seated in front of them, two of them seated under another tree and two in between the two trees on the bank of a river. A person is shown lying in the river with a fish behind his head.

metadata.title2: Krishna and Balarama Are Standing Under a Tree

artworks.title: Kaliya Mardana
artworks.description: Miniature painting depicting the episode of Kaliya Mardana. Krishna is shown seated on the five headed snake Kaliya with the wives of Kaliya standing on either side in the river.

metadata.title2: Krishna Seated on the Five Headed Snake

artworks.title: Illustrated Manuscript
artworks.description: A single leaf from a manuscript illustrated on both sides on one side four headed god is depicted seated on top of a hillock between two trees. Cowherds and cows are also seen at various places. on the hillock. On the other side Krishna followed by a cowherd is showing his right hand towards the cows in front of him. Two other in front of them are also depicted in this scene.

metadata.title2: Four Headed God Is Depicted Seated on Top of Hill Cowherds and Cows Are Also Seen at Various Places

artworks.title: Scene from Bhagavata
artworks.description: Miniature painting depicting a scene from Bhagavata. The theme is of Krishna and Balaram driving the cows along with four other cowherds driving the cows in the foreground.

metadata.title2: Krishna and Balaram Driving the Cows

artworks.title: A Warrior on Camel
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of three men, with one man riding a camel and the other two paying homage to him. One of the men in the front is holding a coconut, while all three individuals are dressed in turbans and sporting mustaches.

metadata.title2: Two Men Paying Obeisance to the Warrior

artworks.title: One Rider on Camel and Another on Horseback
artworks.description: Painting depicting two men, one riding on a camel and another on a horseback. Both of them are shown charging towards the right. The horseman is shown holding a flag in his right hand and the camel riding noble is shown holding a bow in the both hands.

artworks.title: Fighting Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting two soldiers in full Armour fighting each other with swords. The soldier to the right is shown in left profile while the face of the soldier to the left is in three quarter profile with his right eye depicted half. Both are wearing beards and moustaches. Both wear up turned shoes.

metadata.title2: Two Soldiers in Full Armour Fighting Each Other with Swords

artworks.title: Narasimha Killing Hiranyakasipu
artworks.description: Narasimha killing Hiranyakasipu. Standing on either side, Prahlada & Leelavati watching with folded hand. Narasimha is shown with lion face, four hands two tiger's legs, emerging out of a broken pillar. Hiranyakasipu is with green costume, dagger like mustaches and disheselled hair. The faces of Hiranyakasipu, Prahalada & Leelavati are all shown in profile.

artworks.title: A Seated Lady Holding a Parrot
artworks.description: Painting portrays a seated lady holding a parrot in the right hand.

artworks.title: Mahaprabhuji and Jamunadasji
artworks.description: Painting depicting four vaishnava gurus and disciples. According to the inscription on the reverse, one of them is Mahaprabhuji, and another is Jamunadasji. The painting was created by the artist Amardasji and dated V.S. 1884 (A.D. 1927).

artworks.title: Conversation of Maharaja Durjan Sal and Rajavata Chitor Singh
artworks.description: Maharaja Durjan sal of Kota with Rajavata chitor singh of Ramgarh and an attendant.

metadata.title2: Maharaja Durjan Sal of Kota with Rajavata Chitor Singh of Ramgarh and an Attendant

artworks.title: Prince Feeding the Birds
artworks.description: Painting showing a prince holding a flag staff with an attendant to his back and two swans to his front. He wears a Mughal style of head gear of gold colour cloth, diaphanous white jama and kurte with full sleeves tucked into red trousers having golden stripes.

metadata.title2: A Prince Holding a Flag Staff with an Attendant to His Back and Two Swans to His Front

artworks.title: Maharaja Sri Ajeet Singh Ji
artworks.description: Painting depicting a full length portrait in profile of Maharaja Sri Ajeet singhji in standing position holding in his left hand a straight sword touching the ground and with his right hand on the Jamadhar which is secured in Kamarbandh. Portion of a long curved sword and a shield at back hung from his shoulders are shown.

metadata.title2: Portraitof Maharaja Sri Ajeet Singhji in Standing Position

artworks.title: Portrait of Shekhavata Amar Singh Ji
artworks.description: Painting depicting a full length portrait in right profile of Shekhavata Amar singhji.

metadata.title2: The Portrait of a Standing Shekhavata Amar Singh Ji

artworks.title: Portrait of a Bird
artworks.description: Portrait of a bird, Devanagari inscription at the back says that this is the portrait of a bird Lal Tasri, presented to Gajadhara by the artist Sukhram in V.S.1842(A.D.1785) on the 10th day of the month of Asij. Sukhram seems to have been a disciple of the master artist Gajadhara from who we have many paintings in the Bikanir palace collection.

artworks.title: Rag Maru
artworks.description: Painting illustrating 'Rag Maru', with a jogini and a disciple seated face to face in front of a temple under a star studded sky adorned with half moon. Both figures are shown is profile.

metadata.title2: A Jogini and a Disciple Seated Face to Face in Front of a Temple

artworks.title: Illustration of Rag Dhola Maru
artworks.description: Illustration of Rag dhola Maru A lady in male dress seated on a camel facing a male seated on a horse.

metadata.title2: A Lady in Male Dress Seated on a Camel Facing a Male Seated on a Horse

artworks.title: Lord Krishna and Balaram Playing
artworks.description: Two Deccani paintings on two sides (A & B) on paper. (A) painting to show two separate scenes arranged one above the other. The lower panel depicts three cow boys playing. The upper panel shows Krishna and Balaram playing with three other cow boys. (B) Painting depicts Krishna and Balaram seated below a tree along with two cow boy friends. The tree is flanked by Krishna with a cow boy to his back.

metadata.title2: Lord Krishna and Balaram Seated Below a Tree Along with Two Cow Boy Friends

artworks.title: Ladies Conversation Scene
artworks.description: There are two Deccani paintings, one on each side of the paper. The first painting, A), depicts six seated ladies engaged in conversation under a canopy. The second painting, B), also depicts six seated ladies conversing under a canopy.

metadata.title2: Six Seated Ladies Engaged in Conversation Under a Canopy

artworks.title: Rishi Standing in Front of Four Headed God Seated Under a Tree
artworks.description: Two Deccani paintings on two sides (A & B) on paper (A) Painting depicts five bearded Rishi's seated under a tree. Two of them are seated on a mat to the left, facing the other three Rishi's seated on another mat, to the right, obviously engaged in some discourse. (B) Painting on the second side of the paper depicts a Rishi standing in front of seated Brahma under a tree.

metadata.title2: Five Bearded Rishi's Seated Under a Tree

artworks.title: Portrait of Sultan Mohammed
artworks.description: Portrait of Sultan Mohammed (brother of Shah Alam), In standing position, with both hands on the patka. He is shown with mustaches and beard, plumed turban of shah jehani style, full sleeved angarkha, pyjama and painted shoes. Inscribed on the reverse. He wears two necklaces and dagger in the patka on the right side. Pearls and stone wrist at on the right hand, floral designs on the garment.

artworks.title: Bairadi Ragini
artworks.description: Painting Illustrating Bairadi Ragini. It depicts a love scene set in a palace with a lady seated opposite a seated king who fondles her left breast with his right hand. Colour scheme comprise dominating white for the palace, blue for the firmament and green for the floor.

metadata.title2: A Love Scene Set in a Palace with a Lady Seated, King Fondles Her Left Breast with His Right Hand

artworks.title: Krishan and Arjuna
artworks.description: Painting showing two scenes at two levels. The lower scene depicts Krishna and Arjuna in a running chariot drawn by two white horses along the lakeside. The lake is filled with lotus flowers, a marble fountain and four storks. The upper panel throws up an undulating and a scene of hills and vales. At the extreme left a cluster of buildings are shown indicative of a city from where a number of devotees are seen traversing to pay homage to a Rishi seated on the extreme right in panel color scheme compresses brown , green, yellow blue ,and white.

artworks.title: Month of Chaitra
artworks.description: Painting illustrating the month of chaitra. A lady with folded hands beseeches her lord while he seems intent upon going away. The locale consists of a pavilion in a garden. The background shows bush greenery consisting of plantain trees, creepers and lotus with a peacock and a pair of parrots. The lady wears a choli, odhni & shirt and the man has an angarkha and a jewelled turban. At the top there is a description of the month of chaitra in Devanagari script in Hindi.

artworks.title: Jain Kalpa Sutra
artworks.description: An illustrated folio from the Jain Kalpa Sutra having the text and a miniature painting on the front side and text on the back side written in Devanagari script. The painting shows a seated lady in front of two crowned men, one of them having a nimbus around his head.

artworks.title: Jain Kalpa Sutra
artworks.description: An illustrated folio from the Jain Kalpa Sutra having the text and miniature painting on the front side, and only text on the back side written in Devanagari script. The painting shows a crowned person with nimbus standing in front of two Munis, one seated and one standing.

artworks.title: Lord Vishnu
artworks.description: Vishnu and his consort riding in a chariot drawn by two horses.

artworks.title: An Episode from the Ramayana
artworks.description: Miniature painting on paper depicting an episode from the Ramayana. The rectangular space is divided into five arched panels with the two extreme panels having an elephant and a horse each in the lower portion. The central panel depicts Rama and Sita seated on a throne, attended by two chowri bearers, one chatra holder, while three attendants handle Nidhis at bottom. Hanuman sits at left of Rama. The central panel is flanked by two panels filled with the princes, Rishis and the vanara heros. The farthest panels on the left and rights shows Narada and Thumbara standing with their musical instruments.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Is Shown with His Consort and Garuda
artworks.description: Indian Miniature painting depicting a mythological episode from the life of Krishna. Krishna is shown with his consort and Garuda, four naked boys, one maid & two guards. Krishna's consort while speaking to him points her left hand towards the Duplicate boys. Krishna keeps his right hand on Garuda while the maid holds up an umbrella to him below a canopy. This may be a scene just before an episode, in which Krishna took off to Bhrhmaloka on Garuda in search of a missing cow boys who was kidnapped and hidden by Brahma it is a night scene which moon and stars in the sky and two tall tapering candles with flames on either side.

artworks.title: Rama and Sita in Darbar
artworks.description: Indian miniature painting depicting Rama durbar set in a marble place against lush green vegetation with Rama and Sita seated on a chowki type throne and attended by Lakshmana, Bharata and Satrighna at the back and Hanuman in the front paying obeisance.

metadata.title2: Lakshmana, Bharatha Hanuman in Front Paying Obeisance

artworks.title: Princess Enjoying Music
artworks.description: Indian miniature painting depicts a serene palace scene under the light of the moon, where a princess is being entertained by her attendants. The princess sits comfortably against a bolster, surrounded by three maids who are singing and playing music to delight her. A veena lies nearby, adding to the enchanting atmosphere.

artworks.title: Dancing Lady
artworks.description: Indian miniature painting showing a seated lady with raised hands which are clasped at top apparently indicative of a dancing posture. She is shown in profile, wearing a violate coloured, spotted pyzama and a transparent bodies, leaning against a red and green bolster buttressed by a marble trellis.

artworks.title: Portrait of Alawardi Khan Jehangiri
artworks.description: Indian miniature painting showing a Mughal courtier, standing against a dark brown background. The inscription above his head says " Alawardi Khan Jehangiri " He wears angarkha, pyzama, patka and a head-gear decorated with two feathers. He holds a flower in the right hand, and a walking stick or a gupti in the other.

artworks.title: Laila and Majnu
artworks.description: Indian miniature painting depicting Laila-Majnu theme. Apparently unfinished, this sketch shows two women Laila & her maid standing in front of half naked, emaciated Majnu sporting beard and Moustache, seated on the back of unequally emaciated horse against white ground. The women wear loose robe like garments with tight fitting full sleeves, odnis thrown up to serve as veils, long, dark, curly dresses failing in front on either side , nose-gay and other ornaments.

artworks.title: Love Letter
artworks.description: Indian Miniature painting " Love letter " which is obviously a love letter while her maid is standing behind her with a chowry and a cloth in hands.

artworks.title: Hiranyakasipu Being Killed by Narasimha
artworks.description: Indian miniature painting showing Vishnu in the Narasimha avatara disemboweling Hiranyakasipu flanked by the Supplicant. Spectator- Leelavati and Prahlada.

artworks.title: Nawab of Bhawalpur Riding on an Elephant
artworks.description: Nawab of Bahawalpur riding on an elephant with a Mahavath seated in front while a turbaned and long robed bearded man with a Mahajar is standing in front of the elephant and bowing down.The howdah and the elephant are covered with calligraphy, the mahout's face is shown in profile while those of the Nawab & the bowing man frontal, Black, red, gold, yellow, green and white colors are used, a lengthy Urdu inscription at top.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Raja
artworks.description: Indian miniature painting showing a realistic bust portrait of a Raja with a moustache. The Raja is adorned with a pearl stringed sharper, pearl and emerald necklaces, and pearl, gold and emerald ear-drops. He wears a gold lined blue coat.

artworks.title: Presenting War Scene
artworks.description: A folio of an illustrated manuscript having illustration Devanagari on either side of the Folio. Presenting war scene. A king with his two consorts seated in a marble pavilion and besieged by enemy force in the first painting. The second painting depicting the rout of the enemy with the elephant and its rider fallen dead as the foot soldier and two horse riders fleeing. Alone horse rider is seen exchanging arrows with the seated king. A horse rider attacking the king with his musket in the first painting. Two trees in the middle of the landscape in the second painting as against one tree in the first painting. Painted against yellow land scape and green trees with a semblance of perspective shown in the receding horizon colour scheme comprises ochre yellow, grey, shades of mango and white.

artworks.title: Aurangazeb Seated on Throne
artworks.description: Indian Miniature painting showing Aurangzeb seated on a throne facing a standing noble, set in a place. Aurangzeb in ripe old age with white bread & moustache. Ten calligraphic panels around the painting giving chronological details of his life. One big calligraphic panel on the other side of the painting. Golden umbrella above the throne, the figures are shown in profile. Gold colour profusely used other colours include the combined shades of blue, green, red and white.

artworks.title: Mother with Children
artworks.description: Painting showing a mother with children, one each on either side done in oil colour and with butterfly wings set in a black painted wooden frame.

artworks.title: Three Pine Trees
artworks.description: Painting by Dorothy Buckley D.H.S. showing three pine trees and a woman walking away with a bundle of sticks. Done in oil colour and butterfly wings within a brass frame.

artworks.title: Dining Room Scene
artworks.description: The artwork is an oil painting created on a wooden slab and depicts a scene of a dining room. The painting shows a girl wearing jewels standing, while the other diners are seated. It was created by Berndston Gabail. The piece is framed in a carved gilt wooden frame.

artworks.title: Laundry Scene
artworks.description: Oil painting on wooden panel depicting a laundry scene where in a group of women are ironing clothe. Two women looking at the work. The painting is fixed in a carved gilt wooden frame.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: Water colour painting on rectangular paper with black wooden frame, Representing trees at left and bushes in foreground. Signature 'B. Lealie Rogers' at bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Lane with Houses on Either Side
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper showing a lane with houses on either side, two women are seen at right near water pails, a man in the center and a woman and a child at left. Signature of the painter at bottom left corner with inscription Sophia D Ouseley Meridith...... .

artworks.title: A Scene of Sailing Boats
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper painted with a scene of sailing boats. A light house at center of the right side. Signature J. Wilton is seen at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Group of People
artworks.description: The panel painting depicts a scene of people leaving a location. The group consists of men, women, and children, with various objects visible in the foreground, including a rifle, bugle, and bag. The artwork is signed by A. Friedlaender at the bottom right side.

artworks.title: Represents a Garden Scene
artworks.description: A rectangular porcelain slab painted with a garden scene; a woman is seated on a chair, a child is standing in front and as empty sage on the ground.

artworks.title: A River Scene
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper: a river scene, a ship is seen in the foreground, other ship and yard at the right side. Signature J.Wilton is inscribed at bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Lake View
artworks.description: The watercolour painting depicts a serene lake scene with a nearby tree under which a small hut stands. A figure can be seen standing to the left of the composition, while goats and a shepherd are positioned on the right-hand side. The artwork is signed by J.M.B.Williams at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Sea-scape
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas; sea -scape is represented with a fleet of ships a barrel is floating at the right. Initials J.M. Combined are inscribed at bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Sea Sore
artworks.description: Sea Shore. This represents a sea shore with two women standing one with a car the other with a vessel and net. Boats are depicted at the left. The ladies are probably belonging to fishermen and waiting for the boats with fish. Signature C.Ciolta is inscribed at bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; a landscape is painted showing trees at left, hillock in the background and a brook in the foreground. Initials A.K. are inscribed at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Bridge with Building
artworks.description: The painting depicts a serene scene of a bridge with swans swimming in the water below, accompanied by houses on the left and a tower in the center. A group of people are visible at the left side of the scene, adding to the sense of activity and life in the area. The artwork is signed by Sophie D. Ouseley Meredith, whose signature is inscribed at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; a landscape is painted showing a bridge in the center on which two men are seated one with fishing chord in hand. A rider with a woman is at rear left, bullocks and trees in the background. M.H.Long inscribed at bottom right corner. Another name and date 1834 is found at left which is not clear.

artworks.title: Building Scene
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; a building wall is seen and an old man is peeling by on the road Painter s at bottom right corner and title Le, Musee De Cluny at left.

artworks.title: Herring Boats in the Water
artworks.description: Water colour on paper depicting Herring Boats in the waters. Sign T.James is inscribed at bottom right corner.

artworks.title: A Scene of Tank
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; painted with a scene of tank. Seven water carriers are seen and a man with a line standing, a boat is at left with three children.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas, a landscape is represented with hillocks on three sides. A river flows in between heavy boulders in the foreground. Signature "J. Gerold" is inscribed at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.description: The artwork is an oil painting created on canvas. It is a still life piece that employs the technique of using a brush to apply paint, as opposed to finger touch. The subject matter depicted in the painting includes a flower vase, fruit dish, tea-pot, and cup saucer. The artwork is signed by the artist "Sayeed Be..." at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Sea-scape Showing the Rough Waves
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; sea-scape showing the rough waves dashing against the massive rocks at left. Signed W.T. Bord is inscribed at lower left corner.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; representing a landscape, mounts on either side with a stream in between. Name 'B. Dealie Rogera' is inscribed at bottom right corner.

artworks.title: A Moon Lit Scene
artworks.description: The artwork features a watercolour painting of a serene moonlit scene. A massive hillock serves as the backdrop, with a stream running along the right side of the composition. The country house and surrounding trees are depicted in full bloom, adding to the peaceful atmosphere of the scene. The artist's name, 'S. Nilme', is inscribed at the bottom left corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Representing a View of Cattle
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper, representing a view of cattle gracing in a field under the thick trees. Name and date D. Cox 1837 is inscribed at bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas; a hunting scene is shown. The scene depicts a thick jungle with a rider who is being directed by a man in front, accompanied by a row of hounds in the distance. A signature 'W.Tiares' dated 1873 is inscribed in the center of the bottom of the painting.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; landscape is represented. Signature B. Leslie Rogers is seen at bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas. A hilly landscape represented. Signature James Ply-ton is inscribed at bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Mary Is Standing with the Child in Her Arms
artworks.description: Panel painting: the holy family Mary is standing with the child in her arms, and an old man is left, a woman seated at right, two angels at bottom (copy).

artworks.title: Peasant Life
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas : a young girl is standing with two water carriers and smiling. Signature J . Dorna is inscribed at bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Peasant Life
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas: A farmer girl is seen carrying a bundle of hay. A tank is in the background. Name 'J.Drona'is inscribed at bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Gossips
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene where a man is seated on a box, smoking a pipe and engaging in conversation with a girl standing in front of him. She holds a basket against the backdrop of a boat. The title of the painting, "The Match Maker", along with the artist's name, L. Bothe, is engraved on brass and affixed to the artwork.

artworks.title: Standing Lady Against a Wheel
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas depicts a scene of a young girl standing and leaning against a well or other container, which has been knocked over to her right side. The girl's face is resting on her arm, suggesting a moment of rest or contemplation. The artist's name, J Dorna, is inscribed at the bottom left corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Standing Lady Against a Wheel
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas depicts a young girl standing and leaning against a wheel, with her face resting on her arm. The scene also shows a water carrier that has been toppled over to the right side of the composition. The artist's name, J Dorna, is inscribed at the bottom left corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Two Girls Are Talking with Each Other
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas. A farm scene a man is standing near a gate and looking at two young farm girls who are seen talking with each other, One is having a basket and the other a take, a camel is to the left. Name A. Sebot is inscribed at bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Young Girl
artworks.description: The artwork is an oil painting created on canvas. A young girl is depicted in the scene, seated on a rock with her right hand outstretched. Additionally, a bowl has been toppled to the ground. The artist's name, J. Dorna, is inscribed at the bottom left corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Turkey Bird
artworks.description: Miniature water colour tempera painting of a Turkey, with inscription along the margins and floral designs on border.

artworks.title: Group of Hens and a Cock
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas: a group of 8 hens and a cock are seen, one is at the top of ladder, the other is in a window and remaining all on the ground on hay. 'A. Perhn'.

artworks.title: Two Cranes
artworks.description: The artwork in question is a miniature watercolour tempera painting created on handmade paper. It features two cranes as its central subject. A Persian inscription can be found along the margin of the piece, adding to its cultural and historical significance. The border at the back of the painting showcases intricate floral patterns. One of the cranes is depicted grazing, while the other stands on an oval-shaped oblong base, providing a visually interesting contrast between movement and stillness.

artworks.title: Wall Plaque
artworks.description: Rectangular porcelain wall plaque painted with a crane standing in water and an eagle at top flying to catch it.

artworks.title: Wall Plaque
artworks.description: Painting on porcelain wall plaque representing an eagle flying with a catch (a crane), a landscape with a lake is also painted.

artworks.title: A Beggar ( an Old Man )
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas, a beggar; an old man is holding a tray with a clay incense burner and flower garlands. Sign. Syayeed Digny 1941, at bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Portrait of Nakhshband Band
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas Nakhshband faqir holding a flaming lamp in right hand wearing coat and turban. Signature Syeed Bin Mohammed 1943 at lower right margin.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Man
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas; bust of an old man with spects wearing red turban and belt and a mala in neck. Sign Iftekhar,41 at bottom right. Titled Old guard .

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Watercolour on paper; landscaped; a river is flowing in the foreground. The landscape features green mounds in the background, with trees located on both ends of the river. A bridge can be seen in the distance, and Sign B is visible at the bottom left side. Leslie Rogers is depicted at the bottom left side of the artwork.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Water colour on paper; landscape; with green grass mounds in the background, a dusty road at right and a brook at left. B. Leslie Roger signed at centre of left margin.

metadata.title2: With Green Grass Mounds in the Background

artworks.title: A Dancing Girl in Rhythmic Pose
artworks.description: Water colour on paper. A dancing girl in rhythmic pose wearing only bodies, S.M.S., 6-11-1931 inscribed at the centre of left margin.

artworks.title: A Shepherd Girl
artworks.description: Water color on paper; a shepherd girl is cutting tree leaves, two goats near her feet. Sign at bottom right corner 'A. Moghny'.

artworks.title: Shepherd Girl
artworks.description: Water colour on paper. A shepherd girl is plucking fruits climbing over the point of a cliff. Sign of artist at bottom right 'Amoghny'.

artworks.title: A View of Ooty
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper ,a view of Ooty, landscape with green trees on either side. 'M.E.J. Ooty downs, Furhe loushes' inscribed at bottom.

artworks.title: Peep of the Downs
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper; 'A peep of the Downs' , Ooty, E.Julives 1914 , inscribed at bottom a landscape with mounds and a cart track in front, groves of trees at left.

artworks.title: An Arab Guard
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas; an Arab guard, armed with a dagger, sword and a rifle at his back, wearing black shervani and a silk turban. Bushes and flowers are depicted in the foreground. The artist's signature, 'Farooqui 1945', is located at the centre of the right margin.

artworks.title: Fort Scene
artworks.description: Water colour painting on paper, fort is represented with two cannons at left, grooves of trees at right top. Sign S.H.Askari inscribed at bottom left.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.description: Oil painting on canvas; still life, a vase with a bouquet of flowers placed on a table, roses being prominent, a blue table cover hanging. Sign in red ink at bottom left corner which is not legible.

artworks.title: Mosque and Tomb
artworks.description: Water colour on paper; mosque and a tomb; mosque at left. Palm tree and other trees at the front slope. Sign A.H.Askari. inscribed at left bottom.

artworks.title: An Old Lady
artworks.description: Water colour on paper; an old lady is bent down and sweeping with a broom. Sign 'S.Hodo' is at right lower margin.

artworks.title: An Old Man
artworks.description: Water colour on paper. An old man is seen slightly bent forward holding a staff in right hand and a bag in left. Sign 'S.Hodo' at lower right margin.

artworks.title: A Standing Man Wearing a Straw Hat
artworks.description: Water colour on paper: a man is standing wearing a straw hat, smoking a pipe and laughing. Signature S.Hodo at lower left margin.

artworks.title: Lord Shiva with Ganga
artworks.description: Painting depicting Shiva with Ganga (river) falling on head and rays emanating from his eyes by E.F.Sass Brunner.

artworks.title: Tajmahal
artworks.description: Painting depicting a view of Tajmahal seen through the Branches of Gul-Moher tree E.F.Sass Brunner.

artworks.title: Bamboo Staff Into a Dragon
artworks.description: Painting on silk representing the transformation of a bamboo staff into a dragon - By Tien Lung. Three vertical rows of inscription at the left.

artworks.title: Landscape Painting
artworks.description: Painting on silk of a landscape painting with eight vertical rows of inscription. By Chin Nan.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mohd Safadar Khan Bahadur Ghaur Jung
artworks.description: Potrait of Mohd. Safdar Khan Bahadur Ghaur Jung (1732-1789 A.D) wearing a light yellow colour dress flower designs, a waist band and a dagger .In gilt wood frame signed R.W.Devskar.

artworks.title: Portrait of Md Ali Khan Shuja-ud-dawlah Bahadur
artworks.dimensions: 135.5 L X 102.6 W (WITH FRAME), 98.8 L X 65.9 W (PAINTING ALONE)
artworks.description: The painting depicts Mohd. Ali Khan Bahadur Suja-ud-Dowlah, who ruled from 1807 to 1831 AD. The subject is seated and dressed in floral design clothes tied with a coloured waist band and wears a star on his attire. He also wears a ring on the second finger of his right hand. The painting is framed in gilt wood and signed by R.W.Devskar.

artworks.title: Portrait of Md Ali Khan Shujauddawlah Bahadur
artworks.dimensions: 135.5 L X 102.6 W (With frame), 98.8 L X 65.9 W (Painting alone)
artworks.description: Portrait of Mohd. Ali Khan Bahadur Sujaud Dowlah (1807-1831 A.D) seated and wearing floral design clothes tied with a coloured waist band with star. wearing a ring on the second finger of right hand. In gilt wooden frame signed R.W.Devskar.

artworks.title: Portrait of Nawab Laiq Ali Khan Bahadur (Salar Jung II)
artworks.dimensions: 236.0 L X 145.5 W (With frame), 209.0 L X 118.6 W (Painting alone)
artworks.description: Portrait of Laiq Ali Khan Bahadur, Salar Jung II (1863-1888 A.D), wearing an embroidered state dress, holding papers in his right hand. A ring on small finger. Gloved left hand having a sword. Signed R.W.Devskar.

artworks.title: Potrait of Hyder Yar Khan Bahadur Sher Jung Muneer Mulk I
artworks.dimensions: 133.2 L X 95.3 W (With frame), 108.7 L X 70.7 W (Painting only)
artworks.description: Portrait of Hyder Yar Khan Bahadur Sher Jung Muneer Mulk I, who lived from 1701-1775 A.D., is depicted wearing a white dress with floral designs and a waist band that features a dagger on his left side. The portrait is set in a gilt wooden frame and is signed by Ramakrishna Wamana Deuskar.

artworks.title: Judgement of Paris
artworks.description: Copy of the painting Judgement of Paris by Rubens, in a gilt wood frame. In the painting there are three goddess, like Venus (W/o Vulcan, M/o Cupid) and Hera (W/o Jupiter, the king of gods) and the judge, Paris. Venus holds the title of beautiful goddess and wins the golden apple in the competition.

artworks.title: A Greek Legend
artworks.description: Copy of a painting representing a classical subject where Mars meeting with a goddess probably Venus. Some cherubs her accompanying with them. His vehicle a winged horse is also depicted.

artworks.title: Portrait of Salar Jung I
artworks.description: The painting depicts Turab Ali Khan Bahadur, Sir Salarjung I, wearing an angarkha and a waist band with a sword (Talwar), resting his hand on the Treaty of Barez over a table. In a carved gilt wooden frame, the painting is signed by R.W.Devskar.

metadata.title2: Portrait of Turab Ali Khan Bahadur

artworks.title: Temple Scene
artworks.description: Water colour painting of a temple scene, blossomed tree in the back, fitted in gilt wooden frame. Signed by Kulkarni.

artworks.title: Seascape with a Hill
artworks.description: Water colour painting; seascape with a hill at the left side, in a frame. Signed by G.A.Taylor. Inscribed : March, 1880.

artworks.title: Mir Alam Tank with Mausoleum
artworks.description: Water colour painting; Mir Alam Tank with Mausoleum of Mir Momin and a sailing boat containing two persons are painted, in a frame. Signed by T.Schmibtina.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Jpseph- Francois Marquis Dupleix
artworks.description: Painting of a portrait of Jpseph- Francois Marquis Dupleix in black borders, red coat and wearing white shirt; in a gilt wooden frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: Painting of a portrait of a man, standing, keeping his left hand on the pedestal and in the right hand holding a stick.

artworks.title: Portrait of Lord Clive
artworks.dimensions: 117.7 L X 97.0 W (with frame), 91.0 L X 70.4 W (without frame)
artworks.description: Painting of the portrait of Lord Clive, wearing his usual black bordered coat and white shirt, fitted in a carved frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of Lord Rippon
artworks.description: Painting of the portrait of Lord Rippon holding papers in the left hand and a crossed belt over the shoulder and a prominent beard, fitted in a gilt wooden frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of Lord Dalhousie
artworks.description: Painting of the portrait of Lord Dalhousie dressed in black coat, white prominent cloth over his neck, in a gilt wooden frame.

artworks.title: The Meer Jumla Tank
artworks.description: Water colour painting. The Meer Jumla Tank with people carrying water, in a wooden frame. Signed by T.Schmibtina, 1878.

artworks.title: Spring Season
artworks.description: Water colour painting, fitted in a frame, representing spring season and rivulet passing through the blossomed trees and small hill on the left side. Signed :- K.A.Phatak.

artworks.title: Hussain Sagar Tank
artworks.description: Water colour painting; Hussain Sagar Tank is shown, fitted in a frame. Signed by T.Schmibtina, 1878.

artworks.title: Tombs of Golconda
artworks.description: Water colour painting representing a portion of tombs of Qutub Shahi Sultans in a wooden frame. Signed by T.Schimbtina, 1879.

artworks.title: Part of Saroor Nagar Fort with a Lake
artworks.description: Water colour painting showing part of Saroor nagar fort with a lake in front, in a wooden frame. Signed by T.Schmibtina, 1879.

artworks.title: Sub-urban Landscape
artworks.description: Water colour painting; a sub-urban landscape with terraced boulders and two human figures by the side of it. Fitted in a frame. Signed by T.Schmibtina, 1878.

artworks.title: Landscape of Sub-urban of Hyderabad
artworks.description: Water colour painting representing landscape of sub-urban of Hyderabad, a small temple, boulders, houses etc. are painted, in a wooden frame. Signed by T.Schmibtina, 1879.

artworks.title: Golconda Fort
artworks.description: Water colour painting of Golconda Fort in a frame. Signed by T.Schmibtina, 1878.

artworks.title: Lake with Lotuses
artworks.description: Water colour painting of a lake with lotus flowers, fitted in a decorative gilt wooden frame. Signed by D.Kaibey.

artworks.title: Flower Bunch
artworks.description: Water colour painting of a flower bunch in a blue colour vase, fitted in frame. Signed by T.R.Cowan.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.description: Water colour painting of a flower bunch in a handle and fluted vase with a blue colour plate at the backside. Signed by T.R.Cowan.

artworks.title: Scene from Vizag Agency

artworks.title: Atala Poisoning Herself
artworks.dimensions: 291.5 L X 240.2 W, 231.1 L X 180.8 W (Only paiting)
artworks.description: Atala Poisoning Herself. A heroin character in the novel by Francois Augusto Chateaubriand. It was received with extraordinary enthusiasm in 1801 AD. In fact Orlando Furioso Ariosto wrote a drama in 1516 AD., representing the story of Atala. Atala, the daughter of a white man and a Christianized Indian takes an oath of virginity but subsequently falling in love with Chactas, a young Indian. She poisons herself fearing that she may be tempted to break her oath. In the picture, Atala is taking a poison tablet from old man probably her father who performed the religious formalities. Her lover, bearded one seated at her left side in a cave. The colour effect in the picture is that artificial torch dominates the objects in the cave though there is sun light from outside.

artworks.title: Awakening of Galatea
artworks.description: A wakening of gala-tea painting represents a classical story pigmentation the sculptor of gods. Carved the statue, named it gala-tea and fell in love with it. He is bowing at the feet of statue and praying the Aphrodite, that it may be given life, the prayers are heard and life is gradually coming which is represented by a been of rosy diagonal light. Awakening of Galatea. The painting represents a Greek classical story of Pygmalion, the king and sculptor as well. Once he carved a beautiful statue and fell in love with it. He is bowing at the feet of the figure and praying the goddess, Venus to make it alive. The prayers are heard and life is gradually coming in to the carving, which is represented by a beam of rosy diagonal light. It is said that the sculptor afterwards, married this beautiful woman in one version, reflecting that the power of man to make live of a carved statue.

When the Persian Emperor Darius-III, killed in the battle, the family of the queen requesting Alexander for rescue operation to their family members, which was happened in about 323 BC. In the picture tents, soldiers are also seen in the background. Alexander had considered her request and helped her. Later he proceeded to Indian lands and fought against Pores in 326 BC. This painting is one of the biggest paintings in the Museum collection.

Telling the story in three parts in one painting is called triathlon as seen in this work separating the three scenes with two wooden reapers. He is best known for his role in Napoleonic wars, in which France asserted its dominance over much of Europe in the 19th century AD. artworks.description: Mary Antoinette (2-11-1755 to 16-10-1793) awaiting her judgement. The picture shows Mary Antoinette, the queen of French and wife of Louis XVI. She was the queen consort of France and Navarre during 10-5-1774 ---21-9-1792. Because of the expensive life of the queen and other others including the Emperor, the French nation as a whole, put under revolution. The couple tried to escape from the country but they were caught and put in the home jail by the people. The Emperor was guillotined first along with others who caused the nationÃ¢Â?Â?s inflation by the senate members. And after one month, on the request of the Queen, she was also guillotined by the Jail authorities on 16th Oct. 1793. Several of her statements like Ã¢Â?Â?take cake if bread is not availableÃ¢Â?Â?Ã¢Â?Â?, have become very popular. Painting showing Mary Antoinette awaiting her judgement her hand resting on the chair and a man reading the judgement: for other men Are also seen in the posture. Signed S.C.L.Muller. ( Marie Antoinette (1755-1793 A.D. ), The wife of Louis XVI, was guillotined by French revolutionary tribunal in 1973) .

artworks.title: Akbar and Tansen
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in mughal style signed the right corner bottom of the painting. Display of Deepak Rag. Akbar seated on a royal chair at the bank of river Jamna and a huge crowd of people assembled. Display of Deepak Rag by Tansen standing in the river. Flames coming out from the water and audience astonished at this sight. People in the red fort and on trees are witnessing the scene. Cloud s are in the background. Flower creeper design and in between plain and golden band around tthe painting.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Jahangir and Nurjahan’s stag hunt. Jahangir and Nurjahan with spears galloping their horses towards the deer and five hounds pursuing the deer. Six deers running fast and one of them caught by a hound. Two horses heads and a horseman are seen partly. Building, trees, hillock and sky in the background. Hillock and flower plants in the foreground. A plain golden ban round the painting. flower creeper designs and medallion panels in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Akbar and Jodhabai Hunting the Deer
artworks.description: Framed painting in Mughal style. A hunting scene. Deer standing at the foot of a hill near the bank of a river and two drinking water. Rani Jodhabai holding a bow and arrow in her hands and aiming at the deer. Akbar standing besides her pointing towards deer with his right hand and a bow in his left hand. Two men standing behind them. Four deer at the pond and three drinking water. Trees and hillocks in the foreground. Hills trees and building in the background. A plain golden band around the painting. Leafy patterns at the corners. Flower creeper design with medallion panels in red and gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Akbar with Nauratan Darbar
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Akbar's Nauratan Darbar. Akbar seated on a carpet with pillows on either side and a bolster at his back,holding a huqqa pipe in his left hand and putting his right on his thigh.Trees are seen behind the parapet.Blue band in between plain golden bands round the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of Akbar

Akbar seated on a carpet with pillows on either side and bolster at his back.Two courtiers seated on his right side and one of them reading something.Seven courtiers seated on his left side. A man holding a sword standing at the door. An attendant standing behind Akbar holding a fly-whisk in his right hand and a sword hanging by his right hand and a sword dagger tied up at his waist. A landscape is seen through the window.Black band and between plain yellow bands around the paining.
