artworks.description: A Noble Hussan-Ul-Mulk Ancestors of Salar Jung seated on throne under a canopy. A prince seated in front. An attendant standing behind and another in front. Moon and stars in background. A line on back by Hussan-Ul-Mulk:

artworks.title: A Noble Reclined Close to His Lady
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccan style. Specimen calligraphy behind the painting by Mohd. Muzaffaruddin. Beginning with:Ending on: A noble reclined close to his lady love holding a flower in his right hand. A maid in attendance holding fan in her right hand and a musician playing on guitar before them. Flagons and vases in trays in front. A fountain in the foreground. A coconut tree, a mango tree and building in the background.

artworks.title: Nasiruddula with Maharaja Chandu Lal
artworks.description: Painting representing Nasiruddula seated with a rose in his left hand, Talwar, Bowl and spittoon beside him. Maharaja Chandu lal standing with folded hand in front. Their names written at the top. Cistern and flower plants in the foreground. A specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Check the Title
artworks.description: Painting representing a saintly lady seated under date palm feeding her baby. An angel on one side and a fairy standing on the other side. Dates seen fallen on either side. Fountain in the foreground. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mirza Mohd. Ali.

artworks.title: Miskeen Shah
artworks.description: Painting representing Miskeen Shah nude wrapped with a rack, standing with huqqa in his right hand and a horn under left arm. Flower plants and fish in foreground. Herons and trees in the background. Yellow and red bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Ibrahim.

artworks.title: Miskeen Shah
artworks.description: Painting representing Miskeen Shah nude wrapped tree with flowers on either side. With huqqa in his right hand and a horn under left arm.Golden creeper against blue. Red and yellow bands around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mir Dilawar Ali Danish.

artworks.title: Saint Allah Bakhash Miya
artworks.description: The painting depicts Saint Allah Bakhash Miya sitting in a serene environment, surrounded by trees in both the foreground and background, under a cloudy sky. He is dressed in black and holds a rosary in his hand, adding to the contemplative atmosphere of the scene. Inscriptions are visible on top of the painting, providing additional context or information about the artwork. The back of the painting features a specimen of calligraphy by Abdul Wahab, showcasing another aspect of the artist's skill and craftsmanship.

artworks.title: King Before a Saint
artworks.description: Miniature panting in Deccani style with inscription behind the painting. A saint seated on a carpet and a bolster at his back. Holding huqqa pipe with his right hand and a rosary in his left hand. Candlestick, flower pot and spittoon, dagger and a kerchief before him. Tombs, mosque, trees, peacock and birds in the background.

artworks.title: Lady with Maid
artworks.description: Painting representing a lady seated on throne dressing her hair. A maid standing in front on the terrace holding a tray with wine cup and flask. Cistern and flower beds in foreground, blue background. yellow and red bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Hafiz Mohd.Ali.

artworks.title: King Afzaluddula
artworks.description: Painting representing bust of a king (Afzaluddula) with a sword in left and name written above, Brown, Yellow and blue bands. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: King Nizam Ali Khan with Nobles
artworks.description: A king Nizam Ali Khan seated on a terrace with two nobles in front and an attendant with fly whisk standing behind. Talwar (Sword), shield and spittoon beside him. Cistern and flower plants in foreground. Pavilion in the background. A specimen of calligraphy.

artworks.title: An Englishman Sabit Jung with Attendant
artworks.description: An Englishman Sabit Jung seated on a chair with an attendant holding hat and handkerchief. The scene is set in front of a cistern and flower plants, which are surrounded by an orange colour band. Inscription is visible at the top, while a specimen of calligraphy can be seen on the back.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raja Jai Singh
artworks.description: Painting representing a Raja Jai Singh standing with kerchief in left hand, Talwar and shield hanging by his left, a cloth cover over his beard. Raja Jai Singh is written on top. A specimen of calligraphy by Mohammad Vazir Ali is on the back.

artworks.title: Raja Gurbakhsh Bahadur Riding on Elephant
artworks.description: A prince riding on an elephant holding a goad in his right hand, with armed men in front and behind him, accompanied by a Mahout who is seen on foot. On top of the image, it is written "RAJA GURBAKHSH BAHADUR". This is a specimen of calligraphy by Mir Hassan Ali Atrid Khalam.

artworks.title: Mirza Mohd Ali Riding on Horseback
artworks.description: A nobleman Mirza Mohd. Ali riding on horseback holding up lifted Talwar, four attendants on foot behind, shaded blue background. A specimen of calligraphy on back by Mirza Mohd. Ali.

artworks.title: Vilayat Ali
artworks.description: Painting representing a seated nobleman - Vilayat Ali, with a rose in his right hand and sword, shield, betel box and spittoon placed around. Cistern and flower beds in foreground. Inscriptions on top: and Telugu inscriptions at the bottom. Yellow band around. Specimen on back by Khane Khanan.

artworks.title: Saint Guru Nanak
artworks.description: The painting depicts Guru Nanak standing with an open book. It is surrounded by lotus flowers, which are a common motif in Sikh art and symbolize spiritual growth and enlightenment. The painting features yellow and blue bands around the edges, as well as a red margin, which adds to its vibrant and colorful appearance. A specimen of calligraphy on the back of the painting is attributed to Mohd. Vazir Ali, highlighting the attention to detail and craftsmanship that went into creating this piece of art.

artworks.title: Bulbul Bird
artworks.description: Incomplete painting representing a Nightingale (Bulbul) inscription on top. Persian verses below begin with Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Lady with Maid
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene with a lady standing to the right of the viewer. A maid is shown holding a mirror beside her, adding a sense of intimacy and quiet moment to the scene. In the foreground, a cistern and flower plants are visible, providing a subtle contrast to the more formal atmosphere of the lady and her maid. The painting features a distinctive red and blue band around it, which may serve as a decorative element or a signature mark. On the back of the painting, there is an example of calligraphy, suggesting that the artist or another individual added this detail for aesthetic or symbolic purposes.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicting a lady standing turned towards right holding a flower plant in both the hands. Plain and marbled bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The painting depicts a lady seated with a wine cup in her right hand and a flask in her left. A green cloth piece is tied round her waist and shanks, and she wears a plain and gold sprinkled band around her attire. On the back of the painting, there is a specimen of calligraphy by Abdul Hasan.

artworks.title: Lady with Antelopes
artworks.description: The painting depicts a lady yawning with her hands clasped together. A black buck is positioned on either side of the subject. The background of the painting is blue, while the foreground features floral elements. A plain, brown band encircles the main image. On the back of the painting, there is a calligraphic specimen.

artworks.title: Peacock
artworks.description: Painting represent peacock in profile turned towards right. Plain and sprinkled band around. Calligraphic panel on back.

artworks.title: King
artworks.description: Painting representing a king seated on terrace. Sword and shield placed beside. Swimming ducks and flower beds in foreground. Banana and mango trees and cloudy sky in the background. Cloud and sun pattern border around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Abdullah.

artworks.title: Noble with Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicting a noble seated on terrace with a lady seated in front pouring wine into the cup. Wine cup, flasks, dagger, spittoon etc., placed in front. Cistern and flower beds in foreground. Cypress, date and coconut trees in the background. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mazharullah.

artworks.title: King
artworks.description: The painting depicts a bearded king standing with a Talwar on his right hand, Jamadhar at his waist, and a shield hanging by his left. A golden, plain, and marbled band is visible around the painting. On the back of the painting, there is a specimen of calligraphy written by Mohammad.

artworks.title: King Sultan Abdullah Qutub Shah
artworks.description: Painting depicting a king Sultan Abdullah Qutub Shah standing with Talwar in right hand. Wearing a red colour turban with feathers on it. Odni held across his breast. Plain and marbled band round the painting. Inscriptions on top. Calligraphic exercises on top.

artworks.title: King
artworks.description: The painting depicts a bearded king standing with a fly-whisk in his right hand and a Talwar in his left. The scabbard of the sword is hanging from his left side. On the reverse side, there is an example of calligraphy.

artworks.title: Nobleman
artworks.description: Painting representing a nobleman seated smoking huqqa, a pillow on his lap and sword placed beside. Red and blue band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Khan Zaman.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The painting depicts a lady standing with her left hand on her hip and her right hand uplifted, supporting the odni, while her right foot is relaxed. A heron can be seen in the lower right corner of the painting. The painting features a plain and gold sprinkled band around it. On the back of the painting, there is a specimen of calligraphy.

artworks.title: Man with Lady
artworks.description: The painting depicts a serene scene of a man seated under a mango tree, wearing a conical cap and enjoying huqqa with a lady seated in front of him. In the background, there are hillocks visible, adding to the peaceful atmosphere of the scene. The artist has also included a flower creeper against a brown background, which adds a touch of vibrancy to the painting. On the back of the painting, there is a specimen of calligraphy, providing an additional layer of interest and detail to this already captivating artwork.

artworks.title: Noble with Attendant
artworks.description: Incomplete painting depicting a noble seated on terrace with rose in his left hand. A bowl and spittoon placed in front. An attendant standing behind with fly whisk in left hand and dagger at his waist. Blue and marbled band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Nobleman
artworks.description: The painting depicts a bearded nobleman standing with a falcon on his right hand, holding a kerchief in his left hand and a kattar at his waist. The background of the painting is pink, while the foreground is green, and there is a blue band around it. On the back of the painting, there is an example of calligraphy by Khan Zaman.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: The painting depicts a king Akbar standing with a falcon on his right hand, and a kamar band tied around his waist. The inscription on top is a specimen of calligraphy by Sultan Ali Al Mashhadi. The text being described is the first chapter of the Quran with a Persian translation.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: The painting depicts a fairy seated on a throne, holding a lotus stalk in her right hand. The flower is surrounded by plants on either side, adding to the serene and natural ambiance of the scene. A golden creeper border and gold sprinkled margin add an extra layer of elegance to the artwork. On the back of the painting, there is a specimen of calligraphy that adds a touch of cultural significance to the piece. The painting begins with a sense of tranquility and ends on a note of refinement.

artworks.title: Dancing Ladies
artworks.description: Painting in oval panel depicting two ladies dancing, holding hands of each other. Plain bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Badrul Aman Bukhara. Beginning with: Ending on:

artworks.title: Lady Feeding Pigeons
artworks.description: Painting depicting a lady feeding pigeons of various breed, holding bag in left hand in front of the door. Pigeons have been shown on terrace, in the window, on the wall and in the air. Golden creeper around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Yehya. Beginning with: Ending on:

artworks.title: French Lady
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a French lady standing in a balcony, with her hands positioned across her breasts. She is holding a flask in her right hand and a wine cup in her left hand. The painting features two golden creeper borders and a gold sprinkled margin, adding to its ornate appearance. A specimen of calligraphy can be found on the back of the painting.

artworks.title: Bust of a Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicting the bust of a lady seen at the balcony holding a fruit in left hand. The hair style is a typical one. Golden creeper against blue. Floral designs on golden ground, both surrounded with flower creeper. Margins also with creeper design. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Noble Man Enjoying Huqqa and Music
artworks.description: Painting depicting bearded noble seated on terrace enjoying huqqa and listening to a lady who is playing a guitar seated in front him. Fruit dishes, flower baskets, flask and spittoon placed in front. Cloudy background. Calligraphic panel on back. Beginning with: Ending on:

artworks.title: Farooq Shiyar
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded king Farrukhsiyar standing with a crest in right hand and sword in the left. Plain band around. Inscription on top: at bottom: calligraphic panel on back.

artworks.title: Bearded Man with a Tamed Lion
artworks.description: Drawing representing a bearded man with tamed lion holding a stick with tassel and dagger tied at his waist. Two flower creeper border around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Shah Mahmood

artworks.title: Jahangir
artworks.description: Painting depicting King Jahangir standing with his left hand put on sword, ring in right hand thumb and dagger tied at his waist. Plain bands around. The painting also features an inscription on the top, which adds to its significance. On the back of the painting, there is a specimen of calligraphy that begins with "King Jahangir" and ends with a specific phrase.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a lady standing on a stool, pouring water over her head while holding a cloth in her right hand. The painting is adorned with golden creepers and has a gold sprinkled margin, adding to its aesthetic appeal. A specimen of calligraphy by Mohd. Qasim can be found on the back of the painting.

artworks.title: Mohammad Azam Shah
artworks.description: Painting representing a king Mohd. Azam Shah standing with his hands put on sword and kattar tied at his waist. Golden leaf pattern in background. Golden creepers bands around. Inscriptions on top: Mohd. Azam Shah. Calligraphic panel on back with Persian verses beginning with: ending on:

artworks.title: Man Riding on Tiger
artworks.description: Painting depicting a man riding on tiger, a man standing in front. An other man is seen on the hillock. Red band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Couple with Maid
artworks.description: Painting representing a noble holding bow and arrow seated with his lady lover on his lap offering him wine. A maid standing in front and cat seated beside. Wine cup, flask and betel box placed in front. Bed room and fortress in the background. Plain bands around. Calligraphic panel on back.

artworks.title: Lady with Attendants
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style, with a specimen of calligraphy at the back. A lady seated on a carpet with bolster at her back on the platform, holding a lotus flower in her left hand and touching its petal with her fore-finger. A lotus flower beside her on the carpet. A lady attendant standing behind her with a kerchief in her right hand. A lady seated before her playing on guitar. Flower plants, fountain, cypress trees and clouds in the background. A plain golden band around the painting. Specimen of calligraphy at the back. Persian verses plain band in the between golden and blue color lines around the calligraphy.

artworks.title: Semi-nude Lady Reclined on Throne
artworks.description: Painting depicting a semi-nude lady reclined on Takhat (throne). A maid on right holding the left hand of the lady. Another lady offering her wine. Cistern and flower beds in foreground. Black band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohammad Baqar.

artworks.title: Ladies Enjoying Music and Wine
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style, with the specimen of calligraphy at the back. Ladies enjoying music and wine. A lady seated on carpet with guitar in her hands and a bolster at her back. Another lady seated in front holding a wine cup in her right hand and a flagon in her left with a bolster at her back. Two green pillows beside her. A lady seated either side of them. Flagons , tray , bowls , wine bottle and fruits on a big tray before them. Trees and cloudy sky in the foreground. Parapet , peacock flower plant and fountain in the foreground. Plain golden band around the painting. The specimen of calligraphy at the back. Persian verses in the decorative panels beginning with :Persian couplets in gold Nastaliq.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded king Morad Baksh standing with sword kept on right shoulder, holding fly- whisk in left hand and a dagger at his waist. Green background. Golden creeper bands around. Inscriptions on top: Morad Baksh brother of Aurangzeb. Calligraphic panel on back. Beginning with: Ending on:

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting of a king standing with a rose in his right hand, Talwar in his left and a jamadhar at his waist. Plain and yellow band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Ameer Taimor
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style. Specimen of calligraphy behind the painting by Sharif with green and golden band around. Beginning with: Ending on: A Shepherd behind a white sheep with black spots, holding a stick in his right hand. Flower plants in the foreground. Background green. A golden band around the painting.

metadata.title2: With Black Spots Holding a Stick in His Right Hand

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded noble enjoying huqqa seated on terrace. White foreground and grey background. Plain band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Ahmed Al Husaini. Beginning with Ending on:

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting of lady enjoying fire work standing on the terrace. The black background gives effect of a dark night. Golden creepers around and gold sprinkled in the margin. Specimen of calligraphy on back. Beginning with: Ending on:

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting representing the bust of a king Asaf Jah I at the window with an open box in the right. Green background. Golden creeper against blue around. Colour sprinkled margin. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd.Vazir Ali. Begins with: Ending on:

artworks.title: Saint Ibrahim Adham with Four Fairies
artworks.description: Painting depicting saint Ibrahim Adham seated under a tree near the tank leaning on the Zafar Takya. Four fairies angels standing in front with ewer and fruit dishes. Angels are having two wings each. Tank, trees, and building in the background. Inscriptions on the top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Ali Yehya.

artworks.title: Bust of Noor Jehan
artworks.description: Painting depicting the bust of a lady Noor jehan at the window turn towards right wearing cup with crest and another crest held in the right hand. golden creeper against blue band. Colours sprinkled margin with flower plant pattern. A cypress tree is seen on either side. Green background. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Shad.

artworks.title: Bust of a Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicting the bust of a lady at the window turn towards left wearing turban with crest and another crest held in her left hand and her right put on the parapet wall. A cypress tree on either side. Green background. Golden creeper on blue band in the margin. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Jaffar.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting a frightened princess in the lap of a prince shooting an arrow towards the tiger busy in attacking a male deer. Two horses, swimming ducks, herons and hillocks in the foreground. Building and cloudy sky in the background. Golden creeper against blue specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Zaibunissa
artworks.description: Painting of a lady Zaibunissa seated with hands on the right knee and chin resting on it and eyes being half shut awaiting her lord. Flower basket, mirror, toilet boxes in front. Bed room, trees and sky in the background. Golden creeper against blue band around. Colour sprinkled margin. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Vazir Ali.

artworks.title: King with Nobles
artworks.description: Painting depicting a king taking to a noble standing by his right,while three attendants are seen on either side.Two male dancers and musicians are seen in front. Drummers and trumpeter above the gate in foreground. Golden creeper around and gold sprinkled dark green band. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Muzaffaruddin.

artworks.title: King with Attendants
artworks.description: The painting depicts a king seated in the pavilion of a fort, surrounded by three attendants in front and two behind. There are cross roads and buildings visible between the fortresses, adding to the scene's sense of grandeur and complexity. The painting features a dark green bold sprinkled band and golden creeper around it, which adds an extra layer of visual interest. A specimen of calligraphy is also present on the back of the painting, suggesting that it may have been created with great care and attention to detail.

artworks.title: Noble with Two Ladies
artworks.description: Painting depicting a noble seated in the pavilion with wine cup in his right hand while another cup is being offered by one of the two ladies seated in front. Flower beds and cistern in foreground. Cloudy sky in the background. Golden creeper and gold sprinkled bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Wajhuddin.

artworks.title: Prince with Bride
artworks.description: Painting depicting a prince and his bride both knelt before mother queen in the pavilion. Two maids standing on either side. Gate and trees in foreground. Golden creeper and gold sprinkled bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Abdul Baqa Moorvi.

artworks.title: Bed Room Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting bedroom scene. A prince is seen on bed embraced with the princess leaving his own bed in the moon light. Pavilion in the background. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting of a king Nizam Alikhan Asab Jah II seated on terrace, sword and shield kept beside him. A noble Arastu Jah seated in front with folded hands. Building and trees in background, cistern and flower plants in foreground. Inscriptions on top: golden creeper on blue band around. Calligraphic panel on back. Begins with: Ends on:

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Painting depicting the king of fairy land seated with a lady in a pavilion. A couple is seen in bed wrapped in blanket in another pavilion. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mir Ali.

artworks.title: Lady Bathing Scene
artworks.description: Painting representing a lady bathing seated on Chowki holding; her hair tassel by both her hands while a maid is seen beside the room holding towel. Golden creeper bands around. Gold sprinkled margin. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Muzaffaruddin.

artworks.title: Asavari Raagini
artworks.description: Painting depicting (Asavari Ragini) a semi-nude Jogin playing on veena seated on rock under a tree while two cobras dancing before. Swimming ducks and herons in foreground. Trees, a building and a cloudy sky in background. Golden creeper on blue border. Colors sprinkled margin. Inscriptions on top.

artworks.title: Todi Raagini
artworks.description: Painting depicting (Todi Ragini) a jogin playing on Tambura. Four deers in front and peacocks on trees being enchanted. Swimming ducks and herons in foreground. Trees in the background. Golden creeper on blue border. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Muzaffaruddin.

artworks.title: Todi Raagini
artworks.description: Painting depicting (Todi Ragini) a jogin playing on Tambura. Four deers in front and peacocks on trees being enchanted. Swimming ducks and herons in foreground. Trees in the background. Golden creeper on blue border. Specimen of calligraphy on back by MOhd. Rafi Quraishi. Similar to XIX-26-23 but with slight difference and without border.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting a prince on piebald horse holding spear looking at the elephant with Mahout behind him. Palace, flying birds and cloudy sky in the background. Specimen of calligraphy on back. A seal of Mohd. Raziuddin khan pasted in the margin of calligraphic panel.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting hunting scene. A prince on horse back shot dead and male deer (antelope) by an arrow. Two deer and two rabbits are seen in front. Hillocks in foreground, hillocks, palace and flying birds in background. Calligraphic panel on back. Arabic verses being translated in Persian verses.

artworks.title: Procession Scene
artworks.description: Painting representing a procession scene, featuring men armed on foot, on elephants, and camels. A palanquin carried by men and a chariot are prominently displayed in the foreground of this artwork. The background is shaded with a blue hue, adding depth to the overall composition. The painting is attributed to Mohd. Hussain. On the back of the painting, there is an example of calligraphy by Salik Asfahani.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting of a king Nizam Ali Khan Asaf Jah seated on terrace holding a flower in right hand and sword kept by his left. Noble Arastu Jah seated in front with folded hands. Cistern and flower plants in foreground. Trees and shaded blue background. Golden creeper on blue band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back. Arabic verses translated into Persian verses. Begins with: Ends on:

metadata.title2: King Nizam Ali Khan with Noble Arastu Jah

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting depicting the bust of a king Nasiruddulla at the window, green background. Golden creeper on blue band around. Inscription on top: Calligraphic panel on back. Begins with: Ends on:

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Bust of a king Afzal-ud-Daulah at the window. Green background. Inscriptions on top. Golden creeper on blue background. Specimen of calligraphy on back. Begins with: Ends on:

artworks.title: Ladies offering water to a noble man
artworks.description: The painting depicts a king on horseback drinking water poured by a woman into his hands. Two women are shown accompanying him, carrying water pots on their heads. Birds and monkeys can be seen in the tree nearby. The painting features a golden creeper border. A specimen of calligraphy is visible on the back, attributed to Khan Khanan.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a romantic nature, showing a prince holding a flower in his right hand and placing his left hand on the shoulder of his lady lover. In addition to the main subject, the painting also features a cistern with a fountain in the background, which adds to the serene atmosphere of the garden setting. The artwork includes an example of calligraphy by Mohammad Vazir Ali on its back, showcasing the artist's skill and craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Mohna Raani
artworks.description: Painting depicting a princess Mohna Raani descending from the first floor by the help of the rope. A prince the lover, with his retinue and trees are seen in foreground. Guards are seen above the gate and drummers are and trumpeters on second floor. Golden creeper against blue band. Inscriptions on top: Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mirza Mahammad. Ali.

artworks.title: Nude Sadhu with Prince
artworks.description: Painting depicting a nude Sadhu (Saint) seated under a tree beside a tank, a prince seated in front with folded hands, and devotee standing behind with fly-whisk in right hand. Herons, ducks and lotus flowers in foreground. Flying birds are in the background. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Khan Khanan.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting depicting harnessed horse with mouth open, hind and fore-feet on left side being raised. Flower stalk pattern border around. And flower creeper on three sides. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Zarren Qualam Akbar Shahi. Begins with: Ends on:

artworks.title: Aurangzeb in Seated Palanquin
artworks.description: The painting depicts Aurangzeb in a palanquin with an umbrella (chatar) and an Afib Girl held over his head, seen with his retinue. A young noble is also visible, bent in salute. The background of the painting is grey, and there are additional design elements including an inscription on top and a calligraphy panel on another panel.

artworks.title: Battle Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting a battle scene. A king on horseback with sword in his uplifted right hand attacking another king who is on foot with shield in his left land and sword in his right. A man is seen fallen in foreground with his right hand cut off. Flower creeper and floral bands around. Flower creeper in the margin. Hillocks, trees and birds in background. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting representing an old bearded king Shah Alam II holding a chain in right hand shown in window. Golden flower creeper in the margin. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy by Mohd. Fazle Ali on back. Begins with: Ends on:

artworks.title: Hunting Expedition
artworks.description: Painting depicting hunting expedition. Jogis on top left, a procession in the middle and top right. Below left a king on horseback with men around him. Below right a jogi with bow and a jogin and deer are seen. Flower creeper on three sides. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohd. Ismail.

artworks.title: Princess
artworks.description: The painting depicts a princess wearing a turban with a crest, standing with a guitar in her right hand and supported by her left. The background of the painting features a shaded green foreground, while the outer edge is marked by a plain band around a floral margin. On the back of the painting, there is a calligraphy exercise.

artworks.title: Muraqqa
artworks.description: Painting depicting an old bearded saint with turban like that of a Rohila, Rosary in right hand. Sword, basin and fruit dishes put in front. A garland and flywhisk are seen hanging in arches. Inscription on top. Golden flower creeper in orange band around. Golden flower creeper making ogee panels in margin. On the back of the painting, there is a specimen of calligraphy, showcasing the artistic skill and attention to detail of the artist.

artworks.title: French Man
artworks.description: The painting features a French man sitting on a chair and holding a long smoking pipe in his left hand. The subject is accompanied by another French man wearing white stockings, who is also part of the scene. A dog is seated in front of the main figure, adding to the composition. The use of flower creeper as a border element adds visual interest and texture to the painting. In addition to the main artwork, there is a calligraphic exercise on the back of the piece, suggesting that it may have been created with both artistic and educational purposes in mind.

artworks.title: Bathing Scene
artworks.description: The painting depicts a semi-nude lady sitting in a bath room, seated on a chowki and holding the hair tassel. On either side of her are water pots, adding to the serene atmosphere of the scene. In the margin, there is a beautiful flower pattern that adds an extra layer of aesthetic appeal to the painting. The back of the painting features a specimen of calligraphy by Hafiz Zainul Haq, showcasing his artistic skill and attention to detail.

artworks.title: Semi Nude Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicts a semi-nude lady seated on chowki looking a mirror held by left hand. Flower creeper and leafy borders around. Flower pattern in margin. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Lady with Maid
artworks.description: Painting depicts a lady seated on terrace with pillow on her lap, a wine cup in left hand, flasks in front and a lady seated beside her. A pillow also in the backside of the lady. Flower creeper borders around. Floral designs in margin. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Alamgir Badshah Delhi with Attendants
artworks.description: Painting depicts a bearded king Alamgir Badshah Delhi ( QADEEM old )seated on throne with umbrella reading some book. An attendant standing behind with fly whisk in right hand. Flower bends and cistern in foreground, shaded blue top. Golden, blue and orange bands around. Inscription on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Saint Syed Jalal Bukhari with Nobles
artworks.description: Painting depicts a semi-nude saint Syed Jalal Bukhari seated under a tree beside a lake with utensils in front. Two nobles standing in behind. Hillocks and buildings in background. Yellow and orange bands around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Faruk Khan Iranian Ambassador
artworks.description: Painting depicts a bearded man (Faruk khan Iranian Ambassador) standing putting on a long black cap, dagger tied at his waist and sword by his left. Inscriptions on top. yellow and orange bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Saint Shaik Sayed Abdul Khan
artworks.description: Painting depicts a saint Shaik Sayed Abdul Khan seated in front of tomb holding rosary, book in his lap, another book beside him and foot-wear behind. Flower plants in foreground. Yellow and orange bands around. A tree behind the tomb with a branch coming out of the front. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mir Dilawar Ali Danish.

artworks.title: King Muhammad Shah with Ladies
artworks.description: Painting depicts a bearded king Muhammad Shah on roof terrace holding a crest enjoying music. In the lake are seen Gondola, boatman, lotus and fish. Yellow, and blue and orange bands around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Khan Khanan.

artworks.title: Sufi Bande Nawaz with Nobles
artworks.description: Painting depicts an old bearded Sufi Bande Nawaz seated on throne holding prayer beads in his hands. Two attendants standing at left, one of them holding fly whisk in his right hand. Another bearded man standing at his right. Cistern and flower beds in the foreground. Yellow and black bands around with orange margin. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Tasveer-e-rustam Fighting with Dragon
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene from Persian mythology, specifically the story of Tasveer-E-Rustam attacking a dragon with his sword. The dragon is shown as being entangled in Rustam's horse, suggesting a fierce battle between the two. The painting features vibrant colors, including yellow, blue, and orange bands that adorn its surface. On top of the painting, there are inscriptions that add to its narrative significance. Additionally, the back of the painting showcases a specimen of calligraphy, highlighting the artistic skill of the creator.

artworks.title: Saint Baaba Sharbuddin
artworks.description: Painting depicts a semi-nude saint Baaba Sharbuddin standing with staff in right hand and a tin in left. Lake in foreground. Hillock and building at top right. Golden, blue and orange band around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Noble Sirajul Mulk
artworks.description: Painting depicts a noble Sirajul Mulk seated on terrace with right hand upraised. Flower basket, betel box, spittoon, sword and hand-kerchief is seen in front. Shaded blue background. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back. Begins with:Ends on:

artworks.title: Alamgir Sani
artworks.description: Painting depicts a king Alamgir Sani ( QADEEM old) seated in the balcony holding a crest in right hand witnessing elephant fight. A woman at the entrance with staff in left hand. Inscriptions on top. Yellow and orange bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: King Ashaf Jah I
artworks.description: The painting depicts an old bearded king, Ashaf Jah I, standing with an open book in his right hand and a sword in his left. The scene is surrounded by flower beds at the lower corners of the painting, adding a touch of elegance to the overall composition. Yellow and orange bands are prominently displayed around the edges of the artwork, creating a vibrant and eye-catching effect. Inscriptions can be found on top of the painting, providing additional context or information about the piece. A specimen of calligraphy by Khan Khanan is featured on the back of the painting, showcasing his skill as a calligrapher.

artworks.title: King Nadir Shah
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded Persian king Nadir Shah seated on terrace holding a sword by both the hands. King is in orange color dress with flower pattern designs and on it. Flower beds and cistern in foreground. Shaded blue top. Inscriptions on top. Yellow and orange bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Khan-e-Khanan.

artworks.title: Enjoying Ladies
artworks.description: Painting depicts a lady seated on rock under a tree playing on guitar with snakes on the tree and five deers beside her. The ladies on the left also seated on rock under a tree one of them putting her arm round the others neck. Lake in the foreground. Golden, blue and orange band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: King Bahra Mal
artworks.description: Bust painting of a king Bahra Mal at the window holding crest in his right hand. Flower patterns in foreground. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicts a lady seated on terrace holding a flower in right hand. Flower plants in foreground, blue top. Orange band around. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Nizam Ali Khan with Noble
artworks.description: Painting depicts Nizam Ali Khan seated on terrace with sword and shield put on his left. A noble seated in front with his hands folded. Flower beds on lower corners. Yellow and orange bands around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by S. Hyder Hussain Razvi.

artworks.title: Sikhandar Jah King, Munir-ul-mulk and Chandulaal
artworks.description: Painting depicts Sikhandar Jah (king) seated on terrace with a flower in right hand and sword and shield put by his left. Two nobles (Munir-Ul-Mulk and Chandulaal) seated in front, one of them with folded hands. Flower beds on lower left corners. Yellow and orange band around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Akbar Shah Padshah Sani
artworks.description: Painting of an old bearded king Akbar Shah Padshah Sani seated on chair has been shown at the window. Brown, yellow and orange bands around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back.

artworks.title: Akbar Shah Badshah Sani
artworks.description: Painting depicts an old bearded king Akbar Shah Badshah Sani seated on a chair and an attendant standing behind him on the terrace. Flower beds and cistern in the foreground. Yellow and orange band around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Hussain al-Musawi Khurasani.

artworks.title: King Muhammad Shah with Nobles
artworks.description: Painting depicts a king Muhammad Shah seated on throne holding a crest in right hand, three attendants standing in front and three behind him, all are seen in front on first floor. Two men on either side of the gate are seen on ground floor. Inscriptions on top. Yellow and orange bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mir Dilawar Ali Danish.

artworks.title: Saint Syed Muhammad Shah Agil with Devotee
artworks.description: Painting depicts an old bearded saint Syed Muhammad Shah Agil seated with rosary in right hand. Books, papers, arm-rest, box and book stand around him. A devotee is seen standing behind with a rosary in left hand and a flywhisk in the right. Yellow and orange bands around. Inscriptions on top. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mir Dilawar Ali Danish.

artworks.title: Prince and Princess
artworks.description: Painting depicts a prince and princess seated under a canopy. A maid with fly whisk standing behind. A man with musical instrument seated in front with a man having face like that of a dear seated beside him. Golden creeper border. Golden flower plants in margin.

artworks.title: Saint with Pupil
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Dev Gandhar, a Sadhu seated on lion's hide with rosary in right hand. One pupil is seen in front with wooden plaque, pen and ink-pot. Flower creeper in gold, green and red around. Flower creeper in margin. Arched panel on top.

artworks.title: Semi Nude Woman
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Jogiya Asawari. A semi nude woman seated on ledge of rock playing on pipe. Snakes are seen enchanted by the music. Golden flower creeper around. Flower plants in margin.

artworks.title: Lord Radha Ans Krishna
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of Rag Bhairavi, Radha, and Krishna seated on a bedstead. They are accompanied by two maids, one holding a flywhisk on the right and the other holding a fan on the left. A third maid is seated in front of them with cups and saucers placed before her. The scene is surrounded by a golden flower creeper, and there are additional flower plants located in the margin.

artworks.title: Worshipping Shiva Linga
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Bhairavi, a lady seated before Linga with folded hands. Another lady is seated behind her, holding a lotus in the right hand and a coconut in the left. The painting features diaper designs bordering it in gold and green, as well as a flower stalk pattern in the margin.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Dancing
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of Rag Vasant, dancing Krishna accompanied by three women on either side. One woman is holding a milk pot, while the other two are playing musical instruments. The painting features a linear border and a floral pattern in its margin. An arched panel tops off this beautiful artwork.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Swinging
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of Rag Hindol, a figure of Krishna, swinging while being held by three women on either side. Two of these women are shown playing musical instruments, while the other two hold the ropes of the swing. The scene is surrounded by a golden flower creeper and features flower plants in the margin.

artworks.title: Lady with an Attendant
artworks.description: The painting depicts Rag Patamanjari, a lady seated on a terrace with a bolster in the back and pillows on one side. She is accompanied by a woman seated in front of her, who has a parrot perched on her left hand. The scene is surrounded by a golden creeper and features flower plants in the margin.

artworks.title: Lord Brahma with Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicts Rag Khomaj, Brahma seated under an arch holding written papers in three hands and a spoon in the fourth. A lady is seen seated beside him with folded hands. Utensils and burning fire in foreground. Flower creeper in gold, green and red around. Fish in the margin are seen swimming.

artworks.title: Lady in Forest
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Kamodni, a lady in the forest holding garland in each end. Linear border. Flower stalk pattern in margin. Arched panel on top.

artworks.title: Check the Title
artworks.description: The painting depicts Ragni Vaishag, a scene that captures three men engaging in different physical activities. One of the men is lifting a weight, demonstrating strength and power, while another is moving an Indian club, showcasing agility and coordination. The third man is seen standing on a post with his body upside down, suggesting a display of acrobatic skills or possibly even a form of yoga or meditation. The painting features a distinctive zig-zag border along its edges, adding a decorative element to the artwork. A flower creeper runs along the margin of the painting, adding a touch of natural beauty and elegance to the composition. At the top of the panel is an arched section, which may serve as a frame or a decorative motif.

artworks.title: Seated Lady on Grassy Land
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a woman named Ragni Gaound sitting on the ground, surrounded by natural elements. Ragni is seated on grassy land under the shade of a tree, with her right hand raised and looking back over her shoulder. The background features a stream and rocks, adding to the serene atmosphere of the scene. The artist has used floral motifs to add color and texture to the painting, with a flower creeper in shades of gold and green wrapping around the main subject. A small flower plant is also visible on the margin of the composition.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Pancham, a couple seated. Two maids standing behind, one with fly-whisk and the other with handkerchief. A woman with guitar standing in front. Golden flower creeper around.

artworks.title: War Scene
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of intense action, specifically a Nat-Ragini, or horseman, attacking his opponent with a shield. The horseman is shown to be ready for the chance to strike, while his opponent lies wounded in the foreground with a broken sword and discarded shield. The artwork features a decorative border with leaves and floral designs along the margins, adding an ornate touch to the overall piece. An arched panel can also be seen at the top of the painting.

artworks.title: A Lady Playing on Musical Instrument
artworks.description: The painting depicts the Todi Ragini, a composition that features a lady playing a musical instrument. She is accompanied by an enchanted male deer in front of her and two female deers are seen behind her. The scene is surrounded by a flower creeper in gold and green, with additional flower plants placed in the margin. An arched panel tops off this intricate composition.

artworks.title: Lady
artworks.description: Painting depicts Todi Ragini. A lady seated on chowki in pavilion holding her odni in left hand. A man is seen while an elderly women holding him by his shoulders. Flower creeper in gold, green and red around. Flower plants in margin. An arched panel on top.

artworks.title: Saint
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Megh Malhar, a Sadhu, seated beside a lake on lion's hide holding his tresses in his hands. The background of the painting features human faces seen in the hillock behind him. The scene is further adorned with golden flower creepers and plants along the margin.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Painting depicts Malvi Ragini. A couple going to bed, the man is seen putting his left arm on her shoulder and holding garland in the right hand. Linear border plants in margin.

artworks.title: Check the Title
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Kanada, Rama seated on a ledge of rock with sword in left hand and tusk in the right after cutting elephant's trunk. While two men are seen congratulating him upraised hands. Moon-lit in background. Zig-Zag border. Plants in margin. An arched panel on top.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Dancing
artworks.description: Painting depicts Ragni Malhar, Krishna dancing. Two ladies on either side, one of each side with musical instrument. Flower creeper in gold color and green around. Arched panel on top.

artworks.title: Black Princess (Copy of Ajanta)
artworks.description: Painting depicting two Ajanta black princesses. Signed by Syed Ahmed, Ex-curator Ajanta Caves 1922.

artworks.title: Scene of Ajanta
artworks.description: Painting representing the famous drinking scene of Ajanta signed by Syed Ahmed;1925; wooden frame.

artworks.title: Happy Pair (Copy of Ajanta)
artworks.description: Painting representing happy pair the famous drinking scene of Ajanta signed by Syed Ahmed, 1925.

artworks.title: Conversation (Ajanta Copy)
artworks.description: Painting depicting two standing female figures from Ajanta signed by Syed Ahmed 1922. Wooden frame.

artworks.title: Fly-whisk Bearer (Ajanta Copy)
artworks.description: Painting representing a standing semi nude lady fly-whisk bearer from Ajanta. Signed by Syed Ahmed. A seal affixed at the bottom in a wooden frame.

artworks.title: Mother and Child Before Buddha
artworks.description: Painting depicting adoration group Mother and Child before Buddha, cave no. 17 Ante-chamber wall, left shrine door. Signed by Syed Ahmed 1917. Wooden frame.

artworks.title: PROCESSION SCENE (copy of ajanta)
artworks.description: Painting depicting a horse and an elephant with a rider on the elephant. Signed by Syed Ahmed with seal affixed. Wooden frame. Procession (Ajanta copy), 1919

artworks.title: Two Donkeys Beside a Cart
artworks.description: Painting depicts two donkeys beside a cart with buildings in the distance. Signed by V.G.Nageshkar 1934.

artworks.title: Acrobatic Feats
artworks.description: Painting depicting acrobatic feats by female acrobats. The two male figures - one each on either side providing music on drum, the other on Shehnai. The paraphernalia of the circus party i.e. burning candles, half-rolled rope, bundle of clothes, bust of the bird in the foreground. Urdu inscription:-

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting a hunting scene. Persian verses inscribed on top and bottom.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicting a hunting scene. Persian verses inscribed on top and bottom.

artworks.title: Four Ladies Playing Polo Game
artworks.description: Painting showing four ladies playing polo. Two horses on either side of a ball between the crossed sticks.

artworks.title: King Kobra
artworks.description: Painting depicting a King Cobra coiled with its tongue drawn out and erect hood. Background light brown.

artworks.title: King Kobra
artworks.description: Painting depicting a King Cobra coiled with its tongue drawn out and erect hood. Background light brown.

artworks.title: War Scene
artworks.description: The artwork features a watercolour painting of five figures engaged in war. Two prominent warriors are depicted: one wielding two-handed weapons and backed by two half-clad soldiers, while the other is four-armed and accompanied by a single soldier. Both warriors are rendered in gold, drawing attention to their importance in the scene. In the background of the painting, a temple can be seen, adding context to the battle scene unfolding before it.

artworks.title: War Scene
artworks.description: The watercolour painting depicts a scene of war with five figures prominently featured. Two warriors stand out, one wielding a two-handed weapon and another four-armed warrior, both backed by soldiers who are only half-clad. These figures are rendered in gold. In the background, a temple can be seen, providing a striking contrast to the stark depiction of war in the foreground. The soldiers accompanying the warriors are dressed in scant attire, adding to the sense of urgency and intensity in the scene.

artworks.title: Mysore painting
artworks.description: Water colour painting. A warrior, holding a sword in left hand. His right hand brandishing the spear in the net filled with fish and tortoise. Typical South Indian temple in the background.

artworks.title: Warrior
artworks.description: Water colour painting. A warrior holding a sword in left hand. His right hand brandishing the spear in the net filled with fish and tortoise. Typical South Indian temple in the background.

artworks.title: Subhadra Before Arjuna
artworks.description: Water colour painting. A lady stands before a Rishi (Subhadra before Arjuna in sage's guise). The sage sits on a chair, with a swan-shaped back. The lady is depicted with her hands folded. Vessels are placed at the feet of the sage. Two pillars flank either side of the picture.

artworks.title: Subhadra Before Arjuna
artworks.description: The subject matter of this watercolour painting is a lady standing before a Rishi, specifically Subhadra before Arjuna in the guise of a sage. The sage sits on a chair with a swan-shaped back and the lady is depicted with her hands folded in reverence. In front of the sage's feet are several vessels. The painting also features two pillars that flank the picture, adding to its overall composition.

artworks.title: Sage Pouring Holy Water
artworks.description: Picture depicts a sage pouring holy water into the cupped hands of a warrior. Two horsemen on the left top. Six soldiers standing. Sage in hut. Utensils in the house.

artworks.title: Sage with Warriors
artworks.description: The scene depicted in this picture shows a sage pouring holy water into the cupped hands of a warrior. On either side of the main figures, there are two horsemen visible at the top and six soldiers standing nearby. The sage is situated inside a hut, which provides a sense of setting for the scene. In addition to the people in the picture, various utensils can be seen within the house. A large cylindrical object is visible behind the sage, adding depth and context to the image.

artworks.title: Standing Human Figures
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts four standing human figures and a four-headed, eight-handed deity located in a temple setting. The main figure is a large male warrior who stands before the god, with his right hand raised upwards and his left hand holding a bow. The use of gold as a primary material is evident throughout the sculpture.

artworks.title: Standing Human Figures
artworks.description: The picture depicts four standing human figures and a four-headed, eight-handed deity located in a temple setting. The main figure is a large male warrior who stands before the god, with his right hand raised upwards and his left hand holding a bow. The use of gold color is prominent throughout the image.

artworks.title: King Before Siva
artworks.description: Picture presents two male standing figures in a snake circle, its head at the bottom. A king, with his arms, stands with folded hands before white-bodied, nude, snake ornamented Shiva. Two buildings- one temple, the second residential building on either side of king and God.

artworks.title: King Before Siva
artworks.description: Picture presents temple with two male standing figures in a snake circle, its head at the bottom. A king, with his arms, stands with folded hands before white bodied, nude, snake ornamented Shiva. Two buildings one temple, the second residential building on either side of king and God.

artworks.title: Temple with Shiva-linga
artworks.description: A temple with a decorated Shiva-Linga in it on right center. In middle stands a white bodied Brahman preaching to three animal skin-clad disciples. A tree shades the Brahman and the tree. Temple gold coloured. The Brahman's garments too are gold tinted.

artworks.title: Temple with Devotees
artworks.description: A temple with a decorated Shiva-Linga in it on right center. In middle stands a white bodied Brahman preaching to three animal skin-clad disciples. A tree shades the Brahman and the tree. Temple gold coloured. The Brahman's garments too are gold tinted.

artworks.title: Killing a Snake
artworks.description: The scene depicts a king engaged in battle with a serpent. The snake is positioned upright, its head raised high and its tongue spread out, while its body is painted gold. The king, himself colored gold, retaliates by firing arrows at the snake, striking it directly in the head. Two warriors stand behind the king, providing support as he takes on the serpent. In the background, a temple can be seen located in the top left corner of the scene.

artworks.title: A King Killing a Snake
artworks.description: A king killing a snake. The snake stands high, its head raised, and its tongues spread out. The body gold painted. The king, gold coloured, sends arrows. One in the head of the snake. Two warriors back him. A temple in the top left. Rocks behind the snake.

artworks.title: King in the Temple
artworks.description: Picture shows a temple with male figures in it. Two figures in center, one Raja feeding the elephant that stands on the steps and the other with folded hands behind him. In the right, on top of the elephant on the temple crouched a Saivite. On the left side sits a saint, his legs bound with a band of cloth.

artworks.title: A King in the Temple
artworks.description: Picture shows a temple with male figures in it. Two figures in center, one Raja feeding the elephant that stands on the steps and the other with folded hands behind him. In the right, on top of the elephant on the temple crouched a Saivite. On the left side sits a saint, his legs bound with a band of cloth.

artworks.title: Warrior Shooting Arrows at the Elephant
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a warrior shooting arrows at elephants that are standing on raised rocky ground. The landscape is further enhanced by the presence of flower plants growing on both the rocks and the grounds. In the center of the composition, there is an architectural structure with a row of pillars and steps leading up to it.

artworks.title: A Warrior Killing an Elephant
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a warrior shooting arrows at elephants standing on raised rocky ground. Flower plants are visible on both the rocks and the surrounding ground, adding a touch of natural beauty to the scene. In the center of the composition, there is an architectural structure with a row of pillars and steps leading up to it, suggesting a sense of grandeur and importance.

artworks.title: Temple of Shiva-linga
artworks.description: Picture depicts a decorated Shiva-Linga inside a shrine, gold tinted on the left three figures, a priest, a king with folded hands and his turban. Turban associate stand before the shrine. On the top are represented three men at work in the field. A tall tree on the right shadows the shrine.

artworks.title: Temple of Shivalinga
artworks.description: Picture depicts a decorated Shiva-Linga inside a shrine, gold tinted on the left three figures, a priest, a king with folded hands and his turban. Turban associate stand before the shrine. On the top are represented three men at work in the field. A tall tree on the right shadows the shrine.

artworks.title: Royal Couple Worshipping Goddess
artworks.description: The central figure in this artwork is a goddess, flanked by priests on her right and a royal couple paying their respects on her left. Notably, plantain leaves adorn either side of the painting, adding to its visual appeal. The goddess herself is surrounded by flames, which creates a dramatic effect. The figures' garments are also noteworthy, with gold rims adorning them.

artworks.title: Royal Couple Worshipping Goddess
artworks.description: The central figure depicted in this artwork is a goddess, flanked by priests on her right and a royal couple paying their respects to her left. On either side of the painting, plantain trees are visible, adding a natural element to the scene. The goddess herself is surrounded by flames, which creates a sense of drama and intensity. The figures in the painting wear garments with gold rims, suggesting a high level of luxury and opulence.

artworks.title: Shiva and His Consort Parvathi
artworks.description: Shiva and his consort Parvati sitting on his left crossed let, flanked by two devotees, one on left of Raja and on the left his turbaned associate. Shiva four-armed. Water erupts from the top of the head of Shiva. River farms - fish float in it. Temple in the left center.

artworks.title: Siva, Parvathi and Devotees
artworks.description: Shiva and his consort Parvati sitting on his left crossed leg, flanked by two devotees, one on left of Raja and on the left his turbaned associate. Shiva four armed. Water erupts from the top of the head of Shiva. River farms fish float in it. Temple in the left center.

artworks.title: Raja with His Son and Others
artworks.description: A Raja with his son and an assistant stand before the saint. On right side a temple. Before it stands a ash-smeared, turbaned devotee.

artworks.title: Raja with His Son and Others
artworks.description: A Raja with his son and an assistant stand before the saint. On right side a temple. Before it stands a ash smeared, turbaned devotee.

artworks.title: Yashoda and Balakrishna
artworks.description: On the left side of the scene, Krishna's mother (Yashoda) is depicted in the balcony of her house, looking over her son who is lying on the floor. To the right, a couple is shown standing with their hands stretched upwards. The garments worn by both figures are gold colored.

artworks.title: Yashoda and Balakrishna
artworks.description: The painting depicts two scenes side by side: one shows Krishna's mother, Yashoda, standing in the balcony of her house, looking over her son who is lying on the floor. On the opposite side of the painting, a couple is shown standing with their hands raised upwards. The clothing worn by both figures is gold-colored.

artworks.title: Two Devotees Before Temple
artworks.description: Two devotees, a male and female with folded hands before the two shrines in which are housed Parvati and Shiva-linga. A tree stands between the shrines, shading them. The shrine and garments are gold tinted.

artworks.title: Two Devotees Before Temple
artworks.description: The scene depicts two devotees, a male and female, with their hands folded in reverence before the two shrines that house Parvati and Shiva-linga. A tree stands between the shrines, providing shade for them. The shrine itself and the garments are adorned with a gold tint.

artworks.title: Group of Warriors
artworks.description: The scene depicted on the right side of the artwork shows a group of seven warriors, with five of them being horses. These warriors are separated from the rider on the left by a stream, which is also home to various elements including a warrior, his horse, and his crown that have been painted in the water. In addition to these figures, fish can be seen floating in the river water below. A temple is visible at the top left of the composition.

artworks.title: Group of Warriors
artworks.description: On right represented a group of seven warriors, five are horses, separated from the rider on left by a stream in which are painted a warrior, his horse and his crown. Fish float in the river water. Temple on the top left. The stream starts to the right.

artworks.title: Noble Man Reclining on Bed
artworks.description: A noble man reclining on bed. A woman in right foreground stands touching part of the bed. His counsel stays on the left foreground. One man handles the fly-whisk and the other a Brahman recites verses. Two pillars side the picture on either flank.

artworks.title: Noble Man Reclining on Bed
artworks.description: A noble man reclining on bed. A woman in right foreground stands touching part of the bed. His counsel stays on the left foreground. One man handles the fly-whisk and the other a Brahman recites verses. Two pillars side the picture on either flank. Two posts are either side of the picture.

artworks.title: Man and Women at Work
