Wooden frame with eight beaded panels, eight ivory & shell inlaid panels and the rest of the frame is also decorated with shell and ivory inlaid flower and geometrical designs.

artworks.title: Lost in Thought
artworks.description: Framed Chuqtai sketch. Lady seated on a platform holding a book in her right hand and a rosary in her left in a meditative mood. A flagon, book and a table cloth are placed on the table. A plain golden band around the painting. Stained marble design margin.

artworks.title: Lady and the Deer
artworks.description: The framed painting depicts a scene with a woman holding a string of three deer in her hands, standing upright. She is surrounded by plants in the foreground and a desert landscape with clouds in the background. A plain light yellow band encircles the entire painting.

artworks.title: Lady
artworks.description: Framed Chuqtai sketch. A lady holding a peacock feather in her right hand and holding her cloak with her left hand.

artworks.title: Peacock
artworks.description: Framed Chuqtai painting. A peacock seated on a tree. TajMahal is seen in the background. The background represents moon light effect. A plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in red, white, green against stained marble margin.

artworks.title: Dancing Girl
artworks.description: Painting on canvas representing a dancing girl in red shaded dress, a woman at her left, both seated and holding tambourine. Signed at lower left corner: A.Duval. Wooden frame with eight beaded panels and eight shell inlaid panels bearing an Arabic inscription. WOMAN AT RIGHT SIDE FOLDED HER LEFT LEG.

artworks.title: Lady Lighting Lamp
artworks.description: Framed Chuqtai painting. A lady holding a burning lamp in her left hand and supporting her left hand with her right, above the candle stick. A plain golden band round the painting. Flower plants in red, light green and grey against stained marble margin.

metadata.title2: A Lady Holding a Burning Lamp

artworks.title: Lady Beside a Grave
artworks.description: Framed Chuqtai painting with inscription on the decorative panel on grave. A wailing of a beloved at the death of her lover. A lady seated beside a grave in a sorrowful mood putting her head down and holding her hairs with her hands. Another lady standing before her, stretching her hands bending her neck in lamentation. Flower petals scattered before the seated lady. A candlestick and flagon placed beside the grave. plain golden band around the painting. floral patterns in red,white, light green and Gray against stained marble margin.

artworks.title: Flower Plants and Butterflies
artworks.description: Painting on canvas surfaced paper in gold polished wooden frame with glass representing flower plants and butterflies. Signed at lower right : V.Bhushan/51.

artworks.title: A Girl
artworks.description: A girl seated feeding a lamb under her right arm. A stick is seen in front. Signed at the lower right : M.G.Sampath, 1936.

artworks.title: A Blue Cockerel
artworks.dimensions: 23.8 L X 17.7 W (Painting), 37.9 L X 27.9 W (WITH FRAME)
artworks.description: Painting in wooden frame with glass depicting a blue cockerel. Signed at the lower right in Hindi: Kumaril.

artworks.title: Cockerel
artworks.dimensions: 23.8 L X 17.7 W (Painting), 37.9 L X 27.9 W (With frame)
artworks.description: Painting in wooden frame with glass depicting a blue cockerel.Signed at the lower right in Hindi: Kumaril.

artworks.title: Noor Jahan Seated on a Chair
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory in Mughal style. Noor Jahan seated on a chair with two flowers in her left hand and huqqa pipe in her right. A landscape with a fort is seen behind the parapet.

artworks.title: Jahangir Seated on a Chair
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory in Mughal style. Jahangir is seated on a chair, holding a wine cup in his left hand and a necklace with a heart-shaped pendant featuring the bust of Noor Jahan in his right hand.

artworks.title: Jaswanth Singh Holding a Sword
artworks.description: Framed painting in Mughal style. Jaswanth Singh holding a sword with his hands in a standing position. A kattar tied up at his waist. Background light green. Flower creeper designs in between plain golden bands around the painting. Margin red.

artworks.title: Mumtaz Mahal Seated on Chair
artworks.description: The subject of this miniature painting is Mumtaz Mahal, depicted in Mughal style. Mumtaz Mahal is seated on a chair and wearing a crown with a crest, symbolizing her royal status. She holds a rose in her right hand, which may represent love or beauty. The background of the painting features a landscape seen behind a parapet, adding depth to the composition. The chair's hands rest on lions on either side, which are often used as symbols of power and strength in Mughal art.

artworks.title: Three Princes Dara, Shuja, Aurangzeb Riding on Horses
artworks.description: Framed painting in Mughal style. Three princes Dara, Shuja, Aurangzeb riding on horses holding the reins and spears in their hands. Swords hanging at their sides. Grassy land in the foreground. Trees,Hillock and clouds in the background. A plain golden band around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Shah Jahan Seated on a Chair
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory slab in Mughal style Shah Jahan seated on chair holding a dagger in his right hand and a bejeweled crest in his left hand. Landscape is seen through the arch. Seat rests on two lions in the front. Seat rests on two lions in the front.

artworks.title: Akbar with His Christian Wife
artworks.description: Framed painting in Mughal style with inscription on top and bottom. Persian verse on top : Inscription at bottom: In oval panel Akbar seated with his Christian wife Mary holding a huqqa pipe in his right hand and putting his left on her shoulder, Mary holding flowers in her right hand and holding her husband's hand with her left. A bolster at his back. A landscape is seen behind the parapet. Flower creeper design around the painting. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Rani Jodha Bai Seated on Chair
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory slab in Raj-put style. Rani Jodha Bai seated on chair with two flowers in her left hand, a fan in her right hand and putting her left foot on chair. Buildings, hills and rivers are seen through the arch.

artworks.title: Akbar Seated on Throne
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory slab in Rajput style. Akbar is depicted seated on a throne, holding a dagger with a lion head-shaped handle in his left hand and a falcon perched on his right hand. In the background, hills and a river are visible through an arch.

artworks.title: Standing Princess
artworks.description: Painting showing a Princess standing holding an open book in her right hand. Green background with decorative panel at the top. Flower creeper design border around.

artworks.title: Bust of a Woman
artworks.description: Painting showing the bust figure of a woman holding a ring in each hand, flower design band around the image.

artworks.title: Two Ladies in Swinging Pose
artworks.description: Painting in two ladies swinging while four others standing aside. Building visible at the upper right.

artworks.title: A Seated Princess
artworks.description: a princess seated in a pavilion with bolster at her back. Flask wine cups, fruit dishes and spittoon are seen in front of her. Steps and flower beds in the foreground sun-set effect at the top, blue band with golden leafy design around. Flower plants in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Bathing Scene
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a lady taking a bath beside a temple. A prince is shown riding horseback and peeping from behind a tree while two ladies are shielding her with an object referred to as "odni" which can be interpreted as a curtain or screen. The margin of the painting features flower stalks in various colors, including gold, green, pink, and orange.

metadata.title2: A Lady Taking Bath Beside a Temple

artworks.title: Standing Princess
artworks.description: Miniature painting showing a Princess standing in chowki after bath wrapped in a maid is wiping out the water at her foot and the other maid is seen holding her dress standing behind. Ewer, vase etc., are seen on the floor. Dark blue color sprinkled band around.

artworks.title: Standing Two Maidens
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style. Two maidens standing close with their arms around their neck and one of them holding a flagon in her right hand and a cup in her left hand.

artworks.title: Wedding Reception
artworks.description: Miniature painting in oval panel in Kangra style. Wedding Reception :- A bride guided by an old woman standing at the door of a room. A lady holding a lantern in her right hand receiving them. A light red rope like band around the painting. Floral pattern in between flower creeper at the corners of the painting.

metadata.title2: Bride Guided by an Old Woman Standing at the Door of a Room

artworks.title: Seated Princess
artworks.description: Painting a Princess seated on terrace with a woman putting his right hand on her shoulder and holding her with left hand and while the right foot of the woman rests on the floor. The old woman on floor with her hands on the bed. Fruit dishes in front of them. Flower stalks on either side of the step.

artworks.title: Prince and Princess
artworks.description: Miniature painting showing a Prince holding the hand of a woman brought by an elderly woman, seated on the terrace under the canopy. Candle stick and fruit dishes in the foreground.

artworks.title: Bathing Scene
artworks.description: The painting depicts nine ladies bathing in a tank. The other four women are shown in the background, with one smoking, another putting on trousers, a third simply standing, and the fourth dressing her hair. Trees and hillocks can be seen in the background of the scene. A yellow band is visible around the painting.

artworks.title: Laila and Majnun
artworks.description: Prince Majnun was seated under a tree beside a pond. Laila was seen seated before him, accompanied by three maids who stood behind her, one of them saluting. In the background, various animals could be seen, including deer, lions, ducks, and storks, with a golden band visible.

artworks.title: Prince on Horse Back
artworks.description: Prince on a horse back. Two attendants at the back and two in the front. Building , hillocks, trees and river are shown in the background.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Hunting scene: A king on horse back having sword in his right and attacking a deer. Two attendants, one standing in front and other at the back. A Prince on horse back having falcon in his right hand and two attendants in the background. Trees and hillocks are in the foreground.

artworks.title: Akbar Riding on Horse
artworks.description: Painting showing Akbar riding on white horse with a falcon on his right hand with a dagger at his waist. An attendant holding fly-whisk shown behind him. Another person with a bow, arrow and a falcon holding in his right hand shown standing in front of him with a dog. Hillocks, birds and trees are in the background.

artworks.title: Winged Fairy
artworks.description: A winged fairy has been shown riding on a white horse. Another winged fairy is seen holding a fly-whisk behind her, while the blue demon guides her. Hillocks and trees are depicted in the background, with a lotus pond visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Dhanasari Ragini
artworks.description: Painting representing a princess engaged in painting seated on terrace under a canopy with bolster at the back. Two maids, one seated in front and the other standing with fly-whisk behind her. Painted by Anup. " Dhanasari " in Hindi inscribed at the top.

artworks.title: Dhanasari Ragini
artworks.description: Painting representing a princess engaged in painting seated on terrace under a canopy with bolster at the back. Two maids, one seated in front and the other standing with fly whisk behind her.Painted by Anup. " Dhanasari " in Hindi inscribed at the top.

artworks.title: Standing Lady
artworks.description: Representing a lady standing under a tree resting her arm and head on the tree trunk, golden creeper border on red, yellowish bands around, gold sprinkle margin.

metadata.title2: A Lady Under a Tree Resting Her Arm

artworks.title: Prince Riding on Elephant Assisting His Lady
artworks.description: Showings a Prince riding on an elephant assisting his lady love to climb down from the terrace to the back of the elephant. An old woman is helping her from behind. Canopy, trees and cloudy sky are in the background.

artworks.title: A Himalayan Goat Standing on a Hillock
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A Himalayan goat standing on a hillock. Light green background. A plain golden band round the painting.

artworks.title: Seated Prince
artworks.description: a prince seated on the terrace holding a rose in his right hand. An attendant standing at the back holding a fly-whisk in his hand. A young man with guitar seated in front. Fruit dishes, kattar and pillows etc., lying around. Gold sprinkled greyish black band making an arch around. Gold sprinkled margin.

metadata.title2: A Young Man with Guitar Seated in Front of a Prince

artworks.title: Portrait of Zulaikha
artworks.description: Zulaikha seated on throne under a canopy and an attendant standing behind her with morchal, other 7 ladies seated in front of her under the canopy holding a fruit and knife in their hands looking towards Yousuf. Golden creeper boarded and margin.

artworks.title: Seated Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting of a noble seated on carpet holding huqqa pipe in his left hand and a pillow under his right arm. A kattar tied up at his waist. Another noble seated at his right holding a flower in his left hand and two pillows beside him. A prince, too seated on the carpet. Two princes seated at the left. An attendant standing with a fly-whisk in his left hand. Four ladies seated before of them , two playing on their musical instruments. Parapet and the sky in the background. At the back of the painting:- A party enjoying music and wine. An old bearded noble seated on the terrace of the palace and a youth offering wine to him. Attendant on either side standing behind them. Two men seated behind the noble, one is playing on guitar and other on his pipe. A man seated before looking behind, putting his right hand on his knee and the left on thigh. Two men seated beside the youth, one is enjoying wine and the other looking towards back. An attendant holding a flagon in his left hand standing behind. Three attendants serving wine and food in the foreground.

metadata.title2: A Party Enjoying Music and Wine

artworks.title: Seated Princess and Prince
artworks.description: Painting showing a semi-nude Princess lying on bed resting her right elbow on a bolster and the left hand putting on the shoulder and of the Prince who is sitting below on a carpet. The Prince spread his foot on the floor taking bolster in his lap holding huqqa pipe in his right hand and taking wine cup from woman seated in front, a maid seated behind near the feet of the Princess. Golden flower creeper band against a dark blue surface around.

artworks.title: Mulla Dupiyaza Riding on a Lanky Horse
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Mulla Dupiyaza riding on a lanky horse, holding the reins in his right hand. A dog barking at the horse seated on the ground.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man with Lion
artworks.description: Painting showing a bearded man holding a staff in his right hand with a dagger at his waist holding the chain tied around the neck of the lion. Buildings and trees in either side. Grey band around.

artworks.title: Jahangir with Antelope
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Jahangir holding the string tied up with the bridle of an antelope by his right hand. Bending forward proceeding before the antelope. Foreground is green. Middle yellowish and top sky blue. Plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in the margin.

artworks.title: Rustum Wearing a Tiger Head Helmet
artworks.description: Rustum wearing a tiger head helmet taming the lion. Green color foreground, shaded blue at top with inscription " RUSTUM " .

artworks.title: Prince Azam in Armour
artworks.description: In Mughal style with inscription on top. Prince Azam in Armour riding on horse holding a spear in his right hand and the reins in his left, kattar tied up at his waist. A sword hanging at his left side and a bow and quiver at his right. Flower plants in the foreground.

artworks.title: Sufi 'Hazrat Khaja Nasir Ali Sahib, Alampur'
artworks.description: A Sufi seated with bolster at the back, holding a rosary in his right hand, a stick and a handkerchief beside him. The background of the image is green, with a golden band and flower stalk along the margin. An inscription at the top reads "Hazrat Khaja Nasir Ali Sahib Alampur".

artworks.title: Fighting Two Camels
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Camel fight :- Camels in fight going to bite the leg of one another. Flower creeper on light blue background. Golden lines around the painting.

artworks.title: An Elephant Has Dragged Down a Horseman
artworks.description: An elephant has dragged down a horseman and pierced his neck with its tusk while the mahout is seen crashing down the goad with uplifted hands. Persian couplets on either side. Beginning with: Blue band with golden creeper ground.

artworks.title: Infuriated Elephant
artworks.description: Scene of an infuriated elephant being subdued.

artworks.title: Enraged Elephant with Six Men
artworks.description: Painting showing enraged elephant with six men, one of them being with goad, another elephant is seen in front of it. Four men are seen with fire sticks trying to control the elephant. With inscription:- Marble band with golden floral and leafy margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A lady enjoying with huqqa and music, reclined on a carpet with bolster at her back holding huqqa pipe in her right hand and resting her left elbow on a pillow. A lady attendant holding a fan in her right hand and a kerchief in the left standing behind her playing on guitar. A covered flagon placed on a tea-poy at her back. Tree and grassy land in the background. Creeper design bands on top and bottom. Golden decorative panel on top and bottom. Creeper in between plain golden lines in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Bust of 'Nawab Nasiruddin Hyder'
artworks.description: Painting of bust figure of Nasiruddin Hyder King of Lucknow in decorative oval shape panel. Yellow and blue around with orange margin. " Nawab Nasiruddin Hyder " inscribed over the top.

artworks.title: A King Seated on a Golden Chair (Zahiruddin Baber)
artworks.description: A king seated on a golden chair (Zahiruddin Baber) holding a book in his hands. Blue background.

metadata.title2: Holding a Book in His Hands

artworks.title: Portrait of King Zahiruddin Baber
artworks.description: Miniature painted to represents a king Zahiruddin Baber seated on a golden chair, holding abook in his hands. Blue background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Nobel Man
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style with the specimen of calligraphy at the back. An old bearded noble, supposed to be Shah Jahan, holding a fly-whisk in his left hand and a sword in his right. A dagger tied up at his waist. Gold sprinkled border in between plain golden bands. An exercise of calligraphy at the back by Faqir Mohammad.

artworks.title: Seated Rishi / Saint
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Deccani style. A Rishi seated on the ground tied up a patka round his legs and back and holding it with his right hand in meditation. A cat seated before him. Plain golden band round the painting in marbelling.

artworks.title: Seated Princess
artworks.description: Showing a princess seated on a throne in yawning position with bolster at her back. A maid standing behind her holding fly-whisk in her right hand , white foreground and blue background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: Painting showing a semi-nude Princess seated with bolster at the back tying a turban around her head. Two maids seated in front, one enjoying huqqa and the other holding a mirror. Gold sprinkled border and margin. " Kaharva Hotahay " written on the top in Hindi.

artworks.title: Seated Bearded Man
artworks.description: A bearded man seated on a edge of a rock with a dagger at his waist, a girl in his lap playing with the bird on his right hand.

artworks.title: Portrait of Emperor Akbar
artworks.description: Miniature painted to represents, a king (Emperor Akbar) seated on a carpet under a tree holding a falcon in his right hand, dagger at his waist. One attendant with fly-whisk standing on his right side and four attendants on his left. Twelve attendants enjoying in the foreground. Trees and hillocks are in the background.

artworks.title: Dancing Woman
artworks.description: Painting in lady seated on a bedstead with canopy with hands, uplift as yawing , a woman seated beside is offering betel.

artworks.title: Bathing Scene
artworks.description: Painting showing a woman standing on a small chowki holding her hair with both hands. Cranes and water pot on either side. Three cranes in flight at the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Seated King and Queen
artworks.description: Painting showing and old king and queen seated close to each other. Huqqa and ewer are seen in front. Blue border with creeper designs.

artworks.title: Semi-nude Yogini
artworks.dimensions: 34.3 L X 19 W, 23.0 L X 17.0 W, 18.0 L X 12.6 W centimeter
artworks.description: The painting depicts a semi-nude Yogini seated on the floor. She is holding a rosary in her right hand and a trishool in her left hand. In front of her are fruit dishes, and behind her stands a temple surrounded by trees. The painting features magenta pink and white bands around its edges, with gold sprinkled along the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Lady
artworks.description: Miniature painting showing a seated lady with bolsters at her back, holding a book in her left hand. The painting also features a goblet and wine cup in the foreground. A golden band surrounds the painting, and gold is sprinkled throughout the margin. An inscription can be found on a panel located at the top of the painting.

artworks.title: Emperor Jehangir Seated on Throne
artworks.description: Emperor Jahangir seated on throne with chatter, with his hand on the dagger at his waist. Green background and cloudy top. Black band around with golden creeper designs. Inscription Hindi " Padshah Jahangir ".

artworks.title: Portrait of Padshah Jahangir
artworks.description: The miniature painting depicts the king Emperor Jahangir seated on a throne with a chatter, with his hand resting on the dagger at his waist. The background of the painting is green and features cloudy skies. A black band encircles the image, adorned with intricate golden creeper designs. The inscription in Hindi reads "Padshah Jahangir", indicating that the subject of the painting is indeed Emperor Jahangir.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Prince
artworks.description: Portrait of a Prince standing having parrot in his left hand and stalk in his right hand , dagger at his waist. Plain sea green background. Floral design bands around it.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: The miniature painting is of the Indo-Persian style, depicting a noble figure. The noble is shown holding a book in his left hand and a staff in his right hand while standing. In the foreground, grass is visible, adding a natural element to the scene. A decorative band surrounds the painting, adding an ornate touch. A plain golden band borders the margin of the painting, providing a subtle frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of Christ
artworks.dimensions: 16.2 L X 11.3 W (Siyah), 10.6 L X 6.8 (Water) centimeter
artworks.description: Two paintings , one representing the dead body, Christ being laid in the coffin with men and women around and the other bust portrait of a lady with bolster at back holding a flower stalk in her right hand and a nosegay in her left. Flower creeper in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.dimensions: 33.6 L X 23.6 W, 20.7 L X 17.0 W, 14.2 L X 12.4 W centimeter
artworks.description: Painting representing Kabirdas weaving in front of his cottage. A young man is seen seated looking on. Two plain bands around with gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Shah Jahan
artworks.description: A Persian Rubai in Nastaliq transcribed by Abur Rashid. The work depicts a "Portrait of Shah Jahan". The Emperor is shown seated on a throne. Only his bust is visible. In the portrait, the emperor is inset in an oval shape surrounded by trees and a stream.

artworks.title: Portrait of Shahjahan
artworks.description: A Persian Rubai in Nastaliq transcribed by Abur Rashid. Reverse: - Portrait of ShahJahan. The Emperor is shown seated on a thrown. Only bust is visible. Inset in oval surrounded by trees, streametc.,

artworks.title: Portrait of King
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A king seated on chair holding a spear in his right hand and having a dagger at his waist. A man in front reading over a paper. Two servants standing behind, one of them holding Maratib. Dark black background. Flower creeper design in gold on blue band around the painting. The man reading the book slants forward above the waist. Floral border around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of Hussaini Begum Wife of King Hyder
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscriptions at the top in the margin. Portrait of Hussaini Begum wife of king Hyder, seated on a carpet with bolster at back and pillow beside her left side holding a flower in her left hand and putting her right hand on her ankle. Background light green. Golden creeper design in between the plain golden bands around the painting. Floral pattern designs in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Abdur Rahim Khane Khana
artworks.description: Portrait of Abdur Rahim Khane Khana son of Bairam Khan dressed in white with a jambia (kattar) tied up in his waist leaning on a staff in standing position against dark green background. Leafy design border around the painting, gold sprinkled in margin.Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscriptions towards left at the bottom.

artworks.title: Noble Man Wearing a Blue Turban
artworks.description: The painting depicts a noble man wearing a blue turban and a white Angarkha. He is seen holding a sword hanging from his left side and a dagger at his waist, standing in the scene. The background of the painting is dark green, with Persian verses written between golden panels that adorn the edges. A golden floral design borders the margin of the artwork.

artworks.title: Painting of Prince
artworks.description: Painting of prince with halo wearing golden turban, gold border angerkha and necklaces in standing position. Sword and shield hanging by his right and flower in his left hand. Shaded blue background with grassy foreground. Golden creeper border against dark blue background. Gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Jahangir and Shaik Saleem Chishti
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A prince seated before a dervish (Jahangir and Shaik Saleem Chishti) A dervish seated under a tree holding a book in his left hand. Books, ink pot and pen placed in front. A cat seated beside the prince. Buildings on the back of the river in the background. Creeper design band with decorative panel around the painting. Floral pattern in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The miniature painting is done in the modern Mughal style. A lady is seated beside a pillar with a bolster at the back, holding roses in her left hand and a huqqa pipe in her right. The painting features a creeper design on a blue band around it, while the margin has a flower creeper design in gold.

artworks.title: A Noble Wearing a Jama
artworks.description: A noble wearing a Jama standing stooping over a staff. The color scheme of the two paintings differ. (Same as No. 48/XXXI)

artworks.title: Painting of Prince
artworks.description: Painting of prince with halo wearing golden turban, gold border angerkha and necklaces in standing position. Sword and shield hanging by his right and flower in his left hand. Shaded blue background with grassy foreground. Golden creeper border against dark blue background. Gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Nobleman
artworks.description: Painting of nobleman wearing white with golden stripes turban and angarkha matching in a standing position reading a scroll supported by both his hands. Greenish background. Persian verses in between golden panels around the painting. Golden floral designs margin.

artworks.title: Leaf from Akbar Nama
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription at top. Leaf from Akbar Nama. Display of a wrestling match, camel and elephant fights etc., and other festivities of a royal wedding. Tree and rocks in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in gold and blue in margin.

artworks.title: Bust of Princess
artworks.dimensions: 11.6 L X 8.6 W, 19.0 L X 14.3 W, 32.5 L X 21.4 W centimeter
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in late Mughal style. A bust of princess in oval panel with crescent. Wearing a cap on her head holding a wine cup in her right hand and flagon in her left.Golden creeper design around the painting. Flower creeper design on light blue band and flower creeper design on plain golden band around the painting. Floral pattern in red and green color in golden margin.

artworks.title: Nadir
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajput style. A king (Nadir) seated on a royal chair with his right hand on the dagger. Noble men standing on both his sides. Background green, foreground reddi

artworks.title: Out Door Feasting Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting of an outdoor feasting scene depicting a prince with courtiers partaking of food and wine with musicians in the foreground.Persian verses on top and bottom.

artworks.title: A Seated Old Man Presumably Moulana Roumi
artworks.description: Portrait of a seated old man presumably Moulana Roumi with Persian verses around the margin.

artworks.title: Madonna with Child
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Madonna seated on carpet with her child standing in her lap. A book lying at her right. Books and vases behind her. Stained marble design border on top and bottom. Grey color band in between decorative red bands in the margin.

artworks.title: Akbar with Two Nobles
artworks.description: Miniature painted to represents the king (Akbar) standing with two nobles in front. King wearing red turban, pink angarakha with golden flowers. A falcon perched on his right hand. The noble is seen holding its string, green background, golden creeper on red band around. Golden floral designs margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Painting depicting a bearded noble wearing white turban with blue and golden border and yellow angarakha with golden leafy designs, and maroon color shawl, holding a sword with hands and another sword hanging by his left in a standing position. Green background with three golden creeper borders on red, green and grey bands around. Golden floral designs margin.

artworks.title: Jahangir and Noorjahan
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription on top and bottom and on either side of the painting. Persian verses in decorative panel on top and bottom. Inscription at top and bottom: Persian verses in decorative panels on either side of the painting from Sadi's Boston. Beginning with:Ending on: A lady (Noorjahan) standing before Jahangir, holding a lid in her right hand and a tray with a cup in her left hand. Jahangir putting his right hand on the cup and holding a sword in his left hand, standing in a happy mood. Flower plant and sky in the background. Flower plant in the foreground. Stained marble design border around the painting. Flower plants in various colors in the decorative oval panels in between creeper design in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated King
artworks.description: Miniature painting in late Mughal style with inscription at the bottom. A king seated on the throne with bolster at his back. A man holding fly-whisk in his hand in standing position at back, another man beside him. Two men towards his right, one of them being English-man. Trees behind the parapet, clouds at the top. Flower creeper design around the painting.

artworks.title: Akbar with Noble Man
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription on top and bottom and on either side of the painting. Persian verses on decorative panel on top and bottom. Inscription on the top of the painting. Persian verses in the decorative panel on either side of the painting. Beginning with: Ending on: Shikar by Bahri. A noble holding a duck in his hands standing before Akbar. Akbar too standing with a falcon on his waist. A duck lying on the ground. Stained marble bands around the painting. Flower plants are in the various colors in the decorative oval panels in between creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Two Ladies Burning a Sparkler
artworks.dimensions: 33.7 L X 16.0 W, 24.5 L X 14.2 W, 21.0 L X 11.0 W centimeter
artworks.description: Two ladies standing in front of a door, one of them burning a sparkler with her left hand and right arm around the others neck. Golden creeper border on dark blue band around. Gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Sikh Commander on Horse Back
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajput style. A Sikh commander on horse back holding the reins in his right hand and putting his left hand on the swords handle which is hanging by his left. A shield at his back. A youth holding a sword in his right hand standing behind him. Two armed Sikhs in front, one of them holding a spear in his right hand with a shield at his back and a sword hanging by his left and the other carrying a gun on his shoulder supporting with his right hand with a shield at his back and putting his left hand on the swords handles which is hanging by his left. Cloudy sky in the background. Grassy land and plants in the foreground. Blue band around the painting.

artworks.title: Soldiers Having Drunk Bhang
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Deccani style. Soldiers having drunk bung have lost their senses, various utensils lying here and there.Mice and snake also drinking bung. A cat with a rat is seen in the middle. A blue band in between yellow bands around the painting. Red margin.

metadata.title2: Various Utensils Lying Here and There

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A noble riding on horse holding the spear in his right hand and the reins in his left. A sword hanging at his left. A kattar tied up at his waist and a bow and quiver hanging at his right. A panther attacking an antelope in the foreground. The top is cloudy.

artworks.title: Fighting of Elephants
artworks.dimensions: 12.5 L X 17.5 W, 19.0 L X 24.5 W centimeter
artworks.description: Painting of two elephants with locked trunks in fight with mahouts over their backs.

artworks.title: Court Scene of Jahangir
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A court scene of Jahangir seated on throne with a bolster at his back under a canopy. A kattar tied up at his waist. Three noble standing before him, one of them with folded hands. Two nobles standing beside the steps, one of them with folded hands and the other holding a book in his hands. Three attendants standing behind him, one holding a fly-whisk in his right hand and the other two with quiver and carpet. Decorative bands red and blue with creeper and floral design around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A noble standing with a dagger tied up at his waist. A sword and shield hanging at his left. Flower plants in foreground. Stain marble design band round the painting. Flower creeper design on red band in gold in between dotted bands.

artworks.title: Portrait of King
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Mughal style. A king seated on a chair holding a flower in his chair and putting his left on a kattar tied up at his waist. A crosier at his right. Flower plants in foreground and dark green in the background. Stained marble design bands in between red bands with dots designs round the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A noble standing putting his right hand on the talwar (kattar) handle and left on sword handle. Turban with a dotted design. Plain golden lines around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold on red band in between plain golden lines around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Painting of a noble in standing position resting his left hand on the sword, wearing red turban and blue angarakha with golden flower patterns. Background green, top shaded blue, golden flower creeper on red band around. Flower creeper and floral pattern on margin in vertical panels.

artworks.title: Portrait of Islam Khan Mashhadi
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription in stained marble design panels round the painting. An old bearded noble (Islam Khan Mashhadi) holding a staff in his left hand a kattar at his waist and a flower in his right in standing position. Flower plants in the foreground. Plain golden lines round the painting. Persian verses in the decorative panels round the painting.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A romantic scene a noble leaning on left hand bent towards his consort who is reclined on the bolster. Trees, building and moon-light in the background. Parapets and steps in the foreground. Flower creeper on light green band in between plain golden lines, round the painting.

artworks.title: Prince and Princess Playing Chess
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a prince and princess seated on a terrace playing chess. In the foreground, various objects are visible, including flasks, a wine cup, betel boxes, and spittoons. The background is described as green, cloudy, and blue, with additional details such as a golden band and golden flowers in the margin.

artworks.title: Timur Seated on Throne
artworks.description: Timur seated on throne with chatter, holding sword in his right hand and Kerchief in his left hand with one foot on the foot rest. An attendant with fly-whisk standing on his left with a man with stretched hands in front. Blue background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble Man
artworks.dimensions: 12.8 L X 10.7 W, 16.8 L X 12.0 W, 19.3 L X 14.1 W centimeter
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription on top beginning with : ending on: A king seated on a throne holding a fly-whisk in his left hand and an archery ring in his right. Flower plants behind the parapet. Sky blue in the background. A plain golden band around the painting. Creeper design in gold in the margin. With inscription on top beginning.

artworks.title: Nasiruddin Humayun Badshah Bin Zaheeruddin Babar Badshah
artworks.description: Framed Miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription on top beginning with : ending on: A king seated on throne with a bolster at back, with his left hand on the book put on his thigh and putting his right hand on his raised knee. Flower plants behind the parapet. Background sky blue flower creeper design in gold and plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: A Lady Seated in Sad-mood
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Raj-put style. A lady seated in a sad mood on one side, while another woman stands in the middle, also displaying sorrowful emotions. Seven men are standing before her, participating in funeral rites. The somber atmosphere is palpable as they carry out their duties. The painting features plain golden and blue bands around it, adding a touch of elegance to its overall design.

artworks.title: Jehangir Seated on a Throne
artworks.description: Framed Miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription on top : and at the bottom : With Persian verses at the back beginning with : ending on : Jehangir seated on a throne under a canopy, an attendant holding a fly-whisk standing behind him. Two men standing towards his left and four standing before him. Clouds in background and creeper design around the painting.Flower pattern in the margin. Flower plant design in the margin at the back.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscriptions on top beginning with : ending on : A king seated on a throne holding a dagger in his right hand and rosary in his left hand. Trees behind the parapet. Background sky blue. A plain golden band around the painting. Creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscriptions on top beginning with : ending on : A king seated on throne holding a bejewelled crest in his left hand and a rosary in his right. Flower plants behind the parapet. Background blue, creeper design in gold and plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: A King Seated on Chair
artworks.description: The miniature painting is done in the Mughal style and features an inscription. A king is seated on a chair, with both his hands placed on the hilt of a sword. Behind the king stands an attendant dressed in red attire. To the right of the scene, there is a corridor visible. The painting has a plain golden band surrounding it.

artworks.title: Two Ladies Seated on a Bedstead
artworks.description: Miniature painting in deccan style. Two ladies seated on a bedstead. One offering wine to the other. A maid standing on either side, the one on right holding a garland. Two ladies seated down one of them with guitar. In the background pond with lotus flowers and cloudy sky.

metadata.title2: A Maid Standing on Either Side

artworks.title: Prince with His Consort
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A prince seated with his consort holding a wine cup in his right hand and a kerchief in his left hand. The lady before him is holding wine cup in her left hand and flagon in her right hand. Three maids on the left side and two on right side holding a staff in her hands while the other standing in the garden. Ducks swimming in the cistern in the foreground and background also. Flower creeper design band in gold around the painting. Plants in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: A Sadhu Seated on a Carpet
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani based on Raj-put style. Leafy cut of Krishna Leela. A sadhu seated on a carpet under a tree holding a book in his hands. There is a book in front of him. Disciples seated before him. Flower plants and trees behind the parapet. River, animals, buildings and clouds in the background. Illuminated panels on top and bottom. A plain golden band around the painting. Flower patterns on blue band around the painting.

artworks.title: Sultan Burhan Grand Son of King of Berar
artworks.description: Sultan Burhan grand son of king of Berar seated holding a flower stalk in his right hand and a dagger at his waist. Golden creeper border on Turquoise band around. Persian inscription on top.

artworks.title: King Baber
artworks.description: A king ( Baber) seated on terrace with red bolster at his back wearing blue waist coat and holding dagger with left hand. Cloudy background.

artworks.title: Portrait of King Jehangir
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style with a chit at the top bearing inscriptions. Jehangir standing behind the parapet wall holding a sword in his right hand and a white Kerchief in his left hand. Background green. A golden band with flower creeper design around the painting and a plain grey band after it. Decorative panels in green and grey in the margin.

artworks.title: Palace Scene
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Hyderabad style. A palace illuminated on the occasion of the Dewali. A Raja seated smoking huqqa in the hall beyond the fountain. In the foreground two ladies enjoying Huqqa and enjoying fire display and music. A lady busy in the fire works. A lady attendant holding a staff in her hand standing beside the steps.

artworks.title: Portrait of Nizam Shah of Ahmad Nagar
artworks.description: The painting depicts Prince Nizam Shah of Ahmad Nagar at a younger age. He is seated with his right hand holding a flower stalk, dressed in an outfit featuring the colours orange, blue, and green. The painting also includes a golden creeper on a turquoise band around him. An Arabic inscription can be seen both at the top and bottom of the artwork.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady with Noble Man
artworks.dimensions: 21.9 L X 15.0 W, 26.0 L X 19.1 W, 45.0 L X 29.7 W centimeter
artworks.description: Painting in miniature in Rajput style. A noble man seated with a lady on a carpet under a canopy enjoying music holding a huqqa pipe in his right hand. A lady attendant behind him in standing position. Three women seated in front of them, one of them clapping and the other two playing on musical instruments. Fruit dish with its cover spittoon, a betel box a dish with flagon and cups and fruits in the foreground. Boats sailing in the river , buildings , trees and clouds in the background. Flower creeper design band in gold around the painting. Golden plants in the margin.

artworks.title: Krishna Leela
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Raj-put style with Persian verses on top and bottom. Beginning with: Ending on: A part of out of Krishna Leela. Lord Krishna seated before a hut. A lady sitting in front offering him fruits. A man wrapping tiger skin with bow and quiver scene at right. Trees around the pond in the background. A plain golden band around the painting. Creeper design on blue band around the painting.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A hunting expedition, duck hunting by falcons. A king (Aurangzeb) seated in palanquin going to hunt carried by four men on either side and six re-leavers in front and at back. Two attendants holding fly-whisks in their hands on both the sides , while one holding a chatter behind the king. Two soldiers holding before with shields hanging by their sides while one rider holding reins of the horse by his left hand standing before them. Six men standing in a line with falcons on their hands one man holding the string of the dog standing in besides them. The bullock-carts with drivers in the foreground. Hills , buildings , horses , camels ,elephants , pond and ducks in the background. Plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper design band on black band around the painting. Flower plants with gold and silver, birds in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: The painting depicts an old bearded noble dressed in a white angarkha. He is standing with a sword in his left hand, another sword and shield hanging by his side, and a dagger at his waist. The background of the painting is blue, with a golden creeper border and floral pattern in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Painting depicting the bust of a bearded king with golden hallow wearing white turban with golden border. Two flower creeper borders around one being golden. Two panels above and two below with creeper designs matching each other. Silver sprinkled margin. On the other side: A bearded king with golden ring standing in an oval shaped panel holding a flower stalk in his left hand.

artworks.title: Prophet Abraham Offering His Son as Sacrifice
artworks.description: Painting prophet Abraham offering his son as sacrifice, an angle carrying sheep is seen holding the prophet's hand. A Persian couplet is written on top of the painting. The frame features golden creeper designs on a brown band around it. Golden flowers adorn the margin of the painting.

artworks.title: Old Man with a Boy
artworks.description: Framed water colour painting in Persian style with verses at the right top begin with :- Ending on : An old bearded man with his head resting on his left shoulder busy in writing while a boy sitting beside him pouring wine into the cup. Candle - stick, books and ink - pot etc., in the foreground. Books and tree in the background. Decorative border with geometrical patterns around the painting. margin plain.

artworks.title: A Lady (Zulaikha) Seated on a Yellow Carpet, Eight Ladies Around Her
artworks.description: Water colour miniature painting in Persian style with inscription at top:- (Yousuf Zulaikha). A lady (Zulaikha) seated on a yellow carpet, eight ladies around her. Yousuf bringing a coffee pot in a tray, ladies wonder struck at his approach. An old lady seated in the foreground. A bearded man standing not fully seen in oval panel. Flower plants, birds and turret in background. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Omer Khayyam
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with a quatrain of Omar Khayyam, beginning with: ending on: The idea is that music is necessary with drink. A youth seated holding a cup in his right, Houri pouring wine of heaven into it. A flagon is beside him held by his left hand. Trees in gold in background. Floral designs in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Omer Khayyam
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with a quatrain of Omar Khayyam, beginning with: ending on: The idea is that love is life. A Sufi putting on a funnel shape white turban seated on a floral design blue carpet with red border in meditation. Trees in gold in background. Floral designs in gold in margin.

metadata.title2: A Sufi Putting on a Funnel Shape White Turban

artworks.title: Omer Khayyam
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with Persian verses at the right corner on the top beginning with: Ending on:The idea is that an old man seated with his head resting on his right arm with closed eyes. A young holding dish coming towards him. A spear in the middle, its blade resting on the middle.Its blade resting on the floral. With inscription:

artworks.title: Majnum with a Deer
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with verses around the painting beginning with: ending on: Majnu with a deer. A man seated under a tree putting his left hand on the deer standing beside him. Grass and plants in foreground. Decorative band around the painting and rhombus panels in between verses floral design. Patterns of flower plants in the margin painted in blue, green, red and gold.

metadata.title2: Majnu Seated Under a Tree Putting His Left Hand on the Deer Standing Beside Him

artworks.title: Laila's Camp in the Desert
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style. Laila's camp in the desert distributing food to the poor people, Majnun first to receive it. Five ladies in tent. The first lady with a large spoon pouring soup in the bowl of a beggar while the second holding bread. Five men before the tent one of them sitting, a dog, sheep and a ram in the foreground. Camels, sheep , hillock and trees in the background. Dark blue band with leafy design in gold around the painting. Gold sprinkled in the margin.

artworks.title: A Seated Sufi
artworks.description: The framed miniature painting is in a traditional Persian style, depicting a serene scene. A Sufi figure is seated on a lush green landscape, surrounded by an idyllic atmosphere. He is being attended to by a Houri, who is pouring love from heaven into the hollow of his hands. The painting features a plain golden band around its edges and intricate floral designs in gold along the margins.

artworks.title: Lady Lying on Bed
artworks.description: The addition of a man seated on the left side is a notable feature of this piece. The design features leafy patterns in gold against a dark blue background, which are separated by plain golden bands around the painting. In the background, dried-up trees can be seen, adding to the overall atmosphere of the artwork. Gold sprinkles along the margin add an extra touch of elegance to the piece.

artworks.title: A Young Man Standing
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with a Persian quatrain in the band around the painting beginning with: ending on: The idea is that the wine is the portent remedy to save the soul from annihilation. A young man standing with a flagon and kerchief in his right hand and a blue leaf design cloak on his left shoulder. Plants in foreground and cloud designs in background in gold. Flower creeper designs in gold in margin.

artworks.title: A Sufi Reading an Epic Poem
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with Persian verses at the painting beginning with: ending on: A Sufi's mental reaction after reading the account of a wedding in an epic poem. A Sufi seated under a tree holding an open book in his hands in meditation. Creeper band around the painting. Triangular panels in between verses with floral design. Patterns of flower plants in the margin painted in blue , green, red and gold.

artworks.title: Seated Lady Under a Tree
artworks.description: Framed painting in Persian style painted by Katchhadourian. A lady seated under a tree on the bank of River with a cup in her right hand and holding the flagon in her left hand. Another flagon towards her right. Signature at the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Three Tents in a Jungle
artworks.description: Framed picture in Persian style drawn in black and blue decorated with gold paint. Three tents in a jungle. A lady seated with a cup before and a flagon beside her. The face of another and heads of two horses are seen behind the tent. Two men coming towards the lady, one holding a stick. Trees and birds in the background. Flower creeper designs in gold margin.

artworks.title: Young Man Sitting Under an Arch
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style. A young man sitting under an arch looking at the dancing couple. A man playing on tambourine standing at the left. Two men standing in the middle. Two ladies and a man peeping from the windows of the upper story. Flower creeper design in gold against blue background around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Couple Enjoying Music and Wine
artworks.description: Framed picture in Persian style drawn in black with Shadow of red and decorated with gold paint. A couple enjoying music and wine. A lady offering wine to a man. An attendant holding a tray with flagons. A lady playing on guitar and a man on tambourine. Jar, dish, flagons and cups in foreground. Hillock, deer, trees, birds and clouds in background. Flower creeper in gold in blue band around the picture. Flower creeper in gold in margin.

artworks.title: A Noble Man Seated Enjoying Music and Dance
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style. A nobleman seated enjoying music and dance. A singer seated with a paper in his hand. Three men dancing, their hands hidden in the sleeves. Two men standing at right, one with a tambourine. Two men at the left, one being seated. A man and a lady peeping through the windows. Flower creeper designs in gold against blue background round the painting.

artworks.title: Three Persian People
artworks.description: Framed picture in Persian style drawn in black partly painted in white, red and green and decorated with gold paint. Two men with a lady in the middle very close to each other - steps show as they are dancing. Lady holding wine cup in her left hand. Flower plants in foreground. In the background hillocks, birds, trees and clouds. Flower creeper in gold in the blue band around the picture. Flower creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Lady Under a Tree
artworks.description: Framed painting in Persian style painted by Sirkis katchhadourian. A young lady is seated under a tree on the back of a river, pouring wine into her cup. Another flagon is positioned towards her left. The signature of the artist can be found on the lower left corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Seated Lady Back of the River
artworks.description: The framed painting is in the Persian style, attributed to Katchhadourian. A lady is seated near the back of a river, playing a guitar with a flagon and wine cup placed before her. Flower plants are positioned on either side of the scene. The artist's signature can be found at the lower right corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Man Offering Wine to His Consort
artworks.description: Framed water color miniature painting in Persian style with inscription (Shah Abbas - 1134). A man offering wine to his consort holding flagon in his left hand. In the foreground a lady dancing and the other two are replying on their musical instruments. Two creeper design bands around the painting. Birds and trees in green hue in the margin. A chit on back shows that it was painted by Aqa Mohd. Shiraz.

artworks.title: A Chief Seated
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with a Persian couplet at top: at the bottom: A chief seated holding a cup in his right hand his consort standing with a cup in left hand pouring wine in his cup. Two cups beside him. A woman holding incense burner standing towards his left. Door and river in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Floral designs in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Fighting Scene
artworks.description: Miniature water colour painting in Persian style. Fighting scene. The man on white horse shooting arrow while the other horsemen attacking with sword. A man fallen down in foreground with his turban near his feet and his shield at the left corner. A man with sword is seen behind hills. Flora designs in the margin.

artworks.title: Humayun on a Horse Back
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style with inscriptions on top and bottom. A leaf from Nizami's Khamsa. Humayun on horse back with an attendant holding chatter over him. An old woman leaning in staff standing before him. Hillock at the background. Decorative band around the painting. Color wash and gold spray in Margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature water color painting in Persian style in carved rose wood frame. A noble enjoying music with an attendant standing before him. Five musicians: one playing on harp, one in tambourine, one on guitar while the other two singing. Double border. In the margin a scene of a picnic spot, a couple enjoying wine on top another at the bottom, on the left an old man with a flask beside him and an attendant with a dish standing behind him.

artworks.title: Two Ladies
artworks.dimensions: 15.7 L X 26.6 W, 7.4 L X 15.8 W centimeter
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style except the ladies and pots all in black with a Persian couplet at the top of the painting. Two ladies sitting under a tree one of them holding a wine cup in her right hand and pouring wine into a jar by her left hand with a dish before her while the other playing on tambourine. Rock in the foreground and cloud design in the background. plain golden band around the painting. Floral design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: A Lady Offering Wine Flask to Her Paramour Through a Window
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style. A lady offering wine flask to her paramour through a window. Two ladies behind the fencing one holding a pot. Trees and birds in the background. Two creeper design bands around the painting. Birds and trees are in green hue in the margin.

artworks.title: A Lady Enjoying Music and Wine
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Persian style. A lady enjoying music and wine. The lady holding a wine cup with a female servant holding fruit dish in front of her. A man playing on tambourine another on violin with flagon, cup and fruits in front in the foreground. On the top in the margin a man sitting with a parrot having wine cup and fruits and at the bottom a lady resting on a cushion. Trees and birds are around the margin.

artworks.title: Shahrukh Bin Taimor
artworks.description: Framed water color miniature painting in Persian style. A prince holding a book in his left hand embraced with the seated on yellow carpet. Wine cup in front. With the inscription at the top: Flower creeper and medallion patterns in gold against green background in margin.

artworks.title: Seated Prince on a Rock
artworks.date: EARLY 20TH CENTURY , HASHIYA OF LATE 18TH CENTURY
artworks.description: Framed water color miniature painting in Persian style. A prince seated on a rock at the tank. Holding a wine cup in his right hand and the sword in his left hand. A flagon by his side and fruits in front. Looking at the fishes in the water. A plain band around the painting. Flower creeper and medallion patterns in gold against green background in margin.

artworks.title: Holy prophet's sermon at Khum-e-Chadir
artworks.description: Colour print painting in Persian style in decorative golden frame. A group painting showing fourteen men, two standing on one side of the tree and some of them seated on the other, three camel heads are visible. With inscriptions illustrating the Holy prophet's sermon at Khum-e-Chadir. Beginning with:..... ending on..........

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Miniature water color painting in Persian style in golden wooden frame. A couple sitting very close, the lady offering wine to him. An attendant drinking wine with the flagon itself. An old man sitting in foreground asking for wine. Double border Margin with designs of birds and trees. With inscriptions:-

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Framed water color miniature painting in Persian style with inscription. A hunting scene. In the foreground an archer aiming at a lion, another man stabbing a sword in the throat of a deer, and the third man’s face is seen behind him. Hillock, trees, and birds in the background. Two creeper design bands round the painting. Trees and birds in green hue in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Noble Man
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style. A noble man standing with a glove on right hand, a falcon perching on it. Armed with arrows, bow and jambia (dagger). A water bottle hanging by side. Decorative band with creeper design round the painting. Patterns of flower plants in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Centre Piece with Flowers
artworks.description: Miniature painting of a center piece with flowers of different kinds, a mango and a bunch of grapes and two apples against blue background in arch like panel. Flower creeper design in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Center Piece with Flowers

artworks.title: Center Piece with Flowers

artworks.title: Center Piece with Flowers
artworks.description: Water color miniature painting of a center piece with flowers of different kinds against blue background in a Medallion panel. Floral creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Center Piece with Flowers
artworks.description: Miniature painting of a center piece with flowers of different kinds against blue background in a Medallion panel. Floral creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Center Piece with Flowers
artworks.description: Framed watercolour miniature painting of a center piece with flowers of different kinds against blue background in Medallion panel. Floral creeper design in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Omer Khayyam

The border of the painting features an intricate floral design in gold color on a light red background, adding to its aesthetic appeal. A calligraphy at the back of the painting adds another layer of visual interest and possibly provides additional information about the artwork or its creator.

One attendant is notable for carrying a fly-whisk, which was a common tool used for swatting flies and other insects. The margin of the painting features a golden flower creeper, adding an element of decoration and beauty to the scene. Inscriptions on the top of the painting provide additional context or information about the artwork, although their exact meaning is not specified in this text.

On the reverse chronogram of his death inscribed in Nastaliq script.

artworks.title: Bust of Mirza Taqru Walihad Bahadur Badshah and His Wife Khanam Zamani Begum
artworks.description: Miniature painting. Bust of Mirza Taqru Walihad Bahadur Badshah and his wife Khanam Zamani Begum in separate panel.

artworks.title: Five Women at Swimming Pool
artworks.description: Painting depicting two ladies in swimming pool and three ladies are seen on platform of the pool. Pavilion in the background. Two gold sprinkled bands around.

artworks.title: Mumtaz Mahal Wife of Shah Jahan
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a rose in her right hand and a fan in her left. Yellowish green foreground and grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Mumtaz Mahal wife of Shah Jahan, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: A Mughal King (Nooruddin Jahangir Badshah)
artworks.description: Painting of a Mughal King Jahangir wearing turban with cockade standing with a globe in his right hand and a curved sword at his left. Dark green foreground and light blue background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Nooruddin Jahangir Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Noorjahan Wife of Jahangir
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a falcon perched on her left hand and a dagger in her right. Green foreground and white background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Noorjahan Begum wife of Jahangir, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Noorjahan Wife of Jahangir
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a falcon perched on her left hand and a dagger in her right. Green foreground and white background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Noorjahan Begum wife of Jahangir, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: An Emperor Jalaluddin Akbar Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of Emperor Akbar wearing crown and aigrette standing with a straight sword in his right hand. Green shaded background and foreground with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Jalaluddin Akbar Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Jodabai Wife of Jalluddin Akbar
artworks.description: The painting depicts a queen standing with flowers in both hands. The artwork features a shaded green foreground and background with decorative panel above and a yellow band around it. The subject of the painting is identified as Jodabai, the wife of Jalaluddin Akbar, written in pencil in Urdu below the image.

artworks.title: Jodabai Wife of Jalluddin Akbar
artworks.description: The painting depicts a queen standing with flowers in both hands. The artwork features a shaded green foreground and background, as well as a decorative panel above and a yellow band around it. At the bottom of the painting, the name "Jodabai wife of Jalaluddin Akbar" is written in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: A Mughal King (Naseeruddin Humayun Badshah )
artworks.description: Painting of a Mughal king Humayun wearing turban with aigrette standing with a diamond in his right hand and a curved sword in his left. Shaded green foreground and background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Naseeruddin Humayun Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: A Mughal King Naseeruddin Humayun Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a Mughal king Humayun wearing turban with aigrette standing with a diamond in his right hand and a curved sword in his left. Shaded green foreground and background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Naseeruddin Humayun Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Hatim Zamani Begum Wife of Naseeruddin Humayun
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing turbaned cap with aigrette standing with a flower in her left hand and a box in her right. Shaded green foreground and light green background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Hatim Zamani Begum wife of Naseeruddin Humayun , written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Jaheeruddin Babar Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a Mughal king, Babar wearing crown with cockade standing with a dagger in his right and a straight sword in his left. Dark green foreground and light grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Jaheeruddin Babar Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Jaheeruddin Babar Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a Mughal king, Babar wearing crown with cockade standing with a dagger in his right and a straight sword in his left. Dark green foreground and light grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Jaheeruddin Babar Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Portrait of Ahmed Shah Badshah
artworks.description: Painting representing a Mughal king wearing turban with angarakha, holding a flower in right hand, with his left hand on the hilt of a Talwar (sword). Green foreground and greenish background with a decorative panel on top and yellow band around. Ahmed Shah Badshah written below in Urdu in pencil.

artworks.title: Sikander Jahan Wife of Jaheeruddin Babar
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a diamond in her left hand and hand kerchief in her right and a dagger at her waists.Green foreground and white background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Sikander Jahan wife of Jaheeruddin Babar, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: King Amir Timur Shaheb-i-quran Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a king Timur wearing a turban with cockade standing with a spear in his right hand and a curved sword in his left. Green foreground and grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Amir Timur Shaheb-i-Quran Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: King Amir Timur Shahebi Quran Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a king Timur wearing a turban with cockade standing with a spear in his right hand and a curved sword in his left. Green foreground and grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Amir Timur Shahebi Quran Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Feroze Bano Begum ( Wife of Amir-timur )
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a piece of jewellery in her left hand. Dark green foreground and dark grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Feroze Bano Begum wife of Amir-Timur, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Feroze Bano Begum ( Wife of Amirtimur )
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a piece of jewellery in her left hand. Dark green foreground and dark grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Feroze Bano Begum wife of AmirTimur, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Portrait of Sultan Omar Shaik Mizra Badsha
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded king wearing turban with aigrette standing with a straight sword held in both hands. Green foreground and greyish green background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Sultan Omar Shaik Mirza Badsha, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Portrait of Sultan Omar Shaik Mizra Badsha
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded king wearing turban with aigrette standing with a straight sword held in both hands. Green foreground and greyish green background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Sultan Omar Shaik Mirza Badsha, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Queen
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a book in her left hand. Dark green foreground and greyish Yellow background with decorative panel above and yellow band around.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Queen
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a book in her left hand. Dark green foreground and greyish yellow background with decorative panel above and yellow band around.

artworks.title: Portrait of King Timur
artworks.description: The painting depicts King Timur wearing a turban with a cockade, standing with a jewellery piece in his right hand and a handkerchief in his left. The artwork features a green foreground and a greyish-green background, which provides a visually striking contrast to the subject. A decorative panel is visible above King Timur, adding an extra layer of detail to the composition, while a yellow band encircles the entire piece, completing its ornate design.

artworks.title: Portrait of King Timur
artworks.description: Painting of King Timur wearing turban with Cockade standing with a jewellery piece in his right hand and a hand kerchief in his left. Green foreground and greyish green background, with decorative panel above and a yellow band around. A beef welled ornament with turanj shaped top both on the headgear and in the right hand.

artworks.title: Jamila Khatoon Wife of Mohammad Mizra Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a flower in her right hand. Dark green foreground and light blue background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Jamila Khatoon wife of Mohammad Mirza Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King (Sultan Jalaluddin Miran Shah)
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded Timur-ad king wearing turban with aigrette standing with folded hands with a dagger at his waists. Dark green foreground and white background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Sultan Jalaluddin Miran Shah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Sakina Khatoon Wife of Jalaluddin Miran Shah
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with a flower in her left hand, her right over the dagger at her waists. Green foreground and white background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Sakina Khatoon wife of Jalaluddin Miran Shah , written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Qudsia Begum Wife of Ahmed Shah Badsha
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen QUDSIA BEGUM wearing a cap with cockade standing with a scroll in both hands.Green foreground and light green background with decorative panel at the top and yellow band around. Qudsia Begum wife of Ahmed Shah Badsha written below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King (Sultan Abu Sayeed Mirza Badshah)
artworks.description: Painting of an old bearded Timur-ad king wearing turban with aigrette standing with both hands resting on the staff. Green foreground and grey background with decorative panel at the top and yellow band around. Sultan Abu Sayeed Mirza Badshah written below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Qamar Sultan Begum Wife of Abu Sayeed Mirza Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of princess wearing a cap with cockade standing with a dagger held in both hands. Green foreground and light green with grey shade background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Qamar Sultan Begum wife of Abu Sayeed Mirza Badshah, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Mughal King
artworks.description: The painting depicts a Mughal prince with distinctive features, including a black beard and a crown. The prince is shown standing with a dagger held in both hands, which suggests his status as a powerful figure. The background of the painting is notable for its use of color, featuring a light green foreground and a grey shade background that creates a sense of depth. Additional decorative elements include a panel above the prince and a yellow band around the edges of the painting.

artworks.title: Mughal Princess Sharf Afza Bano ( Wife of Mirza Faqroo )
artworks.description: Painting of a Mughal princess standing with a fan in her left hand and supporting her blue shawl and odni with the right. Green foreground and grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Sharf Afza Bano wife of Mirza Faqroo, written in below in pencil in Urdu.

artworks.title: Princess with Attendants
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A princess seated on a carpet with a baby in her lap and a bolster at her back. Another lady seated before her offering wine with her right hand and resting her left on her thigh, with a bolster at her back. A lady attendant on either side standing one with a fly-whisk in her hand and the other with a kerchief in her hand. A lady playing on her veena and wine cup in her right hand and resting on her left on a flagon. A flagon, wine cup and on front of them. Trees and sky in the background. A plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Mughal style. A lady standing on a grassy land holding a flower in her right hand and a kerchief in her left. Grass and flower plants in the foreground. Sky blue on the top. Plain golden and white lines around the painting. Colour spray in the margin.

artworks.title: A Lady Seated on Terrace
artworks.description: The painting depicts two ladies in a serene outdoor setting. One lady is seated on a terrace, with her right hand placed on her left knee and her left hand resting on a pillow. The other lady is positioned in front of her, holding a rose in her left hand. In the foreground, a fountain adds to the tranquil atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Seated Woman with Tiger
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a woman sitting under a tree with a tiger by her side. The woman is holding a fly-whisk in her left hand, resting her elbow on the tiger as she sits beside it. A basket is placed in front of them, and the foreground of the painting features green hues. The sky above is cloudy.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Princess
artworks.description: The miniature painting is framed in double glass in the Deccan style. A princess is depicted standing with a fly-whisk in her left hand, accompanied by a dagger and a purse hanging at her waist.
