The background of the painting features a cloudy sky above and a grassy landscape below. The frame of the painting is adorned with a plain golden band.

artworks.title: Standing Lady
artworks.description: Painting showing a lady in standing position under a tree enjoying with huqqa pipe , wearing a turban , a pink color pyjama in flower design, bracelets and armlets. Resting her right leg on a small stool. Foreground painted in green color. Two birds on the top of the tree.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: Miniature painting of a lady standing under a tree holding a huqqa pipe in her right hand and a branch under her left arm. The huqqa is placed on a tripod before her. Grassy land and cloudy sky in the background. Flower plants in the foreground. Light red band in between plain golden lines round the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The subject of this painting is a woman dressed in a traditional attire, specifically a lady wearing a saffron-colored saree. The lady is depicted holding a portion of her saree as a veil in her right hand, which adds an element of elegance to the overall composition. The background of the painting features a light green color, while the foreground is dominated by grassy elements, creating a natural and serene atmosphere. Notably, the painting includes a brown plain band that separates two golden bands, adding a touch of sophistication and visual interest to the artwork.

artworks.title: Todi Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass. Todi Ragini. A lady resting on a tree trunk putting her right hand on a branch and turned towards right looking at an antelope. Antelope standing towards her left. Cypress trees, flower trees and cloudy sky are in the background. Flower plants and grassy land in the foreground. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Painting of a Lady
artworks.description: A painting depicting a lady seated under a tree with cloth tied around her waist and shanks. Enjoying huqqa, with a stick on shoulder covered with flowers. Green foreground.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: A lady standing with a pan (folded betel) in her right hand and a small box in her left. Cloudy sky in the background. Grassy land and flower plants in the foreground. Brown band in between plain golden bands around the painting.

artworks.title: Two Sufi's Seated on Carpet
artworks.dimensions: 17.0 L X 11.6 W, 22.0 L X 11.6 W, 25.0 L X 14.8 W centimeter
artworks.description: Miniature paintings framed in double glass in Mughal style with Persian verses in decorative panels on top and bottom. Persian verse on top: Persian verse at the bottom : Two Sufi's seated on a carpet, one is holding the pages of a book with his left hand. An old bearded Sufi before him with a rosary in his hands. Flower plants, trees and birds in the background. Flower plants in the fore ground creeper designs on red band gold in the margin in between dot designs bands round painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of Noble
artworks.description: Painting of a standing nobleman holding a spear in his right hand and resting his left hand on a shield by his side. A kattar and a sword tied up at his waist, Persian inscriptions on all the sides and border with floral design in gold color.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass with inscription on top: Fire work in the garden. A Prince standing close to his consort touching her chin with his right hand and turning her by his left. His consort holding fire work sticks in her hands. Fountain and flower plants in the foreground. Plain golden lines around the painting. Creeper design in red band in gold margin.

artworks.title: Princess with Attendants
artworks.description: Painting depicting a princess seated on a chair. Three women standing in front, one of them offering her a box. Four women standing behind, the first with flask and the last with fly-whisk. Golden creeper designs around the painting. Flower stalk pattern in margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: The painting depicts a Persian noble figure, dressed in attire that includes a turban and a dagger at his waist, with both hands placed over it. A distinctive feature of this artwork is the inclusion of a Persian couplet, which appears both at the top and bottom of the piece. The borders of the painting are adorned with intricate golden creeper patterns, adding an extra layer of visual interest to the overall design. Additionally, the margin features a delicate golden floral pattern, further enhancing the aesthetic appeal of the artwork.

artworks.title: Prince Standing with Falcon
artworks.description: The miniature painting is in the Mughal style, depicting a prince standing on a boulder. The prince is accompanied by a falcon perched on his right hand and a Kattar tied up at his waist. Flower plants are situated to the right of the prince, while cypress trees stand to his left. In the background, there are hillocks and trees that add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Roman Lady
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Sketch in Siyam Qalam. A Roman lady holding a vase design pot in her left hand and wine cup in her right hand in standing position.

artworks.title: Three Ladies Standing
artworks.description: Three ladies in standing side by side are holding the hands of one another. Flower creeper on red band in between plain golden lines. Stained marble in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature Painting (Framed In Double Glass) In deccani style . A Noble holding a dagger in his hand in Standing position as if Presenting it as Nazar to his Superior. A Sword hanging by his left and kattar tied up at his waist. Plain golden Band around the Painting.Flower Creeper Design on red band in between Plain golden band In gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Mughal style. A noble raiding on a horse holding reins in his left hand and a falcon on his right. A dagger tied up at his waist. A shield, sword & a bow hanging at his left. Stained marble design bands on top & bottom. Decorative band in red and gold round the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting (framed in double glass)in deccani style. A young noble holding a flower in his right hand and a sword in his left in standing position. Trees, flower plants & sky in the background. Creeper design on red band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Jacob and Joseph with His Brothers
artworks.description: Painting of Jacob and Joseph with his brothers seated group composition in the open.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting representing a noble man standing holding a flower in his right hand with his left over the kattar's handle. A sword & shield hanging at his left. Light green background. Flower plants in the foreground. Golden creeper band on top and bottom. Flower creeper border in gold in between plain golden lines and dotted bands on red band around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style. A noble probably a court librarian holding a book in his hands in standing position. A dagger tied up at his waist. A plain golden band around the painting. Flower creeper design on red band in between plain golden bands in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mughal King ( Azizuddin Almir II Badshah )
artworks.description: Painting of a Mughal king wearing turban and aigrette standing with a necklace in both the hands. Green foreground with grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Azizuddin Alamgir II Badshah, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: An-war Zamani Begum Wife of Azizuddin Almgir II Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing turban and aigrette standing with a necklace in both the hands. Green foreground with grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. An-war Zamani Begum wife of Azizuddin Alamgir II Badshah, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mughal King (Moinuddin Akbar Badshah)
artworks.description: Painting of an old and bearded Mughal king wearing turban with aigrette standing with a flower in his right hand. Dark green foreground and light green background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Moinuddin Akbar Badshah, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: Vazir Jahan Begum Wife of Moinuddin Akbar II
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen standing with a flower in her right hand and a blue shawl over the head and shoulders. Green foreground and light green background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Vazir Jahan Begum wife of Moinuddin Akbar II, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: Abu Zafar Sirajuddin Bahadur Shah II
artworks.description: Painting of king Bahadur Shah II wearing crown with aigrette standing with a staff in his left. Green background, flower plants in the foreground with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Inscription in pencil in Urdu below. " Abu Zafar Sirajuddin Bahadur Shah II " .

artworks.title: Zeenath Mahal Wife of Bahadur Shah
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen standing with a kerchief in her right hand and supporting her odni by the left. Dark green foreground and light green background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Zeenath Mahal wife of Bahadur Shah, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mughal King (Mozzam Shah Badshah )
artworks.description: The painting depicts a bearded Mughal king standing with a rose in his right hand and a kattar in his left, wearing a turban with an aigrette. The background of the painting is shaded green, and the name "Mozzam Shah Badshah" is written below in pencil in Urdu. The margin surrounding the painting is plain.

artworks.title: Akbar Jahan Begum Wife of Prince Mozzam Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing cap with aigrette standing with flower in her right hand and the left over the dagger at the waist. Green foreground and grey background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Akbar Jahan Begum wife of Prince Mozzam Badshah, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mughal King ( Rafiudrajat Badshah)
artworks.description: Painting of a bearded Mughal king wearing turban with aigrette standing with a book in his right hand and a kerchief in left with dagger tied in his waist. Dark green foreground and light blue background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Rafiudrajat Badshah, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: Sakina Bano Wife of Rafiudrajat Badshah
artworks.description: Painting of a Queen wearing aigrette standing with a flagon (goblet) in her right hand and wine cup in the left hand. Shaded green foreground and background with decorative panel above and yellow band around. Sakina Bano wife of Rafiudrajat Badshah, written in pencil in Urdu below.

artworks.title: Prince Riding on Horseback
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass. A prince riding a horse holding a spear in his right hand and the reins in his left hand. A kattar tied up at his waist. A quiver hanging by his left. Cloudy sky in the background. Flower plants in the foreground. Persian inscription at the back of the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Mughal King
artworks.description: The painting depicts an old bearded Mughal king wearing a turban with an aigrette, standing with a flower in his right hand and a kattar at his waist. The background of the painting is grey, while the foreground is green. The artwork also features a decorative panel above and a yellow band around it.

artworks.title: Amal Mir Kalan
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style depicts an intense scene of two elephants engaged in a fierce battle. The elephants are twisted, their trunks entwined as they clash heads. Mahavath is seated on the back of one of the elephants, urging them to fight. This dramatic scene is set against a marshy landscape in the foreground.

artworks.title: Portrait of King
artworks.description: Painting of the Mughal king, Babar wearing a turban with cockade seated on the terrace with a falcon tied to the fencing, a sword hung by his left side. Golden creeper design on margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of King
artworks.description: A king smoking huqqa in his left hand and a flower in the right, standing on a platform. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Picture Depicting a Tribal Woman Seated
artworks.dimensions: 18.2 L X 9.0 W, 34.3 L X 21.5 W centimeter
artworks.description: Picture depicting a tribal woman seated in front of a cottage with a cup in her left hand and a fruit in the right, a woman seated behind dressing her hair. A semi- nude man with axe on right shoulder and a dead rabbit in his left hand with a golden line in a panel below. Persian verses around.

artworks.title: Controlling an Infuriated Elephant
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Mughal style with inscription at the bottom. Controlling an infuriated elephant. An infuriated elephant has broken the chains. A mahavat seated at it s back holding the ropes, tied up round its body. Another man piercing trident spear in its body. A third man going to control the elephant with a flame (fire work). Hillock, trees & building in the background. creeper design red, white and green on blue background the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of A
artworks.description: The painting depicts two learned individuals with their heads uncovered, sitting beneath a tree. One of them holds a book in his right hand, while the other is engaged in reading from a book. Their turbans are placed prominently on the foreground, adding visual interest to the scene. The dominant color palette used in the painting is light brown.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in deccani style. A noble holding a sword in his right hand and a flower in his left, in standing position. A kattar tied up at his waist. Grassy land in the foreground. Light green background. A plain golden band round the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Mughal style. A noble standing with a hawk on his right hand and holding the string in his left. A talwar (kattar) tied up at his waist and a sword hanging by his left. Green background. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Battle Field
artworks.description: Miniature painting. A battle field with elephants, horses, carts, and horse-men arranged in both figures in minute scale. The surrounding design features a flower creeper pattern in red, green, blue, and gold. In the margin of the painting, there are additional details of flower plants and birds.

artworks.title: Bust of a Princess
artworks.description: Painting in an oval panel of a bust of a princess wearing a cap with aigrette holding wine cup in the henna dyed right hand in oval panel with black background and plain band around.

artworks.title: Hindol Ragni
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Raj-put style. Probably Ragni Hindol. A young man with Veena seated in a swing. Four ladies standing on either side, one of them holding a fly-whisk and another Indian drum(Mridang). Trees on either side in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. An illuminated panel at the top. Blue and plain golden band around the painting. Flower creeper design in the margin.

artworks.title: Jehangir with Noor Jehan
artworks.description: Mughal miniature painting on ivory slab in Mughal style. Jehangir standing near a pillar with Noor Jehan his arm being round her waist. Noor Jehan pouring down the wine into the spittoon by her right hand. A chair on the right, a vase tray with flagon on stool on the left. Golden band round the painting. Trees behind the parapet.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Miniature painting on oval ivory slab in Kangra style. A prince standing with his wife putting his hands on her shoulder, near Minaret. Two maids standing before the door holding huqqa. A peacock seated above the door. Building on the hills and cloudy sky in the background. Golden band round the painting.

artworks.title: Aurangzeb Riding on Horseback
artworks.description: Miniature painting on ivory slab in Persian style with inscription at top. Aurangzeb riding on horseback with a flower in his right hand on their reins in the left. A man on either side holding fly-whisk and one behind holding umbrella. Golden band round the painting.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Miniature painting on oval ivory slab in Persian style. Akbar seated with his left arm round the neck of his wife, and holding huqqa pipe in his right hand. The lady holding his hand in her left and a fan in her right with her elbow on his thigh. A blue band with creeper design in gold making oval panel round the painting. The triangular panel at corner painted with floral designs in gold.

artworks.title: Bust of Tippu Sultan
artworks.description: Miniature painting on ivory slab in Deccani style. Bust of Tippu Sultan. Tippu dressed in green wearing his peculiar turban with crest. Background sky blue.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A noble man standing with a straight sword in his right hand and another curved sword and shield hanging by his left side. Foreground dark green, middle light green, and background bluish. Flower creeper design border in gold around the painting.

artworks.title: Bust of Shamsul Umara IV Amir-e-kabir III Rasheedud Din Khan
artworks.description: Miniature painting on rectangular ivory plate in European style. Bust of Shamsul Umara IV Amir-e-Kabir III Rasheedud Din Khan (d.1299) with long white mustaches sitting on a chair putting his right hand on the left and a sword at his thigh. Cloudy background. A plain golden band making oval panel round the painting, the rest portion is painted in blue and decorated with gold work.

artworks.title: Check the Title Sir
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory in Mughal style. An elevation of the Taj Mahal is depicted with water in the foreground and clouds in the background. In the middle, a bust of Shah Jehan and Mumtaz Mahal are shown on either side.

artworks.title: Bust of Princess
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory in Mughal Bust of a princess seated on resting on bolster holding a flower in her right hand. A red curtain hanging by her left side. Background sky blue.

artworks.title: Bust of Muntaz Mahal
artworks.description: The subject of the framed miniature painting is a bust of Muntaz Mahal. Muntaz Mahal is depicted in a seated position, holding a flower in her right hand and an up-side-down fan in her left hand. The background of the painting features a light blue color.

artworks.title: Bust of Shah Jehan
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory in Mughal style. Bust of Shah Jehan seated on a chair holding a flower in her left hand. Background light blue.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A king standing behind the parapet with a sword in his right hand, a flower in his left and a Kattar at his waist. Parapet pink and the rest blue. Flower creeper designs on golden band around the painting with a plain grey band. Decorative panels in the margin.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Princess
artworks.description: The subject of this framed miniature painting is a young princess depicted in Mughal style. The princess is shown wearing a cap with a bejewelled crest, holding a leaf-shaped fan behind her and a sword handle in her right hand. Behind the princess, trees are visible beyond a parapet.

artworks.title: Bust of a Princess
artworks.description: The subject of this framed miniature painting is a depiction of a princess. The princess is shown as a bust, focusing on her upper body, and is holding jewellery in one hand and two flowers in the other. Her left side is adorned with a green curtain featuring intricate gold work, while the background of the painting is a light blue hue.

artworks.title: Portrait of Akbar
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory in Mughal style. Akbar seated with a blue bolster under his left arm and falcon seated on his right. Background light blue.

artworks.title: Bust of a Princess
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting on oval ivory in Mughal style. The subject is a bust of a princess, depicted with her left hand under her left cheek and her right hand resting on a pillow. Her shoulders are covered by her hair, adding to the intimate and personal nature of the portrait. The background of the painting is a light blue color, which provides a serene and calm atmosphere to the overall scene.

artworks.title: Pukhri Dance
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Raj-put style. Pukhri dance: Two ladies in dancing position in oval panel with their hands clasped in each other raising one hand above and keeping the other below, and making angles by their legs towards sides. Foreground golden with plants. Middle grey. Light blue top. Creeper design raound the painting within golden bands making a rectangle. Floral patterns in gold and ogee designs in pink and medallion design in green with gold work in the margin.

metadata.title2: Two Ladies in Dancing Position in Oval Panel

artworks.title: Prince Shuja
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Prince Shuja standing holding a sword in his hands a shield and sword hanging by his left. Flower plants in the foreground. Geometrical designs in gold round the painting. (Original painting in centre has been repaired by adding space around.).

artworks.title: Court Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A court scene: a king seated on throne under a canopy. Two men seated before him one with a bow. One man standing before addressing to the king. Other men seen in the open yard. Six men and two horses before the gateway, flower creeper designs on blue band around the painting. Flower patterns in medallions panels in the margin in gold.

artworks.title: Fath Majeed, Naushad
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in glass in Raj-put style with inscription: Seated two princess on carpet with bolster at back and one of them holding the wine cup in her hand. A maid seated beside them with a flagon in her hand another maid standing behind with a kerchief in her hand. A maid in male dress dancing before them. Five musicians standing behind. Parapet in the foreground. Trees , building and river in the background. Creeper design in gold on the top and the bottom. Flower creeper design in gold in blue band and plain golden band around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold, red and white in the margin.

artworks.title: Sadhus and Their Disciples
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccan style. Three Sadhus and their nude disciples, two of them preparing bhang and one reclined. Water in the foreground. Hillock, trees, and clouds are in the background. Flower creeper design in gold on blue band around the painting. A plain golden band around the painting. Flower patterns in medallion panels in red, green, white in the margin in gold. Specimen of calligraphy by Abdullah-al-Hussein, Arabic inscription with Persian verses around. Plain golden band and creeper design borders around one seal in the margin not legible.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccan style towards left in hunting scene. A deer was shot dead by an archer. A princess standing by his side four deer running away. Towards left a prince riding on horse by five attendants standing around him while one drinking water. A number of servants in an attendance some of them with bows, falcons etc. In the background army parade and at the top right corner yogis before their huts. Plain golden band around the painting. Gold spray on top and bottom.

artworks.title: Yogi and Yoginis in Conversations
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A Yogi seated at the door of his cottage in the forest. A rosary around his neck and a rosary in his left hand. A Jogan seated on a tiger skin with a bag in her lap under a tree. A devotee seated on either side of her, the one near the yogi holding a flower in the right hand. Flowers, fly-whisk, water vessel, fire, bags and a dog in the foreground. Trees and sky in the background. Creeper in between plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Inscription in the arc plain golden band on top. A king riding on a horse in the forest holding a spear in his right hand and the reins in the left. A quiver and bow hanging by his side. Four fairies in the sky. Flower plants in the foreground. Building and sea side in the background. Plain golden bands around the painting with golden creeper design band in the middle. Floral pattern above and below the inscriptions. Medallion panels painted red, green, blue and gold with creeper design and some with birds in the margin.

artworks.title: Ladies Playing Sparklers
artworks.description: Painting depicting two ladies standing with burning sparklers in their left hands and the third behind them holding a tray. Gold and leafy and flower creeper borders around. Golden flower designs in margin. Specimen of calligraphy on back Begins with: Ends on:

artworks.title: Nobles Seated in Courtyard
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Inscriptions at the bottom (work of Bishandas). A noble seated on a carpet with a bolster at his back in the courtyard of the place. An attendant standing behind him holding a kerchief in his right hand and back by his left. Chiefs seated either side before him. One of them holds a kerchief in his left hand and a dagger tied up at his waist. The other with a sword tied up at his left. A spittoon placed on a tray before them. Two nobles seated before him, on e of them holding a paper in his left hand. Three attendants standing on the right side. One is holding a fly-whisk, the other with a sword and the third with a staff. Fountain in the foreground.

artworks.title: Portrait of King
artworks.description: Portrait of a king standing with jewels in raised right hand, kattar at his waist and sword hanging by his left. Sun set effect shown on top. Golden flower creeper around golden floral designs in margin. Calligraphy on back by Muhammad arif-ul-hussain.

artworks.title: King Riding on Horse Back
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A king riding on horse holding the reins in left hand spear in vertical position. A dagger at his waist and a sword hanging by his side. Grassy lands on foreground and cloudy at top. Flower creeper design on pink band around the painting. Floral pattern in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King
artworks.description: Portrait of a bearded king standing with flower in left hand, sword in right hand and kattar at his waist. Green background. Typically painted top.Flower creeper border.

artworks.title: Portrait of Nobleman
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style without inscription on the top right corner: Painting representing a noble man standing with a red cloth with a deer and birds patterns on the shoulder. The handle of the sword is seen over it and the tassels hanging in front. A dagger tied up at the waist. Creeper design and plain golden band around the painting. Gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Yogi and Yoginis in Conversations
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A cottage of a Saivaite-Yogi. Two men seated on tiger skin under the tree before the cottage. A lady with musical instrument, a prince and a noble sitting in front of them. Two ladies preparing bhang and burning fire in the foreground. Beyond the fence flower plants. Building in the background towards left. Floral design pattern in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King (Jahangir )
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Jahangir seated on throne with canopy resting at the bolster. An attendant with a fly-whisk standing behind him. Three men standing towards his right and four towards left one of them conveying his compliments. Trees are seen behind the parapet. Sky blue background color damaged on top towards left corner and below the throne. Plain golden band around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Shahjahan Nashtah Ba Hamrah Malaan
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription at the top. A king seated on a carpet holding a wine cup in his right hand with a bolster at back and pillows on either side of him. An attendant holding a fly-whisk in his right hand and a dagger tied up at his waist, standing behind him. Three noble men seated in front and one of them tied up a kattar at his waist putting his hands on his thighs. Musical instrument, flagon, vases, ewer, spittoon placed before them. A sword lying beside the king. Fountain in the foreground. Trees and sky at the background.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Painting of a hunting scene. A noble man on the horse back holding a spear in his right hand and the reins of the horse with his left. Wearing a black coat with a leaf design in gold color. A kattar tied up at his waist. Three followers standing behind a flock of deer in the foreground.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajput style with inscription at the bottom towards right. A lady standing with one flower in each hand. Background golden. Plants and birds in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Princess with Her Friend
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A princess standing very close to her friend with her left arm on her shoulder. The lady is offering wine cup to the prince holding the flagon in her left. Background pink. Plain golden band around the painting. Floral pattern in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: The miniature picture is decorated with gold in the Mughal style. A noble man is depicted standing, holding a cup in his right hand and a staff in his left. He also has a dagger tied up at his waist. The painting features a creeper design and a plain golden band around it.

artworks.title: Portrait of King
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription at the lower right corner. A king standing with a straight sword in right hand and fly whisk in his left. A dagger with a ram's head handle hanging by his side. Plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Nobleman
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription on the top right corner: A noble man standing with a red cloth with a deer and birds patterns on the shoulder. The handle of the sword is seen over it and the tassels hanging in front. A dagger tied up at the waist. Creeper design and plain golden band around the painting. Gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: A Bust of Mughal King, Shahjehan
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A bust of Mughal king, Shahjehan holding an amulet in his left hand dressed in white with flower patterns. Decorative flower plants and creeper design parapet in the foreground. Flower creeper design in gold on blue band. Light green and golden bands around the painting. Stained marble like design in margin.

artworks.title: Cock Fight
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style. Cock fight. A prince seated keeping his sword and kattar on pillow watching a cock fight with his nobles, a musical band is also there. Other men witnessing the fight standing around the platform. A cock on the basket on either side. Other enjoying huqqa and bhang. Fountain and garden in the foreground. Three pavilions and trees in the background.

artworks.title: Portrait of Emperor Jahangir
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription. Jahangir holding a globe in his right hand with his left hand on the handle of the sword in standing position. Plain golden bands around the painting. Flower plants in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A hunting scene. A prince aiming at a deer with his gun another standing behind with a sword. Two deers and an antelope ran in their front. Pond in the foreground and sky in the background. Golden flower creeper design on blue band around the painting. Floral patterns in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A prince in golden dress standing with a bow and arrow in his hand and kattar tied up at his waist. White and blue bands with creeper design in gold around the painting. Patterns of the flower plants in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Prince Jahangir
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Prince Jahangir seated before Salim Christi. The sufi seated and holding a rosary in his right and a book in his left hand. Books, ink-pot and pen places before them. A cat near the left corner at the bottom. Hillock with tombs on the river bank in the background. Creeper design band round the painting.

artworks.title: Bust of a Lady
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Raj-put style. A bust of a lady who is holding a cup in her right hand and a flower in left hand. Creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: The framed miniature painting is in the Mughal style. A noble figure is depicted dressed in white with a golden vertical line on their clothing, which appears to be in a folding position. The noble also holds a scroll in a standing position. The painting features plain golden and creeper design bands around its edges, adding an ornate touch. A gold sprinkled margin further enhances the overall aesthetic of the piece.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A bearded noble man standing dressed in white with a jambia (kattar) at his waist and a sword hanging by his left. Golden background. Creeper design against green band in between plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in gold and blue in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Saint with Others
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Indo-Persian style with inscription at the bottom: A saint seated under a tree holding a stick. Three fairies standing before him, two of them holding dishes and one an ewer. Another fairy holding a dish in flying position. Rocky land in the foreground and clouds in the background. Creeper design and plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription towards left on top. An old man dressed in white holding a straight sword in right hand, a curved sword hanging by his side and a Kattar tied up in his waist in standing position. Plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of King
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription at the lower right corner. An old king in standing position holding a stick in his right hand a quiver tied up at his waist. Plants and birds in gold against purple band around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold in margin.

artworks.title: An Antelope
artworks.description: The subject of this miniature painting is an antelope, depicted standing upright with a distinctive feature - a bell hanging at her neck and a red bridle. The foreground of the painting features small plants, adding a touch of natural scenery to the composition. The frame itself is adorned with black and golden bands, which add a decorative element to the piece. A gold spray in the margin adds an additional layer of ornamentation to the overall design of the painting, further emphasizing its Mughal style.

artworks.title: Lady Under a Tree
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Raj-put style. A landscape: a lady seated under a tree on the bank of a river turned herself looking towards left leaning on her left hand. Two boats and two squirrels on the tree. Pond and grassy land in the foreground, river and sky in the background. Red and blue bands with flower creeper designs and leaf design around the painting. Gold spray in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Emperor Jahangir
artworks.description: The miniature painting is done in the Mughal style. Jahangir is depicted standing, holding a globe in his right hand and his left on the sword which is tied up at his waist. The painting features a creeper design and a plain golden band around it. A floral pattern adorns the margin of the painting.

artworks.title: An Old Bearded Man
artworks.description: Miniature painting in deccani style. Bhang drinkers are depicted in this scene, including an old bearded fellow selling bhang at his shop. The painting also shows men enjoying bhang and huqqa, as well as a beggar and a hawker present in the scene. The miniature is framed with plain and grey bands featuring golden bands in between.

artworks.title: Lady Standing
artworks.description: Framed painting in Indo-Persian style. A lady standing in a meadow under a tree smoking huqqa. The huqqa is placed on a stool in front of her. Blue background. Flower creeper designs in gold against green background in between plain golden bands on top and bottom. Flower creeper design in gold white and blue in margin.

artworks.title: Emperor Akbar on Throne
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Akbar seated on a throne holding a rosary in his hands and a dagger tied up at his waist. An old bearded man holding a Kerchief standing before him. An attendant holding a fly-whisk at his back. Plants and flowers in foreground. A scene of a sunset at the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Floral creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Grandee Riding on Horse Back
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting based on Indo-Persian style. A grandee riding on a white horse with a falcon on his right hand holding the reins in left hand. Two men following him one with a sword on his shoulder and the other holding fly-whisk of peacock feathers in his left hand. Flower creeper design on the top and at the bottom. A marble band around the painting. gold sprinkle margin.

artworks.title: Calender Scene
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. An Indian calender scene. A cow standing on a fish in the water with a globe stand on her head. A king standing on the globe shooting a bird seated on human head resting on a staff with an arrow. A vase on a stand with flowers behind him. Two fairies flouting in the clouds. Creeper design border round the painting. Another border with creeper design and the decorative panels. Flower creeper design in the margin.

artworks.title: Doe (Female Deer)
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A doe (female deer)in black in standing position. Red, black and gold bands around the painting. Gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Noble
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A bearded nobleman standing dressed in white with a Kattar at his waist and a sword hanging by his left. Golden background. Creeper design against green band in between plain golden band around the painting. Flower plants in gold and blue in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription at the lower right corner. A noble man standing with a kattar at his waist and a curved sword and shield hanging by his left. Background light green. Creeper design and plain golden band around the painting. Gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Prince and Princess with Attandnats
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription at the top near the tree. On the top floor of the pavilion a prince and princess with a maid are seen. In the ground floor two ladies standing in the door. A lady offering wine to a young man seated on the plat-form and old woman holding a saucer and rosary sitting beside her. Armed men seated around some of them smoking huqqa and two of them fighting before wine shop. Plain golden band around the painting. Stars pattern on the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Sufi Busy in Writing and a Lady Observing
artworks.description: Framed miniature Indo-Persian painting. A Sufi seated on a carpet under a tree busy in writing, perhaps a charm for the lady standing behind him. Creeper design band around the painting. Floral design in gold and red in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Lady
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A lady seated on a carpet resting on a bolster with a pillow on her folded legs holding a cup in her right hand. Flagon, fruits dish and betel box in the tray before her. Grey and pink bands with different flowers creeper designs around the painting. Flower creeper along the edge of white margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Rajput style. A lady holding a wine cup seated before her husband. A flagon, a dish and a spittoon are seen on the carpet. Two ladies one with a guitar and the other clapping seated in front of them. Trees in the background. Creeper design and plain golden bands around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: The framed miniature painting is in the Mughal style. An old man dressed in white is depicted, with a Kattar tied up in his waist and holding a staff in a standing position. The painting features a plain golden band and creeper design around it, as well as flower plants in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Lady with Fly-wheel
artworks.description: Framed miniature sketch of a lady with fly-wheel. Creeper design against blue background between plain golden band. Sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Elephant Fighting
artworks.description: The artwork features a framed miniature sketch of an elephant fight. Two men are seated on each elephant, with one man holding a goad in hand. Additionally, two other men can be seen standing at the lower corner, armed with flaming sticks. A group of spectators is observing the scene from the right side. The painting is adorned with a plain golden band and features gold sprinkled along its margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble
artworks.description: Framed miniature sketch, decorated with gold inscription. A noble seated resting on bolster with pillow on either side and a sword in front under a canopy on which dragon with a goat has been drawn. Building and trees in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Flower creeper with birds in gold in the margin with four medallion panels in blue and gold at corners.

artworks.title: Fight Between Rustam and White Demon
artworks.description: Framed miniature sketch. Fight between Rustam and white demon. Rustam holding the demon by his horn going to stab a dagger. Creeper design band against grey background.

artworks.title: Portrait of Noble Man
artworks.description: Miniature painting (framed in double glass)in Mughal style. A noble standing, putting his right hand on the kattar's handle and his left on the shield hanging at the left. A sword too hanging at his left. Top: cloudy sky, green in the middle, grassy and flower plants in the foreground. Geometrical designs in gold around the painting.

artworks.title: Jodhabai
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Rajput style with inscriptions. A Lady in dancing style with Fly-whisk, turning towards the right. The painting features a flower creeper design in gold on a blue band around it. The margin is adorned with gold sprinkles.

artworks.title: Ibrahim Adil Shah on Horse
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top between the forelegs below the trunk and jhool: A king riding on an elephant. Mahout holding the goad in both his hands. Red carpet with floral design spread over the elephant with a band and three necklace. Plain golden band around the painting. Grey margin.

artworks.title: Seated Man in Meditation
artworks.description: The subject of this framed miniature painting is a bearded man who is seated on the floor under an arch. He appears to be in deep meditation, surrounded by a serene environment that includes a parapet, trees, and a sky in the background. The painting features plain golden bands around its edges and has gold sprinkled along its margin.

artworks.title: Seated King on a Carpet
artworks.description: Framed Mughal miniature painting. Deccani based on Mughal style. A king seated on a carpet with a pillow on either side holding a book in his hands. Background green.

artworks.title: Portrait of a King
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A prince standing with a falcon in his right hand holding the string with the tassels in left hand. A dagger with ram's head handle at his waist. Background grey. Golden around the painting. A prince wearing two pearl necklaces.

artworks.title: Shaikh Ovais Qurni
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Deccani painting in Mughal style with inscription in gold. SHAIKH OVAIS QURNI (Earliest Ancestor of SalarJung Family) A old Sufi seated holding a book in both his hands. Foreground green with star pattern in gold. Background golden with clouds above, red, green, and golden bands around the painting. Floral designs and birds painting against the golden background.

artworks.title: Shaikh Ovais Qurni
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Deccani painting in Mughal style with inscription in gold. SHAIKH OVAIS QURNI (Earliest Ancestor of Salar Jung Family) A old Sufi seated holding a book in both his hands. Foreground green with star pattern in gold. Background golden with clouds above, red, green, and golden bands around the painting. Floral designs and birds painting against the golden background.

artworks.title: Miniature Painting
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with Persian verses in praise of the king on back with heading: beginning with: ending on: A king resembling Akbar I seated on a throne under a canopy holding a dagger by his left hand and giving something to a Nobleman by his right. Noblemen are standing on either side or a bearded man holding a fruit dish standing before him. Floral designs in the foreground, Creeper design border round the painting. Birds and flower plants in the margin.

artworks.title: Portrait of Alamgir Badshah
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting based on Deccani and Mughal style with inscriptions at top: A king riding on horse holding a flower in his right and reins in the left hand. Two attendants holding spears in front. Two men on either side. Two of them holding fly-whisk one holding chatter and the other an emblem (Marata-b). Sunset scene in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Floral pattern in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Polo Match
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting Mughal style with inscriptions: A polo match: Seven men on horseback playing polo in the foreground three facing the other three and one in the background with a flagon drinking water while an attendant standing in front and by his side cavaliers witnessing the game. A garden with a turret on each corner an elephant on the right and a camel in the left in the background. Margin stained like that of marble.

artworks.title: Portrait of Shams Tabrez
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription: A Sufi seated near a pond holding a book in his right hand and a fish in his left hand.Lotus flowers and fishes in the foreground. Cloudy at the top. Plain golden band around the painting. Medallion panel in the margin.

artworks.title: Garmaza Basan Nira Sheran Az Hurz Dan Karz Wa Teer Wa Shamsheer Nastaliq Script
artworks.description: The framed miniature painting is in the Mughal style. It depicts a nude man seated under a tree, surrounded by a serene natural setting that includes a pond, hillock, and trees in the background. The painting features intricate details such as a leafy design and a plain golden band around it, adding to its aesthetic appeal. A gold spray is visible in the margin of the painting, further enhancing its ornate beauty.

artworks.title: Persian Couplets
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with Persian verses around the painting. Beginning with :........... Ending on: ............ Devanagari script at the bottom. A prince standing with a wine cup in his right hand and flagon in the other. A dagger at his waist. Trees are in the background. Two bands with different flower creeper design around the painting.

artworks.title: Majnu in the Jungle
artworks.description: The framed miniature painting is in the Mughal style. Majnu is depicted in the jungle, surrounded by wild animals. The frame features a plain and creeper design in gold against a dark green band around the painting. Floral patterns in gold adorn the margin of the artwork.

artworks.title: Portrait of Akbar
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Akbar seated with three men in front and servant standing behind. An European offering something to a Prince in the foreground. Building on the hills on the background. Creeper design and plain golden bands around the painting. Shikargah scenes in the margin.

artworks.title: Hunting Expedition
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscriptions. A hunting expedition in a hilly country. Men on elephant and on horseback and others seen on hill. The man on elephant is taking the prey, a deer from the man standing below. A man is seen with a rabbit another with a flapping falcon. River in the foreground. Trees, hillock, and sky in the background. Plain green band around the painting. Flower plants in the margin. (Predominantly under European influence).

artworks.title: Nizam a Water Carrier Carring King Humayun
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. Nizam, the water carrier carrying a king, Humayun in full Armour seated on the back of Nizam. It tree on the left and hills in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold and blue in margins.

artworks.title: Hunting Expedition
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A hunting expedition. Five men on two elephants, three men on horseback and four pedestrians in the foreground with spears in the middle, a king riding on horse with several servants. A lion is seen in the middle towards right. In the background boats in the river with buildings on its bank. Creeper design against green background in between plain golden bands around the painting. Floral patterns in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Jahangir's Darbar
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Raj-put style. Jahangir's Darbar. Jahangir seated on the throne under a canopy. Five persons are standing on either side of the throne. Jahangir awarding a rosary to a noble standing before him. Two men holding staffs in their hands in a standing position in front while the other two holding a flagon and a wine cup in their hands. A group of five men standing at the right side of the throne, one of them is holding a pencil and a book in his hands. Two mahouts seated on elephants. Flower creeper design in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. A hunting scene. A king riding on horse killing a stag with his sword, a dead deer lying near lower left corner. Six men two with guns seen in the hillocks. A Prince on piebald horse with a falcon in his right hand coming through the hillock. Pond in the foreground and sky on the background. Flower creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper design in gold with four decorative panels in margin.

artworks.title: Timur Seated
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style with inscription at the top. Timur seated on throne under a canopy holding spear in his right hand. A man holding chatter standing behind him. Nobles standing on either side. The party on his right with various types of spears has brought Bayazid, a prisoner before Timur. A decorative band with creeper design around the painting.White flower pattern in margin.

artworks.title: Game of Polo
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Persian style. A game of polo. A king and three other nobles on horseback, two men on foot. A man with trumpet and the other two with drums in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Rocks, plants and birds in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Akbar and Three Men on Horse Back
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Akbar and three men on horse back. An elephant in kneeling position, treasure boxes being loaded. A fort in the background. Creeper design and plain golden bands around the painting. Flower plants in gold in the margin.( An adaptation from Akbar nama).

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Framed miniature painting in Mughal style. Another view of painting No. XXXI-79. A hunting scene in a hilly country, men on elephant and on the horse back and others seen in hill. The man on elephant is taking the prey, a deer from the man standing below. A man is seen with a rabbit another with flapping falcon. In the middle a man is seen behind antelope. Fort and hillocks in the background. Creeper design in gold on dark blue in between plain golden bands. Flower plants in black and gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Lalita Ragini
artworks.description: Painting of Lalita Ragini. A bed room scene showing a reclining lady and her lover standing at a distance holding a mala in his left hand and looking at her in a building under a canopy with garden at the back and seven birds on the top border with floral design in gold on a pink background. Persian inscription at the top with floral designs in gold color on all sides.

artworks.title: Ragini Gorjari,
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in Persian in the decorative panel on top: A lady seated on a cot with a bolster at the back playing on veena. A lady on either side one being seated in front and the other standing behind holding a fly-whisk in left hand. A peacock standing in front near parapet. Building , trees, flower plants and birds in the background. Parapets, flower plants and fountain in the foreground. Border : Creeper design on rose blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Margin: Leafy patterns in gold.

artworks.title: Madhu Madhavi Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of 'Madhu Madhavi Ragini'. A lady standing on a terrace looking at the sky, two wavy lines on the top depicting lightning. Foreground with flowers and leaves. Border with floral design on a pink background. Gold color floral design on all sides with Persian inscription at the top.

artworks.title: Bararo Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Bararo Ragini : Lovers standing on a terrace of a palace. Lover embracing his sweetheart with his left hand and with right hand holding her cheek. Eight birds on the top. Border with floral design in gold color floral design on all sides with Persian inscription on the top.

metadata.title2: Lovers Standing on a Terrace of a Palace

artworks.title: Ragini Asavari
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in Persian on top : Two female snake charmer's seated on rocks and playing on snake charmer's flute (pungi) in the forest. Due to the melodious notes snakes bewitching before her. Trees, grassy land, birds and sky in the background. Pond and lotus flowers in foreground. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. flower creeper in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Ragini Bengali Painting
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in Persian in the decorative panel on top : A pious lady engaged in worshiping, seated on a carpet, holding a rosary in her right hand. Three lighted lamps placed around the shrine and the necessaries of pooja before her. A lady attendant standing behind her holding a fly-whisk in her right hand. Hillock, trees, birds and buildings in the background. Lotus flowers and pond in the foreground. Flower on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Kumudni Ragni
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Kumudni Ragni. A lady standing in a landscape, her head slightly bent towards her right and looking at a rabbit. Two squirrels climbing the tree and thirteen birds on the top, foreground depicting a pond. Border with wavy design on pink background and floral design in gold on all sides with a Persian inscription on the top.

artworks.title: Young Lady Feeding to Peacock
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in Persian in the decorative panel on top : A young lady feeding to peacock standing under the mango tree. Squirrels, trees, birds, hillocks and sky in the background. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Leafy patterns in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Ragini Kahtach, Nastaliq Script
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in the decorative panel on top : Brahma seated in the courtyard of the temple. Three devotees, two on right side and one on left in a sitting position. Flower plants, trees, birds and sky in the background, parapets, steps and plants in the foreground. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Vaisakhi Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of a Vaisakhi Ragini. Five persons, two of them wrestling and one holding a bow. Eight birds on the top. Border with floral design in gold on a pink background. Persian inscription on top and all sides with floral design in gold color.

artworks.title: Pancham Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Pancham Ragini. Three ladies seated in a building with garden on the back and eleven birds at the top. The lady on the right side holding a tamboora in her right hand. The lady in the center seated on a cushion with her head bent towards her left side. A pond in the foreground with flowers, border with " Ardhachandra " design in gold color on a pink background. A Persian inscription on the top and floral design in gold color on all sides.

artworks.title: Pancham Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Pancham Ragini. Three ladies seated in a building with garden on the back and eleven birds at the top. The lady on the right side holding a tamboora in her right hand. The lady in the center seated on a cushion with her head bent towards her left side. A pond in the foreground with flowers, border with " Ardhachandra " design in gold color on a pink background. A Persian inscription on the top and floral design in gold color on all sides.

artworks.title: Malvi Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting showing Ragini Malvi. A couple standing on the terrace of a palace with garden on the back and five birds at the top. The lover embracing his sweet-heart by his left hand.

artworks.title: Kalki Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A princess seated on a chair in the courtyard of the place holding a lotus stalk in her right hand. A lady attendant seated besides her holding a wine cup in her right hand. Two flagons and jug are placed in a tray beside her chair. A lady attendant holding a lotus flower in her left hand standing beside the fountain in front. Flower plants trees and fountain in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting.

artworks.title: Gouri Ragini on Bairagh
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top : A lady holding the flower creepers in her hands standing in the garden. Parapets, canopies, trees and flower plants in the background. Parapets, fountain, flower plants and trees in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red ground in gold in the margin, white, black and golden lines around the margin.

artworks.title: Megh Mallahar Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top : A lady holding a guitar in her hand standing in the forest beside a tree.Five peacocks standing around her and one sitting on a tree bending its head towards the lady. Grassy lands, trees, hillocks and clouds in the background. Trees, plants, birds, lotus flowers and pond in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Rag Megh Mallahar
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top : Two wrestlers are wrestling in front. An archer holding a bow in his hands in a standing position. A wrestling in Indian club and the other sitting on the other side. Weighting on the other side. Weights and bars in front side. A wrestler descending from a pole. Trees, grassy land and building at the background. Flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Malkus Ragini
artworks.description: Lord Krishna seated on throne with a bolster at his back. A devotee standing before going to touch his garland. A lady attendant standing behind him is holding a fly-whisk in her right hand. Two ladies seated before him with musical instruments in their hands. A lady seated at the left corner holding a roll in her hands. Two shamadans with lighted candles placed in front. Flower plants, fountains, trees, grassy land and sky in the background. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in the margin. White, black and golden lines around the margin.

artworks.title: Shyam Kalyan Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A princess seated on a carpet, a bolster at her back, a pillow beside and a garland around her neck holding with her hand. a lady attendant going to put the burning candle in the shamadan. Fountain, canopy, flower plants, trees and sky in the background. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design against light red in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Lord Siva and Parvathi Enjoying Music
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in the decorative panel on top:- Lord Siva seated on a cot with a bolster at his back and a pillow beside him. Six snakes have twisted around his body, one on the head around the knot of the hair, another around the neck and one on either arm and one on either arm and on both the hands. Parvati is seated in front of him. Spittoon, betel box and tray before them. Three ladies standing behind the parapet, one holding a fan another with a fly-whisk and the third with fruit tray. Two ladies seated beside the parapets one with a veena. A lady seated at the right corner beside the parapet preparing a drink. Flower plants, trees and birds in the background. Parapets and flower plants in between medallion creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Purbi Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: Two ladies seated on a carpet under a canopy. A betel box in a tray and a spittoon before them. Trees and grassy land in the background. Flower plants and fountain in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Leafy pattern on light red in gold in the margin. White, black and golden bands around the margin.

artworks.title: Bhairavi Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A lady seated in the temple worshiping Linga and the material for pooja placed beside her. Another lady seated beside the steps holding a guitar in her hands and a bull seated before her. A lady with folded hands in the courtyard of the temple. Lotus flowers, pond, trees and sky in the background. Grass, pond and birds in the foreground. Plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Hindol Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on the top: A Sadhu seated on a hillock under a tree before his hermitage. A disciple standing behind him holding a fly-whisk in his right hand. Another disciple seated beside the down-stairs of the hillock, a book in his hands. A water vessel and a book before him. Three ladies standing before the Sadhu, one is holding a baby in her hands and the other two with folded hands. Lotus flowers, pond, trees and buildings in the background. Lotus flowers, pond and birds in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting.

metadata.title2: A Sadhu Seated on a Hillock

artworks.title: Karthik Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: Two ladies in the forest, one is playing on her violin and the other standing before her. Trees, hillocks and clouds in the background. Plants, lotus flowers and pond in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in margin.

artworks.title: Ragini Malkus
artworks.description: Lord Krishna holding the hand of a Gopi from behind and going to break the pitcher which is on her head. Two Gopika's carrying pitchers on their heads looking at them in a standing position. Trees, grassy land, hillocks, buildings & sky in the background. Plants, lotus flowers & pond in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper on light red ground in gold in the margin. White, black and golden lines around the margin.

artworks.title: A Lady Seated on Lotus Shape
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A lady seated on lotus shape Daree under a tree holding a bow and arrow in her hands looking towards right. A garland around her neck. Lotus flower, pond, ducks, trees, hillocks, building & clouds in the background. Lotus flower, pond, trees & hillocks in foreground. Creeper design on the blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper on light band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: A Lover and Beloved Standing Closely
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A lover and beloved standing closely and putting hands around their necks. A lady attendant standing beside a cot putting her hands on a pillow. Two pillows on carpet in the verandah canopy fountain, flower plants, trees & grassy land in the background. Flower plants & fountain in foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Devagandhar Ragini
artworks.description: Painting showing Devagandhar Ragini. A Yogini seated on a tiger skin under a tree. A boy seated in front of the Yogini. A tiger seated on the right side of the Yogini. Three squirrels on the tree and nine birds shown on the top. A Persian inscription on the top.

metadata.title2: A yogini seated on a tiger skin

artworks.title: Paramour Touching
artworks.description: Paramour touching the feet of his beloved who is seated on a cot in the verandah. Naika standing on either side and pleading to gain her favour. Fountain, flower plants, trees, canopy & sky in the background. Flower plants in the foreground.Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden band around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: A King Seated on a Throne
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A king seated on a throne with a bolster at his back under a canopy. A lady singing some song sitting in front is holding a musical instrument in her hand. A mythological figure seated beside her holding flowers in the hands. Two lady attendants standing behind the king, one lady holding fly-whisk and another lady holding a lotus bud in their hands. Two ladies standing beside the fountain one of them hold a covered tray in her hands. Trees, grassy land, building and sky in the background. Fountains, and flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design against blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design against light red gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Prince and Princess
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A prince and princess seated closely on bed under a canopy holding a bow in his hand and aiming at the cock. A shamadan with a candle in front on the floor. Flower plants, trees & sky in the background. Steps & flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. creeper design on light red in gold margin.

artworks.title: Princess with an Old Attendant
artworks.description: Miniature painting Deccani style with Inscription: Being feared by the thunder & lightening, the princess running into the palace and an old attendant consoling her. Trees, flower plants, canopy & clouds in the background. Flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red in gold in the margin. White , Black and gold lines around the margin.

artworks.title: King and His Attendant
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A king standing on the hillock holding a sword in his right hand and a shield in his left hand. A sword hanging on his left side. Two soldiers standing in front holding spears in their hands, shields and swords hanging on their left side. A dead elephant lying on the lower ground. Hillock & sky in the background. Plants and grass in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in the margin. White, black and golden lines around the margin.

artworks.title: Kedara Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: Kedara Ragini(Hindol)Two ladies sitting under a tree, one is playing on her violin and the other enjoying it holding an arm-rest in her right hand. Trees, birds, grassy land, lotus flowers, ducks, pond and the sky in the background. Fire, flower plants & steps in the foreground. Creeper design against light red in gold in the margin.

metadata.title2: Two Ladies Sitting Under a Tree

artworks.title: Madhu Madhavi Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A Raja lying on bed with a pillow under his arm resting his head on his right hand and a garland in his left. A basin and a ewer in front. A youth being brought by an elderly woman who is holding a staff in her right hand and putting her left at the back of the other. The youth seems to be afraid of the situation. Trees and sky in the background. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting.

metadata.title2: Raja Lying on Bed with a Pillow Under His Arm

artworks.title: Woman Snake Charmer Seated Under a Tree
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A woman snake charmer seated under a tree in the forest and playing on her musical pipe. Being affected by the melodious music snakes gathering around. A woman seated on a rock under a tree and holding its branch with her right hand. Pond, trees, lotus flowers & grassy land in the background. Rocks, lotus flowers and trees in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light green band in gold in the margin. White and black lines around the margin.

artworks.title: Rag Bhairavi
artworks.description: The painting depicts Lord Siva seated against a pillow on a bed. He is accompanied by a girl devotee who is listening to music in front of him. Two lady attendants stand beside them, one holding a fan and the other a fly-whisk. A Hindi inscription can be seen at the top of the painting.

metadata.title2: Lord Siva Seated Against a Pillow on a Bed with a Girl Devotee

artworks.title: Bhairavi Rag
artworks.description: Painting of Bhairavi Rag. A kneeling lady worshipping the Linga near a lake with her maid standing at a distance holding a water jug in her right hand and a plate in her left hand. Border in gold and dark blue color with an inscription in Hindi at the top.

metadata.title2: A Kneeling Lady Worshiping the Linga near a Lake

artworks.title: Malvi Ragini
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of two women, one seated and one standing. The seated lady holds lotuses in her hands, while the standing lady is holding lilies. They are positioned on the terrace of a building. The border of the painting features gold and dark blue colors, with an inscription at the top written in Hindi.

metadata.title2: A Lady Seated on a Chair with Lotuses in Her Hands

artworks.title: Ramkali Ragni
artworks.description: Painting of Ragni Ramkali. A lady seated on a couch with her lover prostrated himself at her and a lady holding shoulders, border in gold and dark blue color and an Hindi inscription at the top.

metadata.title2: A Lady Seated on a Couch and Her Lover Prostrated Himself at Her

artworks.title: Vibhas Ragni
artworks.description: The painting depicts Vibhas Ragni. A bed room scene shows a reclining couple embracing each other, with two candle stands, two wine cups, and decanters in the foreground. The border of the painting is in gold and dark blue color. An inscription at the top is written in Hindi.

artworks.title: Deepak Rag
artworks.description: Painting showing Deepak Rag. Krishna with his consort seated, turned towards her and holding a mirror in his right hand. A lady standing behind them with a fly-whisk in her right hand and two ladies standing at a distance one with a Mridang. Border in gold and dark blue color with an inscription in Hindi at the top.

metadata.title2: Lord Krishna Seated with His Consort

artworks.title: Nat Ragni
artworks.description: Painting showing Nat Ragni. An armed man wearing red dress on the horse back fighting with a man in white dress standing on the floor and an another man fallen on the floor. Border in gold and dark blue color with an Hindi inscription at the top.

artworks.title: Hindol Rag
artworks.description: Painting showing Hindol Rag. Krishna seated in a swing listening to music. Two ladies on the right side of which one with a stringed instrument, two ladies on the left side of which one with a Mridang. Three peacocks on the top of the swing. A garden at the back and inscription in Hindi on the top.

artworks.title: Patmanjari Ragni
artworks.description: Painting showing Patmanjari Ragni. A lady wearing a brown dress with flower design seated against a cushion and a lady seated in front of her, in a palace. Two pillows, two small cups and two vases on one side. Border with gold and dark blue colors. Hindi inscription at the top.

artworks.title: Lalit Ragni
artworks.description: The painting depicts Lalit Ragni, a scene of a lady reclining on a bed. She is accompanied by her lover, who stands at a distance looking at her. He holds a mala (garland) in his right hand. The border of the painting features gold and dark blue colors, adding to its aesthetic appeal. An inscription in Hindi is written at the top of the painting, providing additional context or information about the artwork.

artworks.title: Malkaus Rag
artworks.description: Painting showing Rag Malkaus. A Prince seated against a pillow on a chair and a lady standing behind him with a fly-whisk in her left hand and two female musicians seated in front of him with a Mridang and stringed instrument (Tambura). Border in gold and dark blue color and an inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Gowri Ragni
artworks.description: The painting depicts Gowri Ragni, a woman standing by a pond in a contemplative mood. She is holding a spike of flowers in her left hand and a garland in her right hand, surrounded by a landscape that sets the scene for her introspective state. The border of the painting features intricate designs in gold and dark blue colors, adding to its aesthetic appeal. An inscription in Hindi can be seen at the top of the painting, providing additional context or information about the artwork.

artworks.title: Khambavati Ragni
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Khambavati Ragni. A lady worshipping Lord Brahma with manuscripts in his three hands and offering ablution with his fourth. Hindi verses on top.

artworks.title: Ragni Malvi
artworks.description: The miniature painting depicts Ragni Malvi, featuring a couple standing by the side of a bed. The husband is embracing his wife with his left hand and holding a rosary in his right hand, with his face turned towards his sweetheart. An inscription in Hindi can be seen at the top of the painting.

artworks.title: Ragni Bilawal
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Ragni Bilawal. A lady seated on the bed doing make-up. A lady standing in front of her and holding a mirror, with an inscription at the top in Hindi.

artworks.title: Todi Ragni
artworks.description: Painting of Todi Ragni. A standing lady playing on a stringed instrument and one deer in front of her and two at the back. An inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Ragni Devagandhara
artworks.description: Painting of Ragni Devagandhar. A Yogi seated on a tiger skin under a tree with a rosary in his right hand and a tiger crouching before. A nude man seated before him with a pad resting on his and holding it with his left hand. Border with gold and dark blue color and an Hindi inscription at the top.
