artworks.title: Nat Ragini Hindol
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A lady attacking her opponent riding on horse back with a shield in her left hand. Her opponent defending with his shield and going to attack with his sword. Another man killed by her. Being defeated a man fell down on the ground holding, a broken sword in his right hand and a shield in his left. His turban lying beside. Trees , hillocks and cloudy sky in the background. Trees , lotus flowers , ducks and pond in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design against light blue in gold in the margin.

metadata.title2: Lady Attacking Her Opponent Riding on Horse Back

artworks.title: Madhu Madhavi Ragni
artworks.description: The painting depicts Madhu Madhavi Ragni, featuring a girl looking up towards the sky with a frightened expression. She is accompanied by another lady standing in front of her on the terrace of a building. The painting's border is adorned with gold and dark blue colors, while an inscription at the top is written in Hindi.

artworks.title: Ragni Dhanasri
artworks.description: Painting of Ragni Dhanasri. A lady seated against a pillow, painting the portrait of her lover with her left knee resting on a pillow and a lady seated in front of her, in a palace. Border with gold and dark blue color, an inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Gunkali Ragni
artworks.description: Painting showing Gunkali Ragni. A lady seated at one corner of the bed holding a flower in her left hand and a lady standing in front of her with a flower in her right hand. Two flower pots on one side. Border in gold and dark blue color. An inscription in Hindi at top.

artworks.title: Kanaro Ragni
artworks.description: Painting showing Kanaro Ragni. Lord Krishna seated on a stone in a landscape with a sword in his left hand and two nobles standing in front of him, with their right hands lifted up and holding a shield and spear in their left hand. An elephant with trunk cut off standing near a tree. Border in gold and dark blue color and inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Vasant Ragni
artworks.description: Painting showing Vasant Ragni. A couple standing in the centre husband embracing his wife with his left hand and looking towards her. Seven ladies in front of them, one with a mridang and the other holding a flower pot, six ladies standing behind, one with a bowl full of color. Holi festival border with gold and dark blue color an inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Rag Barari
artworks.description: Painting of Rag Barari. A couple standing in a palace with a garden at the back. Lover embracing his sweet heart with his left hand and holding her check with his right hand. Border in gold and dark blue color. An inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Ragni Purbi
artworks.description: Painting showing Ragni Purbi. A love stick lady seated against pillow with her hands lifted up and her face bent towards her left side, a lady seated before her with a cup in her hand. Border with gold and dark blue color and an inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Sri Rag
artworks.description: Painting showing Sri Rag. Lord Krishna with his consort listening to music, in a palace with garden at the back. A lady standing behind them with a fly-whisk in her right hand. Two musicians seated in front of them. One with a stringed instrument and the other dressed in. Border in gold and dark blue colors and an inscription at the top in Hindi.

artworks.title: Pancham Ragni
artworks.description: Painting showing Pancham Ragni. A Prince and Princess seated against a pillow looking at each other and enjoying music, in a palace with garden at the back. A lady seated by the side with a stringed instrument in her right hand. Border in gold and dark blue. An inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Asavari Ragni
artworks.description: Painting of Asavari Ragni. A Yogini seated on a rock under a tree playing on a Been(snake charmer's flute) and a man in front of her playing on a pungi(flute) and three snakes. Border in gold and dark blue color. An inscription at the top in Hindi.

artworks.title: Kankari Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in the decorative panel on top: A lady seated on a golden Masnad holding lotus flowers in the courtyard of the palace. Another lady holding a lotus flower in her left hand standing before her. Flower plants, fountain, trees, birds and building in the background. Parapet, steps and flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden rosy band around the painting. Flower creeper in gold in the margin.

metadata.title2: Lady Seated on a Golden Masnad

artworks.title: Deepak Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: Four headed God “ Brahma " seated on a chowki. Two burning lamps before him. Two devotees, one is seated on the right side and the other standing on the left holding a fly-whisk in her right hand. Flowers, trees, buildings & sky are seen through the door. Flower plants, fountain in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Floral pattern on light red in gold in the margin. White , black and golden lines around the margin.

artworks.title: Bengali Ragni
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a Bengali Ragni, a lady seated under a tree in a praying mood. She is surrounded by objects of worship, including a mala, which are placed in front of her. A tiger is also visible at the door of a building in the background. The painting features a border in gold and dark blue color, adding an ornate touch to the artwork. At the top of the painting, there is an inscription written in Hindi.

artworks.title: Kumudeni Ragni
artworks.description: The painting depicts Kumudeni Ragni, a lady adorned with garlands in both hands. She stands in a jungle setting, accompanied by a deer beside her. The border of the painting is rendered in gold and dark blue colors. An inscription at the top is written in Hindi.

artworks.title: Ragni Desakha
artworks.description: Painting of Ragni Desakha. Three persons of which one holding a shield with right hand, another with a rod in his right hand and the third one doing circus. Their clothes and turbans kept at one side. Border in gold and dark blue color and an inscription at the top in Hindi.

artworks.title: Ragni Kedar
artworks.description: Painting of Ragni Kedar. A king listening to music on the way of his palace situated on a lake with a man in front of him holding a stringed instrument. A man seated on the boat and sleeping. Border in gold and dark blue color. Hindi verses at the top. The name of the composer Lal.

artworks.title: Rag Meg Malhar
artworks.description: Painting representing Rag Meg Malhar. Lord Krishna dancing in landscape surrounded by four Gopika's. One Gopika on the right side holding a mridang and one on the left holding a stringed instrument. Border in gold and dark blue color and an inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Ragni Seth Malhar
artworks.description: The painting depicts Ragni Seth Malhar, a yogi seated on a tiger's skin in front of a cave in a jungle. A man is seated in front of him playing on a wind instrument. The border of the painting is in gold and dark blue color, adding an ornate touch to the artwork. An inscription in Hindi can be seen at the top of the painting.

artworks.title: Gujari Ragni
artworks.description: Painting showing Gujari Ragni. A lady seated in a landscape playing on a stringed instrument. Border in gold and dark blue color with an inscription in Hindi on top.

artworks.title: Gouri Ragni
artworks.description: Painting representing Gouri Ragni. A lady seated against a pillow playing on a stringed instrument with an attendant seated in front with a bowl in her hand. Two cups and two decanters in front of her. Border in gold in dark blue color. An inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Ragni Kakubha
artworks.description: The painting depicts Ragni Kankubha, a woman who is feeding a pair of peacocks under a mango tree. She is dressed in a gold-colored skirt with floral designs and stands out against the natural surroundings. The border of the painting features intricate details, including gold and dark blue colors, as well as an inscription in Hindi at the top.

artworks.title: Vasant Ragini, Rag Hindol
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top:A Raja and Rani enjoying music celebrating Holi festival in the courtyard. Some other ladies also taking part. Two ladies on right, three on left playing on their musical instruments. Two ladies standing closely in front, one is holding a syringe in her hands and the other placing her left hand on her cheek. Two ladies standing in front holding syringe in their hands and the third filling her syringe in a vessel. A pitcher , jar and tray in front. Tree and sky in the background. Flower plants and a passage in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden band around the painting creeper on light red band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Todi Ragini, Rag Malkos
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccan style with inscription on top :A lady standing in the forest holding a veena in her hands looking at deer. Two deers standing on either side of her. Grassy land and trees in the background. Grassy land, trees, lotus flower and pond in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Rag Megh Mallhar
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with inscription on top :Lord Krishna dancing in the courtyard of the palace. Five Gopika's holding musical instruments in their hands. Trees, lotus flowers, pond, hillock and building in the background. Fountain and flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting.Floral patterns on light red ground in gold in the margin. White , black and golden lines around the margin.

artworks.title: Hindol Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with inscription :A prince with princess seated in the swing with a veena putting his left hand around her neck and holding her right hand. Two ladies standing on either side of the swing poles one on either side holding the string of the swing and the others with a drum and cymbals. Trees and sky in the background. Steps and flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Rag Bhero
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: Lord Krishna and Radha seated closely putting his hand around her neck holding her right hand and putting his left hand on her breast. A bolster at his back and one pillow on either side, betel box and tray in front. A lady attendant holding fly-whisk in her right hand standing behind them and another seated at the right side beside the pillar, pouring wine into the wine cup. A candle stick with two lighted candle placed before her. Two ladies with musical instruments seated before them under a canopy. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Floral patterns on light red band in gold in the margin. White , black and golden lines around the margin.

artworks.title: Lalit Ragini , Rag Bhero
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with inscription on top:A lady sleeping soundly on a cot under a canopy. A man standing on the carpet holding garlands in his hands looking at her. Two pillows lying on the carpet. Two shamadans with burning candles placed in front. Fountains, flower plants, palm trees and sky in the background. Fountain & flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design against blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design against light red in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Kakub Ragini Rag Malkos
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with inscription on top: A lady playing on her Tamboora near the bank of a pond in the forest. Three peacocks standing in front, fourth on a tree and one on the other side. Trees & grassy lands in the background. Trees, lotus flowers & pond in the foreground. Creeper design on blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Creeper design on light red band in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Kori Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription in Persian in the decorative panel on top : A young lady anxiously waiting for her lover standing in the forest, with the tassels hanging on either side. Squirrels, trees, hillocks, buildings and birds in the background. Lotus flowers and pond in the foreground. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting.flower creeper in gold in the margin.

metadata.title2: Young Lady Anxiously Waiting for Her Lover

artworks.title: Hindol Rag
artworks.description: Painting of Hindol Rag. A couple in the center seated on a swing, three ladies in two groups standing on either side of which three holding musical instruments. A small tank in the foreground, backside with trees and eight birds on the top. Border with floral design in gold color on a pink background and floral design in gold all sides. Persian inscription on the top.

artworks.title: Manbat Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with inscription in Persian in the decorative panel on top: A Raja & Rani enjoying the Holi festival. Three ladies standing before them, one is holding a vase another with tray and the third spraying color. Four ladies standing at their back, two holding trays in their hands and the other two spraying colours to others. Four plants, trees & birds in the background , Flower creeper on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Medallion panels with birds motif in between floral patterns in gold in the margin.

metadata.title2: Raja and Rani Enjoying the Holi Festival with Others

artworks.title: Rag Malkosh
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with inscription in the decorative panel on top: A king and queen seated closely on a throne putting his right hand around her neck and sitting in her lap. Four lady attendants standing behind them, one is holding a fan in her right hand and the other with a fly-whisk in her left hand. Three ladies seated in front, two holding with Tamboora and the rest with symbols in her hand. A chess board lying at the right. Cypress birds , and sky in the background. Parapets and flower plants in the foreground. Creeper design on rosy in between plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Lady Playing
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in deccani style with inscription in Persian in decorative panel on top: A lady playing on her veena standing in the forest. Two deer's standing in front and three behind. Squirrels, trees, hillock, temple and birds in the foreground. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Dancing with Gopikas
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in Deccani style with decorative panel on top: Lord Krishna dancing. Three Gopika's on either side standing with musical instruments. Sky in the background. Parapets, cypress trees, flower plants & fountain in the foreground. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Flower creeper in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Dhanasri Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Dhansair Ragini. A lady seated against a cushion, the portrait of her beloved, with three lady attendants, two of them seated in front of her, and another standing at the back with peacock fly-whisk in her right hand, in a palace with a pond and garden at the back, nine birds and one squirrel at the top portion. Border with floral design in gold colour on a pink background. Persian inscription at the top floral design on all sides.

artworks.title: Kormalhar Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Kormalhar Ragini. Two ladies, one of them seated on a chair and the other seated in front of her with a plate in her hand, in a place with a garden on the back and seven birds at the top , a pond in the foreground. Border with floral design in gold on a pink background. Persian inscriptions at the top with floral designs in gold colour on all sides.

artworks.title: Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in deccani style with inscription in the decorative panel on top: A Jogin in deep meditation seated on tiger's skin under a tree in the forest. Her ardent disciple seated on a rock near the bank of a pond. A king seated on a carpet before her. An attendant standing behind him with a kerchief in his hands. Squirrel, trees, birds, hillocks and buildings in the background. Lotus flowers and pond in the foreground. Flower creeper on rosy band in between plain golden bands in the argin. Leafy pattern in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Ragini Malvi
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Ragini Malvi. A lady seated on a cushion chair with a lily flower in her left hand, with two lady attendants in front of her, one standing and holding lily flowers in her hands, the other seated and holding a portrait, in a palace with gardens in the back and eight birds on the top. Border with floral design in gold colour on all sides.

artworks.title: Ragini Sri-rag
artworks.dimensions: 43.0 L X 29.6 W, 26.9 L X 19.0 W (PIANTING ALONE)
artworks.description: Painting of a Ragini (Sri-Rag). A King & Queen seated on a chair with two lady attendants at the back holding fly-whisk and one lady with a tambura and two men, one of them having mirdang, and the other with horse head, seated in front of them in a palace. Seven birds and three squirrels on the top. 'Ardhachandra' border in gold colors on a pink background. Persian inscriptions at the top with floral design in gold color on all sides.

artworks.title: Attacking Horseman
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in deccani style with inscription in Persian in the decorative panel on top: A horseman attacking with his sword to his opponent, he is too defending with his shield and going to attack with his sword. Two dead bodies of soldiers lying on ground. A lady holding bowl of blood in her left hand at the right corner. Hillock, trees, birds and cloudy sky in the background. Grassy land in the foreground. Creeper on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Leafy pattern in between medallion creeper design in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Lady Holding a Sword in Her Right Hand
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in deccani style with inscription in Persian in the decorative panel on top: A lady holding a sword in her right hand and the sheath in her left hand, seated on a rock. A wounded elephant kneeling before her. Two soldiers standing in front of her, one holding a spear in his left hand. Hillock,trees, building & birds in the background. Lotus flowers in a pond in the foreground. Flower creeper on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Medallion panels with bird motif in between floral pattern in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Prince and Princess
artworks.description: Miniature Painting in deccani style with inscription in decorative panel in Persian on top: A prince and princess seated on throne placed in the courtyard of the palace. A lady attendant standing behind them, holding a fly-whisk in her right hand. Four ladies standing behind them, one is holding a lighted candle in her left hand and the other two with musical instruments and the fourth simply standing. The whole place is illuminated with Deepak's. Trees and sky in the background. Flower plants and fountain in the foreground. Creeper design on rosy band in between plain golden bands around the painting. Decorative panels with birds motif in between leafy patterns in gold in the margin.

artworks.title: Ramkali Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Ramkali Ragini . A lady seated on a stool and lady attenders of which one holding the lover who has prostrated himself at the feet, on the terrace on a palace with gardens at the back and six birds on the top. A squirrel and two birds on the trees. Border with floral design in gold color on a pink background. Gold color floral design on all sides with Persian inscription on the top.

artworks.title: Seth Mallar Ragini
artworks.description: Miniature painting of Seth Mallar Ragini. A Yogini seated on a tiger's skin and a noble in front of her in a landscape. Eleven birds on the top and a squirrel climbing the tree. Border with wavy design in gold color floral design on all sides with Persian inscription on the top.

artworks.title: Rani Jadon
artworks.description: Painting showing a Rani seated against a cushion holding a Huqqa pipe in her left hand and enjoying the music surrounded by her attendants. A dancer in front and six musicians at her back. A sedan chair with four attendants in the foreground. A peacock at distance on the top and a lady seated with a musical instrument in the balcony of a building. Border in dark blue color with an Urdu inscription; at the top and flower designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raja Ram Singh
artworks.description: Painting showing the upper storey of a building wherein a princess is seated against a cushion holding a huqqa pipe in her right hand with two ladies seated in front of her and seven ladies standing while a prince is climbing up a rope assisted from above by an old woman. The princess, attendants with elephants and horses are in the foreground. An inscription at the top and flower and flower designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Raja Rao Sinha
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of nobility, showing a group of men seated in a court setting. They are surrounded by courtiers who stand in front of them, while an attendant is positioned at the back. The painting features a border in dark blue color and includes an inscription at the top. In addition to the inscription, the painting also showcases floral designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raja Ram Singh
artworks.description: Painting showing a princess in procession seated in Howdah with a shield and sword in front of her surrounded by her followers. A bullock-cart with a tiger inside on the foreground. Three elephants and other members of the procession are shown at a distance at the top. An Urdu inscription on the top with floral and flower designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Akbar with a Yogi
artworks.dimensions: 19.2 L X 25.2 W (Painting alone), 33.5 L X 48.7 W (With border)
artworks.description: A seated Yogi with a stringed instrument (tambura) under a tree. With another seated in his front while a royal personage probably, Akbar standing near the two seated figures. Two peacocks are in the foreground and three monkeys on the tree. Border in dark blue colour with an inscription at the top and floral and flower designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Princess Performing Pooja
artworks.dimensions: 25.7 L X 18.1 W (PAINTING ALONE ), 49.8 L X 35.0 W (WITH BORDER)
artworks.description: Painting showing princess performing pooja under a tree with four attendants behind her. Border in dark blue color with an inscription at the top and floral design on all sides.

artworks.title: Prince Meeting His Beloved
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthani style. A prince meeting his beloved. A prince on horseback holding a sword in his right hand with a shield on his head. His beloved coming towards him holding her Doopatta in the left hand and covering sheets in the right hand. An elephant with mahout at lower left corner. Six attendants, holding fly-whisks and shields standing behind it. Nobles and ladies and two elephants with mahout are seen far behind. Armed horsemen are in the middle. A peacock and two elephants with mahout are seen far behind. Armed horsemen in the middle. A peacock and monkeys are seated on the tree. Buildings and cloudy sky in the background. Flower plants and grassy land in the foreground. Blue bands in between plain golden lines around the painting.

artworks.title: Akbar in Court
artworks.description: Painting showing Akbar seated with folded hands with six persons in the right side and five persons on the left side and a pair of deer in the centre. Border in dark blue color with an inscription at the top and floral and flower designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raja Pratap Singh
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthani style. Raja Pratap Singh seated on the throne holding a huqqa pipe in his left hand enjoying music and dance. Three dancers before him and nine playing on their musical instruments standing behind them. Lady attendants holding fly-whisks, aftabgiri and fruit trays standing behind the Raja. Ladies standing behind enjoying dance. River, boats, buildings,trees and sky in the background.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jahangir
artworks.description: Painting showing a hunting scene. Emperor Jehangir with a mahout and fly-whisk bearer seated on the head of an elephant aiming gun at a lion. Three noble on horse back in the foreground. Border in dark blue color with an inscription: at the top: Flower and floral designs on all sides.

metadata.title2: Emperor Jehangir with a Mahout Fly-whisk, Hunting Scene

artworks.title: Bathing Scene
artworks.description: Painting showing a bathing scene. On the right side prince and princess on horseback watching the nude bathers. An inscription at the top.

metadata.title2: Prince and Princess on Horseback Watching the Nude Bathers

artworks.title: Bathing Scene
artworks.description: Painting showing a bathing scene. On the right side prince and princess on horseback watching the nude bathers. Solitary palm trees rises high in the background. An inscription at the top.

artworks.title: A Princess Enjoying Music Party
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Rajasthani style. A princess enjoying music seated on a carpet with a bolster at her back holding a cup in her right hand and sprinkler in her left. A lady seated beside her. Four lady attendants standing behind her, first with a fruit tray, second with a fly-whisk and a flagon, third with a cup and fourth with sword and shield. Four musicians seated before her, three of them playing on musical instruments. Two lady attendants standing behind them, one holding a fruit-tray in her hands and the other cup and flagon. Trees, buildings, hillocks and sky in the background. Trees and grassy land in the foreground. Plain golden and white line around the painting. Blue band in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Jogan
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthani style. A Jogan seated on the buck's hide with a pillow in her lap. A lady seated on either side. A side fruit tray lying before her. Six devotees seated towards right, and a naked Jogi seated behind them. A naked Sadhu seated on the ground holding antlers in his left hand. An old man seated on a tiger's skin holding a huqqa in his left hand and a boy seated before the fire on tiger's skin. Seven ladies visiting the Jogi's three seated and four standing. Buildings , trees and sky in the background. Plain golden band around the painting. Blue band in the margin.

artworks.title: Roopmati and Baz Bahadur
artworks.description: Painting showing a excursion scene. In the centre the king Baz Bahadur enclosing his queen Roopmati with his right hand while the left holds the sword. The attendants and members of the procession with horses and elephants are seen in the surrounding country. Border in dark blue color with an inscription at the top and floral design on all sides.

artworks.title: King Padam Singh in Tula Palace
artworks.description: Painting showing the birth of a prince. The center portion showing the queen giving birth to a baby, and surrounded by nine lady attendants. On the bed side king Padam Singh in Tula palace seated on a throne eagerly waiting for the news surrounded by three ladies. On the ground the members of the court (thirteen in number) awaiting the news eagerly. Four slaves in the foreground. Border in dark blue color. An Inscription on the top and floral designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jodabai
artworks.description: The painting depicts Queen JodaBai sleeping under a canopy, surrounded by musicians and attendants who are seated and standing near her bed. The border of the painting is in dark blue color, featuring an inscription at the top with floral designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Saint Ibrahim Adham
artworks.description: Painting showing saint Ibrahim Adham seated on the skin of an animal with trays of food before him and a large gathering seated and standing around him. Inscription at the top : Border in dark blue with an Urdu inscription at the top and floral designs on all sides.

artworks.title: Kunwer Jagat Singh
artworks.description: The painting depicts Prince Jagat Singh seated in a Mandapa with his wife on his lap, embracing each other. He is shown holding a wine cup in his left hand, surrounded by attendants and musicians. The painting also features an inscription at the top and floral designs on all sides.

metadata.title2: Prince Jagat Singh with His Wife

artworks.title: Ferhad and Shirin
artworks.dimensions: 26.7 L X 19.1 W (PAINTING ALONE), 49.9 L X 34.5 W (WITH BORDER)
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of Ferhad sprawled near a rock, while Shirin is seated nearby with attendants standing behind her. The artwork features an inscription at the top and a border in dark blue color, which includes an Urdu inscription. The sides are adorned with floral designs.

artworks.title: Princess and Ladies of the Harem
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthani style. Princess and ladies of the harem seated in a circle on a carpet on the terrace enjoying huqqa and wine. Wine cups, trays, flagons and a vase placed on a chowki towards left and two lighted candlesticks towards right. a lady attendant holding a fly-whisk in her right hand standing behind the princess and another lady standing beside the parapet holding a staff in her hand. Flower plants , cypress trees , trees and building in the background. Golden band around the painting. Blue band in the margin.

artworks.title: Kuwar Indersing with His Followers
artworks.description: Painting showing Indersing with his followers seated under a canopy of red color. Indersing embracing a lady with wine. One old man dressed in pink color and another with a cup in right hand seated by his right side while three ladies one of them reclining are seated by the side of the couple. Border in dark blue color with an Urdu inscription at the top and flowers and birds on all sides.

artworks.title: King Nadir Shah Seated on Throne
artworks.description: The painting depicts King Nadir Shah seated on his throne, displaying an angry demeanor. He is surrounded by a nobleman who is pleading before him, as well as soldiers and attendants. The border of the painting features a dark blue color, while the top inscription is written in Urdu. The sides of the painting are adorned with floral designs.

artworks.title: Nizam Ali Khan with Others
artworks.description: Painting showing Nizam Ali Khan with Arastu Jah and Raja Sham Raj.

artworks.title: Siege of a Fort
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Raj-put style. Siege of a Fort. A king seated in a sedan chair (Howdah) carried by attendants. Armed chief guards standing towards left. Attendants holding fly-whisks, chatter and Aftabgiri etc. standing towards right. A mahout riding an elephant with a goad in his right hand. Armed horsemen before the king. The infantry and besieging the fort cannons firing. Soldiers fighting at the entrance of the fort. Dead bodies of the soldiers lying on the ground. Blue bands in between plain golden bands around the painting.

artworks.title: Roopmati and Bazbahadur
artworks.description: Painting showing a Hunting scene. Roopmati and Baz Bahadur on horseback with bows in their hands and followers standing at a distance under a tree. Witnessing the scene. Roopmati catching a deer with her bow, three more deer's in the foreground. Border in dark blue color with an Urdu inscription at the top and floral and flower design on all sides.

artworks.title: Royal Procession
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthan style. A royal procession : Attendants and soldiers towards left and a horseman in the middle. Soldiers towards right and two men on horseback. Ladies of Harem riding on elephants and attendants standing behind them. Elephants with mahouts and attendants holding Mahi and Maratib seated in the litter on the other side of the hillock. Four men riding on camel in front of the elephant. Fort , building and cloudy sky in the background. Blue band in between plain golden bands around the painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noble Man
artworks.description: The painting depicts a standing portrait of a Mughal noble. The subject is shown in profile, holding a sword in his right hand and a flower in his left hand. He wears two rings on his right hand finger and one on his left. An inscription appears at the top of the painting.

artworks.title: Festival Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthan style. Festival scene : Ladies and a Raja enjoying Basant festival pouring color water on each other standing in the courtyard of the palace. Few ladies standing in the cistern pouring color water on each other. Trees, buildings, grassy land and cloudy sky in the background. Plain white and golden lines around the painting. Blue band in the margin.

metadata.title2: Ladies and a Raja Enjoying Basant Festival

artworks.title: Durga with Devotees
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga seated on throne with human and animal figures in her lap. Eight maids standing on either side with chatter, fly-whisks etc. Angelic figures showing flowers over her. Cups, flasks etc. in front. Flower beds at lower corners. Yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts a powerful scene featuring multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger, accompanied by Kaali standing beside her on one side and a group of armed animal-headed demons on the other side of the hillocks. A distinctive feature of this artwork is the presence of Hindi inscriptions at the top, adding an element of cultural significance to the piece. Additionally, the painting features geometrical designs on a yellow band around it, which adds to its visual appeal and aesthetic value.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga on tiger"s back shooting towards the horned demon in two-horse driven chariot who is also shooting arrow. Below again multi armed Durga riding on tiger and in front of her a horned demon standing with spear in two-horse driven chariot. Hindi inscriptions on top and bottom. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Kaali Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts Kali, a powerful figure, with two swords having killed many demons, whose heads and bodies are visible in various locations. A demon is shown shooting an arrow towards Kali, while another demon stands behind him. The painting also features geometrical designs on a yellow band around it.

artworks.title: Kaali Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts slaughter of a horned demon by Kaali. Five demons seen falling. The others seen afraid.Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting features a depiction of Durga, a multi-armed figure, riding on the back of a tiger. She is accompanied by a horned demon who is positioned to attack her, wielding a mace and shield. A similar scene appears below this one, but with some notable differences: the demon in this version has a distinctive pair of moustaches. Additionally, there are geometrical designs visible on a yellow band that surrounds the artwork.

artworks.title: Durga with Group of Gods
artworks.description: Painting depicts a saint seated with a Raja and attendant at top left. Multi Armed Durga standing in the middle and a group of Gods in front of her with folded hands.Hindi inscriptions on top and at the places on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Kaali Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts kaali chasing the demon running away holding bow and arrow, while others are seen fallen on the ground.Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga with Two Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga seated in a chair like thing at top left. Again multi armed Durga seated in a chair like thing with two-horned demons standing in front one with mace and the other with sword. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Tiger's Fighting with Another Demon
artworks.description: The painting depicts a saddled tiger, representing Durga, attacking a demon that has fallen from an elephant. In addition to this central scene, the painting also shows the tiger fighting another demon. On the left side of the composition, three demons are visible. A Hindi inscription is prominently displayed in the middle of the painting. The border of the painting features geometrical designs on a yellow band.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demon
artworks.description: Painting in double glass depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger on left and a horned demon in two horse- driven cart on right both shooting arrows. Similar scene in the background. Geometrical designs on yellow band around. Hindi inscriptions on top and on the painting.

artworks.title: Kaali Dancing on Sankar
artworks.description: The painting depicts Kaali dancing on Sankara, accompanied by Brahma and Krishna standing in front of her. A maid can be seen carrying an umbrella, while another maid stands behind with a fly-whisk. Additionally, Kaali is also shown alongside a nude woman. The scene is surrounded by intricate details, including a golden flower creeper and decorative panels.

artworks.title: Raja Standing Beside Horse in Fort
artworks.description: Painting depicts a Raja standing beside a horse, standing alone and then on horse back in the fort. The same Raja has been shown outside the fort at five places. Hindi inscriptions on top and at places on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Saint and Raja
artworks.description: Painting depicts a saint on black buck's skin seated in front of the cottage. A Raja is seen thrice on horse-back and then on foot behind the cottage. Building on top left. Hindi inscriptions at places on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Raja in His Fort
artworks.description: The painting depicts a Raja seated within a fort, accompanied by nobles and attendants. Soldiers are shown standing guard on the battlements of the fort. A noble is depicted riding a horse outside the fort, flanked by two attendants. Additionally, four horsemen can be seen positioned at a great height. The painting also features geometrical designs on a yellow band that surrounds it.

artworks.title: Tiger Fighting with Demon
artworks.description: Painting depicts a saddled tiger (of Durga) killing a horned demon. Three demons and an elephant are seen running away. A line in Hindi on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga seated in a pavilion in the hillocks and a horned animal headed demon standing before her with arms outstretched. Armed, horned and animal headed demons are seen at the foot of the hills. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger's back with four attendants on right side. Many armed, horned animal headed demons in front to give her a fight. Hindi inscriptions on top and at places on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts a multi-armed Durga figure, shown both riding a tiger and standing on foot. At the top left of the composition, Durga is also depicted sitting on a hillock. Below her, an army of horned demons and various animals are seated at the foot. The painting features Hindi inscriptions at the top, adding to its cultural significance. A yellow band with geometrical designs surrounds the entire artwork, adding to its visual appeal.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts on top left. Multi armed Durga standing on a rock in front of the pavilion and down at the foot of the hillocks army of the horned and animal headed demons. The arrow shot by them and other weapons thrown are seen on the hillocks. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Panels Depicting Saints
artworks.description: Painting depicts (1)Top left: a saint in front of his cottage with a Raja and noble seated before him. (2) Top right: same saint with a devotee in front of him. (3) Below left: again the same saint with six herons before him. (4) Below right: Durga on throne chair with a Raja and seated and an attendant with fly-whisk before her. Hindi inscriptions on top . Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger's back with two attendants with fly-whisk on either side. Three horned demons are seen in front, two of them being fallen down and the third trying to attack Durga. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga with Many Gods
artworks.description: Painting depicts a scene of multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger, surrounded by many gods who are standing with their hands folded in reverence. Additionally, five angelic figures can be seen showering flowers over her, adding to the grandeur and majesty of the scene. The painting also features geometrical designs on a yellow band that adds an extra layer of visual interest and beauty to the artwork.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger. A horned demon with sword and shield attacking to Durga. Another demon and horses are seen fallen and the wheel of the chariot broken. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga with Different God and Goddesses
artworks.description: Painting depicts a saint with a Raja and an attended seated top left. Multi Armed Durga riding on tiger. Other gods on bull, Garuda, peacock, elephant and boat. Kaali, lion-god shown standing. Hindi inscriptions on top and at places on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Panels Depicting
artworks.description: (1)At top left: mother and child in bed and an old bearded man seated with a lady in front. (2) Top right: Durga seated on throne chair. (3) Below: Multi armed Durga riding on tiger, Durga on foot caught a horned demon is seen fallen at lower right. Hindi inscriptions at bottom. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts a saint with a Raja and an attendant seated at top left. Multi Armed Durga riding on tiger, kaali in front and other gods and goddesses on either side of her. Two chariots on the right side. The horned demon seated in each shooting an arrow. Geometrical designs on yellow band around. Hindi inscriptions on right side and on painting at places.

artworks.title: Mahishasura in Fort
artworks.description: Painting represents Mahishasura armed with mace, axe, sword seated on a chair in fort. Two horned demons with fly-whisks standing behind, seven seated in front and two at the entrance. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting represents : Top left: multi armed Durga on tiger back shooting arrow, the arrows already shot are seen in the body of the horned demon in front who is holding battle-axe, behind him is another demon fallen down on the ground. Durga is seen riding on tiger on the right side and kaali bowed before her. below :- Durga riding on tiger blowing conch. A horned demon in the chariot shooting arrow towards Durga. Hindi inscriptions on the top and at bottom. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene from Hindu mythology, specifically Durga riding on a tiger with two attendants holding fly-whisks on either side. On the ground, nine men are shown lying unconscious and frightened by the presence of the buffalo demon. A yellow band around the artwork features intricate geometrical designs.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demon
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger and in front of her a horned demon standing without stretched arms in two horse- driven chariot. Two maces thrown by him are seen on the ground being both broken. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Goddess Durga with Other Gods
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga seated in throne chair in two panels and below Durga is seen seated on throne chair and five gods standing in front of her with folded hands. Hindi inscriptions on top, at bottom and on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger. A horned demon with sword and shield in one chariot and another demon with trident and sword also in a chariot of which a horse fallen being wounded by the trident thrown by Durga. Hindi inscriptions on top and bottom. Geometrical designs on yellow band and around.

artworks.title: Four Panels of Goddess Duega
artworks.description: Painting depicts (1) Top left: multi armed Durga fighting with a horned demon holding mace and shield while another demon is seen fallen. (2) Top right: multi armed Durga seated on chair. (3) Below left: two saints worshipping to multi armed Durga. (4)Below right: multi Armed Durga on tiger's back a horned demon seen fallen down. Hindi inscriptions on top and bottom. Geometrical designs on yellow band and around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger, while a horned demon in front of her about to throw his spear held in both the hands. Below is seen armed Durga on tiger's back while the horned demon in front is going to throw his spear held in his right hand. Hindi inscriptions on top and bottom. Geometrical designs on yellow band and around.

artworks.title: Durga with Many Gods
artworks.description: The painting depicts a multi-armed Durga seated in a pavilion at the top left, surrounded by many gods standing before her with their hands folded in reverence. In the foreground, lotus flowers are prominently displayed. The artwork also features Hindi inscriptions on both the top and bottom of the composition. The design elements include geometrical patterns on a yellow band that adds visual interest to the piece, as well as additional geometric designs surrounding the main image.

artworks.title: Durga with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga seated in a pavilion at top left. A demon is seen in flames another trying to jump over her. On the right side are seen many horned and animal headed demons with arms and flags. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band and around.

artworks.title: Durga with Demon
artworks.description: The painting features a depiction of multi-armed Durga seated on a throne, while a horned demon is bowed before her with folded hands. In the foreground, lotus flowers are visible, and the painting includes Hindi inscriptions both at the top and bottom. Additionally, there is a yellow band around the artwork that features geometrical designs.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts a powerful image of Durga, a multi-armed goddess riding on a tiger while shooting an arrow. She is surrounded by many demons with animal heads, horns, and other terrifying features, all of whom are attacking her. Among them, one demon is seen lying fallen on the ground, while six others stand nearby without their heads. The painting also features intricate geometrical designs on a yellow band that adds to its visual appeal.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demon
artworks.description: The painting depicts a powerful scene of multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger as she prepares to attack the buffalo demon, Mahishasura. Two attendants stand beside her, holding fly-whisks, which are traditional objects used for fanning and ceremonial purposes. The tiger, upon which Durga rides, is an integral part of this iconic image, symbolizing strength and courage. The painting also features a yellow band with geometrical designs around it, adding to the overall aesthetic appeal of the artwork. Additionally, there are Hindi inscriptions at the top, providing further context and meaning to the piece.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger with two attendants holding fly-whisks on either side. The tiger demon wounded by her sword. The horn of the buffalo demon caught in the noose. A demon with sword and shield trying to attack Durga. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: An Army of Armed
artworks.description: The painting depicts an army of armed and animal-headed demons. Their chief is seen with a sword in his left hand and a shield in his right, riding in a four-horse driven chariot in the foreground. Hindi inscriptions are visible on top of the painting, while geometrical designs adorn a yellow band around it.

artworks.title: Durga with Two Demons
artworks.description: The painting features a multi-armed Durga seated on a throne, accompanied by a horned demon with maces bowed before her. A smaller painting of Durga is also depicted at the top left corner of the artwork. The painting includes Hindi inscriptions placed strategically throughout its surface. Geometrical designs adorn a yellow band that surrounds the main composition.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demon
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger shooting arrow. The arrows already shot have pierced the arms and shield of the demon who is holding sword in his right hand. Two attendants with fly-whisks on either side of Durga. Geometrical designs around the painting.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Raktavija
artworks.description: The painting depicts a powerful scene of multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger, attacking a horned demon. The demon is shown holding a shield in his left hand while another one is seen falling down beside him with a sword. Geometrical designs adorn the yellow band at the top of the painting, adding to its visual appeal. Hindi inscriptions are visible on top of the painting, providing additional context and meaning.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts a powerful image of multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger. The spear thrown by the horned demon, who is standing in a two-horse-driven chariot, is seen broken. At the top of the painting, there are Hindi inscriptions, and a yellow band features geometrical designs.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts a multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger and a horned demon in a two-horse driven chariot, shooting an arrow towards Durga. The arrows shot are seen broken. This suggests that the scene may be depicting a moment of conflict or struggle between Durga and her enemies. Hindi inscriptions can be found on top of the painting, adding to its cultural significance and providing context about the artwork's origins. Geometrical designs adorn a yellow band around the painting, which serves as an additional decorative element and may have symbolic meaning within the artwork's overall design.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger. Two horned and a bird headed demons are seen fallen being wounded. One of the four attendants of Durga shooting an arrow.Hindi inscriptions on top, bottom and on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger. A horned demon reclined on two-horse driven chariot in front of her. Below, armed Durga on tiger's back at left, Kaali in the chariot shooting arrows at right. The arrow shot have pierced kaali and the tiger. Hindi inscriptions on top and on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Riding on Tiger's Back
artworks.description: The painting depicts a multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger. Durga is armed with various weapons, including a sword, mace, spear, arrow, and trident. She holds the head of a murdered man by its long hair tassel. The painting features a shaded blue top and a yellow band around it.

artworks.title: Kaali Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: The painting depicts the Hindu god Kaali in a dramatic scene, where she is shown holding a horned demon by his hair while cutting his neck with her hand. Additionally, Kaali is seen holding a bow and arrow, adding to the intensity of the scene. In the background, other demons are depicted as fallen down, suggesting a sense of chaos and turmoil. The painting also features Hindi inscriptions on top, which provide additional context and meaning to the artwork. A yellow band around the painting is adorned with geometrical designs, adding an extra layer of visual interest and cultural significance.

artworks.title: Durga with Demon
artworks.description: The painting features a depiction of the multi-armed goddess Durga seated in a chair-like structure, while a horned demon is shown bowing before her with his hands folded in reverence. Notably, the painting includes Hindi inscriptions both at the top and on its surface. Additionally, it features geometrical designs that adorn a yellow band around it.

artworks.title: Kaali Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts Kaali in attacking position with sword, branch and a horse in her hands and three demon seated on her tongues. On the right many a horned and animal headed demons with arms to fight to kaali. Hindi inscriptions on top and bottom. Geometrical designs on yellow band around the painting.

artworks.title: Battle Scene
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of an army emerging from a fort at the left side. The chiefs and soldiers are shown riding elephants, while others are mounted on camels or in chariots. The opposing forces are positioned on the right-hand side of the composition. The artwork also features Hindi inscriptions located at the top. A yellow band encircles the painting, adorned with geometrical designs.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demon
artworks.description: The painting depicts a powerful scene from Hindu mythology, featuring multi-armed Durga riding on a tiger and shooting an arrow towards the buffalo demon Mahishasura. On either side of Durga are two attendants holding fly-whisks, adding to the dynamic composition of the scene. The presence of these attendants serves as a reminder of Durga's divine status and her role as a protector. The painting also features Hindi inscriptions on top, which provide additional context and meaning to the artwork. These inscriptions are an integral part of the piece, adding another layer of depth and significance to the visual narrative. A yellow band with geometrical designs surrounds the main image, creating a striking border that draws attention to the central scene. This decorative element adds a touch of elegance and sophistication to the overall design of the painting.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger shooting arrow. Horned demons in two-horse driven chariot, one of them shooting arrow. Horned demons at lower right, one of them holding triangular shield. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger and other Goddesses on animals and birds, while kaali in the middle, fighting with a horned demon who is attacking with his mace. Other demons are seen at right. Hindi inscriptions on top and at places on the painting. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Durga Fighting with Demons
artworks.description: Painting depicts multi armed Durga riding on tiger attacking the buffalo demon is seen at top right. Three attendants with Durga. Out of five men on right side two are seen fallen down. Hindi inscriptions on top. Geometrical designs on yellow band around.

artworks.title: Reclining Lady on the Bed
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of domestic life, featuring a maid seated at her feet. She is accompanied by another maid who stands beside her, holding a fan. Two additional maids stand behind the seated maid, adding to the sense of a busy household. In the foreground, a cistern and flower beds are visible, suggesting a tranquil outdoor setting. The painting's borders feature a floral creeper and other decorative elements that add to its aesthetic appeal.

artworks.title: Daulatabad Fort
artworks.description: Painting in gilt frame depicts Daulatabad Fort. Battlements and Chand Minar being on the right. Two men at the wall and three at different places.

artworks.title: Daulatabad Fort
artworks.description: Painting in gilt frame depicts another view of Daulatabad Fort, Chand Minar shown on the left. A woman is also featured in the painting, carrying a bundle of fuel wood on her head. The painting is signed at the lower left by Raja Deen Dayal & Sons and dated 1898.

metadata.title2: Chand Minar Shown on the Left

artworks.title: Maula Ka Pahad
artworks.description: Painting on canvass representing Maula Ka Pahad. Signed at the lower left : Kishan Perehad, 1904.

artworks.title: King Seated on the Back of an Elephant
artworks.description: Painting showing a king seated on the back of an elephant led by nine attendants in front and followed by two at the back.

artworks.title: Chand Bibi
artworks.description: Painting showing four ladies and four noblemen on horseback shooting arrows upon each other. An inscription in Urdu on top. Border with floral designs on blue background.

artworks.title: Nizam on a Hunting Expedition
artworks.description: Framed painting in Deccani style with Rai Venkatachalam, the court artist. A royal procession of Nizam ali Khan. He is out for a shikar in the plains around Golconda fort accompanied by the top ranking nobles and his personal staff on horseback's. The procession is led by the Nishan (standard) on elephant followers by French Infantry of Raymond's Corps. Who is also seen in the picture. Behind the royal elephant there are two more elephants, one carrying the royal insignia of Mahi and Maratib, the other the big kettle drum Chanda Bibi the famous courtesan is seen in the background riding in the palanquin (Miyana).. (Matching No. XXXV-6 but without Chanda Bibi).

metadata.title2: A Royal Procession of Nizam Ali Khan

artworks.title: Nawab Sikander Jhah Bahadur
artworks.description: Painting showing NAWAB SIKANDER JHAH BAHADUR holding a falcon , riding on elephant with a mahout and attendant holding a fly whisk, a dog in the foreground.

artworks.title: Durbar Scene of Akbar II
artworks.description: Framed painting with Mughal, Rajput and European influence with inscriptions on the top: Durbar scene of Akbar II, A king seated on a throne under a canopy all the courtiers standing on both sides and one with a rosary in his hand standing in his front. The name of every one is written on the turban above the head and below the neck. Plain golden band and a floral creeper band around the painting.

artworks.title: Taramati
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription. A lady seated on a bed with a baby in her lap. A maid with fly-whisk standing behind, a women on the right and two women on the left seated, one of them playing on Indian drum (Dhol). Betel box, spittoon, basin and ewer etc. before them. Trees in the foreground. Building, canopy and trees in the background. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: King Aurangzeb Standing
artworks.description: The painting depicts King Aurangzeb, who is shown standing with a spear in his right hand and a sword and shield hanging from his left side. He is surrounded by chiefs, indicating his status as a powerful leader. In the foreground, cavalry and artillery are visible, suggesting a scene of military significance. The fort in the background adds to the sense of grandeur and importance of the scene. A golden band around the painting suggests a touch of luxury and opulence.

artworks.title: Pemamati
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription. In the middle Pemamati seated on carpet and two maids standing behind her holding fly-whisks. Two ladies sitting before her with betel box in front, three ladies arranging fruits in dishes towards her left and three ladies far behind preparing garlands. In the foreground a couple sleeping on bed and two ladies in attendance. Fort in the background. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Arastu Jah Presenting Nazara to Mir Nizam Ali Khan II
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style. Arastu Jah presenting Nazar to Mir Nizam Ali Khan II. A sword tied up at his left. A sword, shield and a flower pot before him. Fountain, flower plants in the foreground. Buildings, trees and birds in the background.

artworks.title: Seated Saint with Two Women
artworks.description: Painting showing a seated saint holding a fly-whisk in his right hand being worshipped by two seated women, one of them holding a child and the other a fruit basket.

artworks.title: Jungle Scene
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a reclining woman situated under a tree. She is accompanied by two individuals standing in front of her, one of whom is holding the other's right hand with their left hand while also grasping a vessel. The setting is a jungle environment surrounded by various birds and animals, against a white background.

artworks.title: A Prince with an Attendant Hunting a Lion
artworks.description: Painting of a Prince with an attendant hunting a lion. Two herons in the foreground with a hilly terrain in the background.

artworks.title: Portrait of Guru Harikishan Jeu
artworks.description: Painting showing a saint (guru) seated against a cushion with flower in his hands and a seated musician in front playing on a stringed instrument. Urdu inscriptions on the painting and Hindi at the back. Border with floral designs on blue background.

artworks.title: Portrait of Guru Arjun Singh Jeu
artworks.description: Painting showing a seated saint (Guru Arjun singh) with a musician in front playing on a stringed instrument. Inscription on the back and on painting.

artworks.title: Nawab Mir Nizam Ali Khan Bahadur
artworks.description: Painting depicts the court of Nizam Ali Khan seated under a canopy with flowers in right hand. Four nobleman seated behind and three in front. Other courtiers standing in front and behind him with names written above their heads. Golden flower creeper around.

artworks.title: Portrait of Guru Taigh Bahadur Jeu
artworks.description: The painting depicts a bearded king sitting regally, dressed in blue attire. He is seated against a red cushion, accompanied by a musician who is playing a stringed instrument. The border of the painting features a dark blue design with intricate floral patterns in gold color.

artworks.title: Portrait of Guru Taigh Bahadur Jeu
artworks.description: The painting depicts a bearded king, identified as Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, dressed in blue and seated against a red cushion. In front of the king is a seated musician playing on a stringed instrument. The border of the painting features a dark blue design with floral elements in gold color.

artworks.title: Princess Receiving a Letter from Prince
artworks.description: Painting showing a prince on a camel , receiving a letter with the help of a lance from his lady love standing in the balcony, another lady standing in the doorway.

artworks.title: Portrait of Guru Ramdas
artworks.description: Painting showing a seated saint (Guru) holding a flower in his right hand and a rosary in the left. A man is seated in front of him playing on a stringed instrument. The border of the painting features a creeper pattern. The subject of the painting is identified as Guru Ramdas.

artworks.title: Three Semi-nude Ladies near a Lake
artworks.description: Painting showing three semi-nude ladies near a lake. A king on horseback holding a falcon in his right hand. A bullock- cart in the background.

artworks.title: Bathing Scene
artworks.description: Painting showing three semi-nude ladies near a lake. A king on horseback holding a falcon in his right hand. A bullock- cart in the background.

artworks.title: Portrait of Maharajah of Gadwal
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscriptions on top. Raja of Gadwal holding a flower in his left hand putting his right on a pillow and a bolster at his back in a seated position. A sword, kattar and betel box on a tray in front. Flower plants behind the parapet. Light green background. A plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: King with Courtier
artworks.description: Painting showing a king dressed in pink seated on throne holding a sword in right hand, with three kings seated on either side. Three attendants on either side holding umbrellas. Three attendants and a horse in the foreground. Border with floral designs in gold color on dark blue background.

artworks.title: Hunting Expedition of a King
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style. Hunting expedition of a king. Men on elephants, horses and camels. A prince seated on an elephant holding a bow in his right hand, shield and quiver hanging by his side. On two elephants men with white and black flags. Seven ladies bathing at a pool near by a temple. A king riding on horse has approached here being thirsty. Two men with fly-whisks and one holding aftabgiri behind him.

artworks.title: Rani Roopvanti
artworks.description: Painting showing a lady seated on a stool in the front portion of a building with garden at the back and an old lady holding a plate with two cups and a decanter in right hand. A duck in front. Border in dark blue with floral designs in gold. calligraphy at the back of the painting.

artworks.title: Rani Roopvanti
artworks.description: Painting showing a lady seated on a stool in the front portion of a building with garden at the back and an old lady holding a plate with two cups and a decanter in right hand. A duck in front. Border in dark blue with floral designs in gold. A small crane is standing in front of two ladies. Calligraphy at the back of the painting.

artworks.title: Nayak Raja Tanjore
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription at the left on top. The subject of this painting is Raja (Nayak) of Tanjore, who is seated on a throne. The throne has a big bolster at his back and a pillow under his right arm. A plain golden band surrounds the entire painting.

artworks.title: Winged Lady Seated on a Horse
artworks.description: Painting showing a winged lady seated on a horse composed of animals (tiger, bear, fox etc.,) a nude female and birds. The horse flying over a hill.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raja Bahadur
artworks.description: Painting in wooden frame with glass depicts a lady descending down a rope from her room while three women are at her help. The lover is seen standing looking at her. Two men at the right, two horses at the left corner and a woman at the temple. Inscription on top. Two creeper borders and flower plants around.

artworks.title: Nizam Ali Khan on a Hunting Expedition
artworks.description: Framed painting in Deccani style with Rai Venkatachalam, the court artist. A royal procession of Nizam ali Khan. He is out for a shikar in the plains around Golconda fort accompanied by the top ranking nobles and his personal staff on horseback's. The procession is led by the Nishan (standard) on elephant followers by French Infantry of Raymond s corp. who is also seen in the picture. Behind the royal elephant there are two more elephants, one carrying the royal insignia of Mahi and Maratib, the other the big kettle drum Chanda Bibi the famous courtesan is seen in the background riding in the palanquin (Miyana). Matching no XXXV-17.
