artworks.title: Four Handed Ardhanarishwar
artworks.description: The painting depicts a unique figure of Ardhanarishwar, which is a representation of Shiva and Parvati combined into one being. The left half of the figure represents Shiva, who is shown holding a goad and an arrow, two symbols associated with his power and spiritual authority. The right half of the figure represents Parvati, depicted with a crow and a moose, which are both sacred animals in Hindu mythology. On the right side of the painting, eight ladies are shown standing together, adding to the vibrant and dynamic composition of the artwork. The painting features black and orange bands around it, which may be used for decorative or symbolic purposes, although their specific meaning is not specified.

artworks.title: Illustration from Bhagavata Purana
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. Subjugation of Kali Nag. Lord Krishna is seen subjugating Kalia Nag a huge monster of the sea with all the mermaids paying homage to him. Gopies and other cowherds watching this scene standing at the bank of the sea. Trees, hillocks and sky in the background. Flower creeper on blue band round the painting.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna and Radha
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. Lover play : Lord Krishna and Radha standing closely under a tree putting on a rug over them with a cow behind them. A cowherd sitting in the cavity of the tree to be safe from the rainfall, while other two standing under the tree. Two Gopika's carrying milk pots over their heads.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna and Radha
artworks.description: Painting depicting Radha lying on bed under canopy and Krishna sitting beside the bedstead holding her trousers band. Ewer, basin etc., at the left corner. Blue band around the painting.

metadata.title2: Radha Lying on Bed Under Canopy and Krishna Sitting Beside

artworks.title: Ahalya Sapa Vimochana
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. Rama visiting a saint, offering him meals while Ahalya has fallen on the feet of Rama. An old bearded man and a youth standing behind Rama. Grassy land and sky in the background. Grassy land and pond in the foreground. A blue band around the painting.

artworks.title: Palace Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting in mixed Basholi and Kangra style. A palace scene : A Raja seated on a carpet with a bolster at his back with a kattar tied up at his waist. The son and daughter-in-law paying their respects. Trees and sky in the background.

metadata.title2: Raja Seated on a Carpet with a Bolster

artworks.title: Mythological Painting
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. A mythological painting : Laxmi and Narayan in the sea on the serpent, holding a lotus in his right hand while Laxmi touching his foot. A seven horsed chariot with a driver holding a whip in his right hand, waiting at the sea shore for them. Flower creeper on blue band in between plain golden lines around the painting.

metadata.title2: Laxmi and Narayan in the Sea on the Serpent

artworks.title: A Love Scene
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in mixed Basholi and Kangra style. A love scene : A king seated closely with his consort putting his left hand round her neck and touching her chin with his right. Flower trees are seen through the door. Trees and sky in the background. Red lines around the painting.

artworks.title: Scene from Rasika Priya
artworks.description: Miniature painting in oval panel framed in double glass in Kangra style. Lord Krishna standing in the courtyard of the palace holding a stick in his hands. A lady standing on a carpet under a canopy. Two pillows placed on the carpet. Trees, buildings, grassy land and sky in the background. Parapets in the foreground. Golden band around the painting. Floral panel in between creeper design on grassy ground at the corners.

metadata.title2: Radha and Krishna Sheltering from Rain

artworks.title: The Tilak Ceremony of Lord Krishna
artworks.description: Miniature painted depicting the Tilak ceremony of Lord Krishna. Brahma Vishnu Mahesh and other Gods in attendance on the left hand side with other courtiers on the right hand.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raja and His Family
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in mixed Basholi and Kangra style. A Raja seated on carpet, a jambia (dagger) tied up at his waist and Rani seated behind him. Nine sons seated in a row before them. Decorative band on the top of the painting.

artworks.title: Palace Scene
artworks.description: Painting depicts palace scene. A lady enjoying huqqa and music seated on a platform in the center of a cistern in which three bathing ladies, four ducks and a boat is seen. In the foreground a lady with two maids standing beside another cistern. On the right side a noble man and on the left a lady seated under canopy enjoying huqqa. Boating scene men and horsemen in the background.

artworks.title: Lord Radha and Krishna
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthan style. Lord Krishna with his flute standing near Radha's house. Radha is seen standing at the entrance to receive Krishna while Gopika s standing before informing the arrival of Lord Krishna. A Gopika standing in the courtyard of the palace looking towards back. Four lady attendants standing behind her, two with fly-whisks and two with trays in their hands. Trees in the background. Tree, plants and stream in the foreground. Plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna and Radha
artworks.description: Painting depicting Radha and Krishna both seated with three maids on either side holding fly-whisks and trays. Two more maids on right side. A guard on either side of the gateway. A horseman on extreme right. Walls painted in gold to represent vase and flower plant designs.

artworks.title: Raja Man Singh Bahadur Enjoying Music
artworks.description: Painting depicts a Raja seated with his consort holding huqqa pipe in his left hand. Two maids standing behind with fly-whisks, flask and cup. Four musicians seated in front him. Urdu inscription on top. Raja Man Singh Bahadur. Golden flower creeper on blue band around.

metadata.title2: Raja Seated with His Consort Holding Huqqa Pipe

artworks.title: Lord Rama Seated on Throne
artworks.description: The painting depicts a king, identified as Rama, seated on a throne and holding a sword in his right hand and a shield in his left. Accompanying the king is an attendant who stands beside him, holding a fly-whisk. In front of the king, a man can be seen bowing down in respect. In addition to these figures, a winged horse is visible on the right side of the scene, adding a fantastical element to the composition. The throne itself is adorned with a blue band featuring a flower creeper design, which adds a decorative touch to the overall image.

metadata.title2: Man Is Seen Bowed in Front

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Standing Outside the Palace
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthani style. Lord Krishna standing outside the palace turning back looking at her beloved. Cows and Gopika's standing before him. Radha standing on the upper story of the palace giving response to her lover. six Gopika's standing in the courtyard of the palace. A man riding on horse at the well. Two ladies drawing water from the well. Trees & buildings in background.

metadata.title2: Cows and Gopi Standing Before Him

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Standing Outside the Palace
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthani style. Lord Krishna standing outside the palace turning back looking at her beloved. Cows and Gopika's standing before him. Radha standing on the upper story of the palace giving response to her lover. Six Gopika's standing in the courtyard of the palace. A man riding on horse at the well. Two ladies drawing water from the well. Trees & buildings are in the background.

metadata.title2: Cows and Gopi Standing Before Him

artworks.title: Seated Lady on Throne
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. A lady seated on throne with bolster at her right holding huqqa pipe in her hand. Another standing before her. An ewer, basin and foot rest placed on the floor. Flower creeper on blue band in between plain golden lines around the painting.

artworks.title: Radha Talking to a Maid Seated in Front Her
artworks.description: Painting represents Radha talking to a maid seated in front her. Four maids standing to her right and four standing in front her. A guard on either side of the gate. A Cow drinking water at the lake in foreground. A horseman at a far of distance.

artworks.title: Vashishtiji Entering Into Rama's Palace
artworks.description: Painting depicts Vashishtiji entering Rama's palace at lower left, in the middle the Guru getting down from the two-horse driven cart is seen entering the third gate of the palace. Rama, Sita and Laxmana are seen kneeling before the Guru with folded hands. At the top right, the Guru seated on chair and Rama touching his feet while Sita and Laxmana are shown standing. The Hindi inscriptions make us to understand the scenes.

artworks.title: Battle Scene at the Fort
artworks.description: The miniature painting depicts a scene in the Kangra style, specifically a battle scene. A battle is taking place at a fort, where an attack is being carried out using arrows. The scene shows a chief on horseback, armed with a spear and bow, positioned at the lower right corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Court Scene of a King
artworks.description: Miniature painting in mixed Basholi and Kangra style. Court scene of a king :- A Raja seated on the throne with a bolster at his back putting his left hand on the kattar handle. Five nobles seated before him, an attendant standing behind them holding a staff in his hands. Plain blue band around the painting.

artworks.title: Scene from Ramayana
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Rajasthani style with inscription in Hindi. Sumant meeting Rama. Rama and Sita seated side by side on a throne with bolster at their back under a canopy, Laxmana standing behind them holding a fly-whisk in his right hand. Two men standing before them with folded hands, and two ladies behind. A Chowkidar standing with a staff in his hands at the entrance of the palace and the opposite side. Rama , Laxmana and Sumant are seen near the entrance. In the second panel outside the palace Rama and Laxmana are shown in chariot while four men standing with folded hands. In the third panel Rama Laxmana and Sumant are seen entering the gateway getting down from the chariot. Sadhus and saints are seen praying. Watchman at the gateway and drum beaters etc.. seated on the gate way. In the last panel Rama and Laxmana are seen touching the feet of their father and prying respects in different poses while Sumant and three ladies on one side and four ladies on the other side standing before witnessing this.

metadata.title2: Rama , Laxmana , Sita and Sumant Are Seen in the Picture

artworks.title: Seated Jogi on a Mat Under a Tree
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. A Jogi seated on a mat under a tree before the cottage. Raja and Diwan seated before him with folded hands. Three disciples seated behind him holding books in their hands. At the foot of the hillock the Raja is seen in deep thinking and afterwards seen seated consulting with the Diwan. A tiger, two deers and three cows in the foreground. A goat, grassy land and sky in the background. Flower creeper design on blue band around the painting. Red lines in the margin.

metadata.title2: Raja and Diwan Seated Before Jogi with Folded Hands

artworks.title: Seated Gaja Laxmi on Lotus
artworks.description: Miniature painting in oval panel in Kangra style. Gaja Laxmi seated on a lotus shape throne holding lotus in her right and left hand. A foot rest placed in front of the throne. Four vases with lotus flowers around her throne. Four elephants pouring water holding pitcher in their trunks. Floral pattern panels in between flower creeper at the corners of the painting. Blue band in between white and golden lines in the margin.

artworks.title: Man Holding Woman Under an Arch
artworks.description: Painting depicting a man holding a woman under an arch, his hands being on her breast while she is trying to get rid of the grip. Dark blue band around.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna and Radha
artworks.description: Painting in depicts Krishna seated with Radha on his lap whose arms entwined Krishna's neck. Trees and hillocks on either side. River in foreground.

artworks.title: Figure of Hari Hara
artworks.description: Painting depicts four handed Hari Hara figure, the left half represents Shanker with trident and drum and the right half shows Vishnu with mace, lotus and conch. Devotees and animals headed gods are also seen. Five angels in clouds. Blue band around.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna and Radha with Gopies
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. Lord Krishna with Gopika's : Lord Krishna putting his left hand around the neck of Radha and resting his right hand on the shoulder of a Gopika standing under a tree in the forest. Six Gopika's standing before him and two behind. Two Cowherds and two Cows and calf standing behind him. Grassy land and sky in the background. Lotus flowers and pond in the foreground. Flower creeper on blue band in between plain golden lines around the painting.

artworks.title: Standing Lady on Chowki
artworks.description: Painting depicting a lady standing on Chowki looking at the mirror held by a maid. Three maids standing behind one of them holding a fly-whisk. Blue band around.

artworks.title: Lord Rama Reclined on Sita's Lap
artworks.description: Painting depicting Rama reclined on Sita's lap and Laxmana picking out thorn from Rama's foot in the forest. Swords, bows, quivers and a bagged deer are seen in the middle. Hanuman practising in the foreground. Trees in background. Blue band around.

artworks.title: Standing Tribal Woman with Consort
artworks.description: Painting depicting a tribal woman standing on one foot with bow and arrows and a deer tied abreast. Her consort is seen knelt busy in picking out thorn from the sole of her foot. Their bag being two deer are seen in foreground. Yellow and blue bands around. Inscription on top.

artworks.title: Radha and Krishna
artworks.description: Painting depicts a couple on bedstead (Radha and Krishna) Ewer and basin at lower left. Blue band around.

artworks.title: Standing Lady in Front of Temple
artworks.description: Painting depicts a lady with goglet in left hand and rosary in the right hand before the Linga's temple. Golden band around.

artworks.title: Seated Nude Lady on a Chowki
artworks.description: Painting represents a nude lady seated on Chowki face turned towards her left, in her bath. Water pots on her right and ewer and basin on the left.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Seated on Lotus Shaped Throne
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of Krishna seated on a lotus-shaped throne. He is holding a laddoo in each hand, surrounded by various figures: three women and a cow to his right, and two women, two men, and another cow to his left. In the foreground, there are several lotus flowers visible. A blue band or border can be seen surrounding the scene.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Seated on Lotus Shaped Throne
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of Krishna, seated on a lotus-shaped throne. He is holding a laddoo in each hand, surrounded by various figures: three women and a cow to his right, and two women, two men, and another cow to his left. In the foreground, there are several lotus flowers visible, adding to the serene atmosphere of the scene. A blue band is also present in the composition.

artworks.title: Lady in the Garden
artworks.description: Miniature painting in oval panel framed in double glass in Kangra style. Lady in the garden :- A lady standing in the courtyard of her palace beside a flower bed pointing towards the plants instructing a maid servant. Two lady attendants standing behind her, one holding a fly-whisk in her right hand and a kerchief in her left and another holding a huqqa bottom in her left hand and fire pot in her right hand.Two women at the entrance holding staff and one in the courtyard with ewer and basin.Trees and sky in the background. Blue band in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Tribal Woman in Front of Her Cottage
artworks.description: Painting depicts a tribal woman seated in front of her cottage in the forest with Linga in front and two Deers seated beside painting on leaf, yellow and blue bands around.

artworks.title: Standing Jogin Beside a Lake Patting on Lion's Head
artworks.description: Painting depicting a Jogin standing beside a lake patting on lion's head. Two rice-birds are seen in front. Yellow and brown bands around. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Mohammad Maqdoom.

artworks.title: Standing Lady Under a Tree
artworks.description: Miniature Mughal style painting. A lady standing on the back of a tank under a tree, with her right arm across her breast. Lightning in the sky in background. Water, lotus flower and herons in the foreground. Golden line and blue band around the painting.

artworks.title: Lord Krishan Enjoying Holi Festival
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style depicts Lord Krishna enjoying the Holi festival with two cowherds in the forest. The scene is set against a backdrop of trees and hillocks, with grassy land and a pond visible in the foreground. The painting features black and red lines around its edges.

artworks.title: Lord Krishan Enjoying Holi Festival
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style depicts a serene scene of Lord Krishna enjoying the Holi festival with two cowherds in the forest. The painting features trees and hillocks in the background, while the foreground is dominated by grassy land and a pond. The borders of the painting are marked by black and red lines.

artworks.title: Seated Lady on the Branch of a Tree
artworks.description: Miniature painting in mixed Basholi and Kangra style. A lady seated on the branch of a tree in the forest playing on her guitar. Two deers in front, the male is standing and the female is grazing. A black band around the painting.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna and Radha Standing Embraced in Balcony
artworks.description: The painting features Radha and Krishna standing together in an intimate moment, embracing each other on a balcony with a maid standing behind them. On the adjacent terrace, two musicians are visible, adding to the lively atmosphere of the scene. In the foreground, three maids can be seen, further emphasizing the domestic setting. The background of the painting is dominated by rolling hills (hillocks), buildings, and a cloudy sky, which provides a sense of depth and context to the scene. A blue band or border surrounds the entire composition.

artworks.title: Couple
artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in Kangra style. Ankh Macholi : A couple seated closely on the bed, putting her right hand on her consort s eyes. Her lover putting his right hand round her neck and hold her left hand with his left. flower creeper on blue band round the painting.

artworks.title: Seated Jogi on Tiger's Skin Before His Cottage
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Mughal style. A Jogi seated on tiger's skin before his cottage and a lady seated with a huqqa beside him. Two devotees seated before him, one of them offering presents. A disciple putting wood on fire seated on the ground. An ewer and Linga before them. Moon-lit in the background. Painting at the back. Still life. A vase with flowers of different kinds. Flower creeper in oval shape around it. Flower creeper in gold in between plain golden bands around the painting.

artworks.title: Two Panales : Ganesha and Saraswathi
artworks.description: The painting depicts two main scenes: Ganesha and Sarasvati sitting on lotus thrones facing each other. Another scene shows Krishna seated on a chair, while Sar-paich is being tied by one of the maids. A maid is also holding a mirror in front of someone, possibly Sar-paich or Krishna. In addition to these scenes, there are three maids standing behind pillars and two musicians seated in the background.

artworks.title: Raja Playing Veena
artworks.description: Miniature painting in mixed Mughal and Raj-put style. A Raja playing veena standing before his beloved in the garden. Five ladies behind him. Three standing, and two seated on the ground. The love-lorn lady is seen reclined and five ladies standing behind her and a lady seated beside her. Trees, buildings and cloudy sky in the background. Trees and pond in the foreground. Flower creeper on grey band in between plain golden bands around the painting.

metadata.title2: Standing Infront of His Beloved in the Garden

artworks.title: Lord Krishna with Gopikas
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style with inscription on top. Lord Krishna with gopikas in the forest. Three gopikas standing on either side of him and Krishna putting his right hand round the neck of a gopi and holding the hand of another gopi with his left. Three gopikas standing in front holding two of them musical instruments in their hands. Flower plants, cows, cowherds, lotus flowers and pond in the foreground. Coconut tree, fruit trees and sky in the background.

artworks.title: Lord Krishna Dancing with Gopikas
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Deccani style. A Romantic scene : Lord Krishna enjoying music putting his hand around the neck of a Gopika and holding a flute in his right hand, the Gopika too putting her right hand around his neck and raised her left hand. Two Gopika's playing on musical instruments and the third holding cups standing beside them. A shepherd holding a staff in his hands standing behind them. Trees , stream , hillock and cloudy sky in the foreground. Flower design on blue band in the gold around the painting.

artworks.title: Ram Darbar
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Kangra style. Ram Darbar :- Rama & Sita seated side by side under a canopy on the throne with a bolster at their back. Rama holding a bow in his right hand and an arrow in his left. Two attendants standing behind them, one of them holding a fly-whisk in his right hand and a kerchief in his left. An attendant standing towards his left holding a quiver in his left hand and supporting a mace with his right hand. A noble and three mythological (monkey gods) before them. A chowki, an ewer and a basin placed on the ground. Grassy land and the sky in the background. Flower creeper design on blue band in between plain golden lines around the painting.

metadata.title2: Rama & Sita Seated Side by Side Under a Canopy

artworks.description: Miniature painting framed in double glass in mixed chamba and Malwa style. After a morning ride a man taking rest on a carpet under a tree putting his head on her thigh and she is seated holding a kerchief in her hand. Shield, sword and a kattar beside him. A quiver tied to the branch of a tree and two horses also. Cloudy sky in the background. A red band round the painting.

artworks.title: Laila and Majnu
artworks.description: Miniature painting in mixed Basholi and Kangra style. Laila and Majnu : Majnun sitting in the desert under a tree resting his right hand on the ground raising his left hand. Laila bent a saluting him holding a flagon in her left hand. A lady attendant standing behind her with a tray in her hands. A dog seated in the foreground.

artworks.title: Check the Title
artworks.description: Drawing depicting some saints with an open book in his hand, a lady on his right with ink bottle and pens the one on either side with folded hands. A baby and a woman with gong in front. The two angels standing behind, one holding candle stick and the other book. The creeper border around. Flower pattern in panels in margins. Calligraphic panel on back.

artworks.title: Semi-nude Lady with Semi-nude Man
artworks.description: Painting depicts a semi-nude lady just shooting an arrow. A semi-nude man behind her holding a rabbit in right hand and rabbit and bow in left hand. Two flower creeper in margin. Leaves are tied around the waist of female figure. Specimen of calligraphy on back by Ali.

artworks.title: Two Disabled Men and Opium Addict Man Passing Their Time Under the Tree
artworks.description: A Chinese ink sketch representing three seated figures - one an opium addict (afyuni), the center (ganjja kana lanja langda) one crippled and lame with a parrot perching on his hand, and a semi nude blind man (andha). The two figures on each side shaded by trees.

artworks.title: Representing a Lady Disrobing
artworks.description: The artwork features a sketch in gold polished wooden frame with glass, representing a lady disrobing. Her sari is seen draped over the bed railing, and there are additional details such as an ewer and soap dish on a stool behind her. The margin of the piece has a floral border, adding to its aesthetic appeal. The artwork is signed at the lower corner by S. Ahmed in 1934.

artworks.title: Two Ladies Standing
artworks.description: The framed Chuqtai sketch depicts two ladies standing side by side beside a fountain. One lady is holding a flower in her right hand, while the other lady is also holding a flower in her right hand. In the background of the scene, there are flower plants visible.

artworks.title: Mother and Child
artworks.description: The framed Chughtai sketch depicts a tender moment between a mother and her child. The scene shows the lady with her child in her lap, preparing to nurse him, as evidenced by her uncovered breast. The child's gaze is directed downwards towards a peacock standing before his mother.

artworks.title: Ladt After Bath
artworks.description: Painting on plywood representing a lady after bath dressing her hair. Signed at lower left by Manishi Dey Poona, 1939.

artworks.title: Lady
artworks.description: Painting on plywood representing a woman carrying a pot on her head supported by her right hand. Signed at lower right. Manish Dey Poona, 1939.

artworks.title: Fixing of Reign to Horse
artworks.description: Miniature drawing in Mughal style with the specimen of calligraphy at the back. Horse shoeing:- A man holding the reins of a horse standing before. Another man holding its left fore leg raised with a leather belt and the blacksmith going to fix the nails with his hammer. Tools lying around him. Decorative band around the sketch, the specimen of the calligraphy at the back. Persian verses beginning with:..... ending on :......... Design in a triangular panel at the right corner on top and left at the bottom. Creeper design on light green band in between plain golden lines around the calligraphy.Tools lying around him.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raja Vikramajit
artworks.description: Miniature drawing in Mughal style with inscriptions round the painting. Raja Vikramajit wearing a turban and holding a bud in his right hand, in standing position. A dagger tied up at his waist and a sword hanging at his right. Line drawing with colours noted therein. Persian verses round the sketch. Flower plants in the foreground.A plain golden band around the painting.

artworks.title: Majnu in the Forest Among the Animals
artworks.description: The painting depicts Majnu seated in a serene environment, surrounded by nature. He is accompanied by two birds, one on his shoulder and another on his knee, amidst the forest teeming with animals, beasts, and birds. The frame of the painting features a marble border adorned with red bands and intricate floral patterns in white. The margins of the painting showcase additional floral designs in zig-zag patterns, rendered in white and green hues.

artworks.title: Hunting Scene
artworks.description: Framed picture in Persian style drawn in black and blue and decorated with gold paint. Hunting scene. Three hunters armed with swords, arrows and bows on horse back, deer and rabbits. One in the foreground aiming at the deer, the middle one with bare sword and the last one has shot an arrow. Trees and hillock in background. Flower creeper design in gold against blue, around the painting.

artworks.title: A Cavalier Seated Under a Tree
artworks.description: Framed picture in Persian style partly painted with white, green and red hues. A cavalier seated under a tree on ground holding the reins of the white horse in his left hand. Flower plants in the foreground and cloud designs in the background. Flower creeper in gold against blue band around the picture. Flower creeper designs in gold on turquoise margin.

artworks.title: King Solomon and Queen of Sheba
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene with King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba seated on a throne. A bearded man is shown sitting on a chair, accompanied by three fairies and three demons to his right. Additionally, a fairy stands behind him. In the foreground, various animals are visible, while birds can be seen perched on top of the scene.

artworks.title: Princess Sleeping on Bed
artworks.description: Miniature painting in Raj-put style. A Princess sleeping on bed attended by three women, the old one standing near her head and the other one sitting at her feet and the third standing with a fan in her hand. Fountain and lotus flowers and ducks in the foreground. Parapet, trees, birds and the moon in the background.

artworks.title: King Seated on a Chair
artworks.description: Miniature sketch in Persian style. A king seated on a chair under a tree near a fountain attended by six servants, one of them offering him a wine cup. A man with a musical instruments seating on left side and a singer towards right side. Flower pattern in the margin.

artworks.title: Seated Prince Before a Dervish
artworks.description: The framed miniature sketch is in the Mughal style, depicting a prince seated before a dervish. In the foreground, two old men are seated with a musician in front of them. The sketch features a flower creeper design in gold on a green band around it, and has a gold sprinkled margin.

artworks.title: Seated Man Under a Tree
artworks.description: Framed miniature sketch in Raj-put style. A man seated under a tree on the bank of a river with bearded man standing behind the tree with his horse. Buildings, trees and boats in the background. Grey band around the painting. Gold spray on the band in the margin.
